seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: बायग्राफोरा जोंनो सोंनाय सोंथिफोरनि गोरलै फिननाय, न'आव हालदै गुन्दैखौ माबोरै नायसंनो बेनिफ्राय जागायनानै.
seg.abda31761e23.back: Easy answers to the questions buyers ask us, starting from how to test turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAIनि मानदण्डआव बुङो दङ, हालदै गुन्दैआव दाजाबनाय गाब होग्रा मुवा, लेड क्रोमेट लाफानानै, आरो गुबुन मुवानि स्टार्च थानो मोनाखै. बेनि आनजाद मेनुयेलआव नायसंग्राफोरा हालदैआव मा मा नायसंयो बेनि लिस्ट दं: मेटानिल येल' बादि दाजाबनाय रं, लेडनि सल्ट, आरो चक गुन्दै.
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: The FSSAI standard says that colouring substances added to turmeric powder, including lead chromate, and starch of other things are not allowed to be present. Its testing manual has a list of what testers check in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: बेनि खायसेखौ नों नोंनि संनाय न'आव नायसंनो हायो, आरो खायसेखौ लेबलासिनो दिहुननो हायो. बे लामा दिन्थिनायआव नैटाखौबो बुङो, आरो गोबां मानसिआ बाहायनाय नैटा आनजादनि बागै बुङो जायफोरा हालदैनि थाखाय मावा. नों बायनाय जायखिजाय हालदैआव बेफोरखौ खालामनानै नाय, जोंनि हालदैबो.
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can test in your kitchen, and some only a lab can show. This guide tells about both, and about two tests that many people use which do not work for turmeric. Do these on any turmeric you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हालदै नायसंनायनि उनाव दैनि गिलास नैटा. आगसि: गुरै गोमो दै, गुन्दैआ गाहायाव थुनलायनाय. आगदा: गोहो गोमो दै, गुन्दैनिफ्राय गोमो सारिफोर गाहायाव बोहैनाय.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric test. Left: light yellow water, the powder sunk to the bottom. Right: deep yellow water, yellow streaks flowed from the powder to the bottom.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧दैनि नायसंनाय⟦/1⟧आगसि: गुन्दैआ थुनलायबाय आरो दैआ गुरै गोमो. आगदा: गुन्दैआ थुनलायनाय समाव बेनिफ्राय गोहो गोमो सारिफोर बोहैबाय, आरो दैआ गोहो गोमो जाबाय. बेखौ लेबआव आनजाद खालामनो गोनां.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧Water test⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has sunk and the water is light yellow. Right: while the powder was sinking, deep yellow streaks flowed from it, and the water became deep yellow. This one needs testing in a lab.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: दै मोनसे गिलासनि सायाव फिसा सामुस मोनसे हालदै सिथ आरो लोरसोरायै थुनलायनो हो. हालदैआ थुनलायो आरो दैखौ गुरै गोमो दोनथायो; दैआ गोख्रोंयै गोहो गोमो जायोब्ला दाजाबनाय गाबखौ दिन्थियो. बे नायसंनायआ लेड क्रोमेट एबा चक दिहुननो हाया, बेनिखायनो थि फिन मोननो, जानाय मुवा आनजाद खालामग्रा लेब बाहाय. आयडिन आनजादखौ खालामनो नाङा: हालदैआव गावनोनो स्टार्च दं.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric on top of a glass of water and let it sink without stirring. Turmeric sinks and keeps the water light yellow; if the water quickly becomes deep yellow it shows added colour. This test cannot show lead chromate or chalk, so to be sure, use a food testing lab. The iodine test need not be done: turmeric itself has starch.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: जेरै मेटानिल येल', जाय गाब गैयि हालदैखौ बांसिन सोरांथि नुथाङो. FSSAIआ हालदैआव गाब दाजाबनो होआ.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Like metanil yellow, which makes colourless (dull) turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow adding colour to turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट आरो गुबुन लेडनि सल्ट
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेटआ रं बोनायाव बाहायनाय मोनसे गोमो गाबनि मुवा. 2019 आरो 2024 आव दिहुननाय स्टेनफर्डनि दिन्थिनाय सान्नायफोरा दक्खिन एसियानि खायसे जायगानि हालदैआव बेखौ मोनबाय. FSSAIआ हालदैआव बेखौ एसेबो होआ.
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour substance used in painting. Stanford studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from some places in South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: ओजन बांहोग्रा मोनसे खम दामनि गुफुर गुन्दै.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A low-price white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: गुबुन फसलनि आटा एबा स्टार्च. FSSAIनि मानदण्डआ बेखौबो होआ.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. The FSSAI standard does not allow this either.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: मोनसे सिखां गिलासखौ न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिनि दैजों आबुं खालाम.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: सायाव समान खालामनाय मोनसे फिसा सामुस हालदै गुन्दै सिथ. लोरसोरनो नाङा.
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle on top one levelled small spoon of turmeric powder. No need to stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: गुन्दैआ थुनलायनाय गिबि मिनिटखौ नाय. बेनिफ्राय गाहायाव बोहैनाय गाब थानाय सारिफोर नाय.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first minute while the powder sinks. Look for coloured streaks flowing from it to the bottom.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: बेखौ 15 निफ्राय 20 मिनिट लाखि. बेनि उनाव गिलासखौ मोनसे गुफुर बिनि एबा मोनसे कागजनि सिगाङाव होनानै, थुनलायनाय गुन्दैनि सायाव थानाय दैखौ नाय.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Keep it 15 to 20 minutes. Then holding the glass in front of a white wall or a paper, look at the water above the sunk powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Light yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.back: No sign of any added colour.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गोहो गोमो सारिफोर, एबा मिनिट खायसेनि सिङाव गोहो गोमो दै
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: गाब दाजाबनाय जानो हागौ. बे बेचखौ बाहायनाय थाद' आरो बेखौ आनजाद खालाम.
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using this batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧मानो बेयो मावो.⟦/1⟧ हालदैनि गावनि गोमो गाब, करकुमिन, दैआव मोटेनो गलाया, बेनिखायनो गुन्दैआ थुनलायो आरो दैखौ इसेसो गाब होयो. मेटानिल येल' बादि रंफोरा गोरलैयै गलायो आरो दैखौ गोख्रोंयै गाब होयो.
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, does not dissolve much in water, so the powder sinks and gives the water only a little colour. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧बेयो मा नुनो हाया.⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट आरो चकबो दैआव गलाया, बेनिखायनो बेफोरजों मिसायनाय हालदैआ बे नायसंनायाव फासनो हायो. लेबनि आनजादलासिनो बेफोरखौ गैया होन्नो बुङो हायो.
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What it cannot see.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this test. Only lab testing can say that they are not there.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: जोबोद मिहि गुन्दैआ दैखौ समखायनि थाखाय गोफोर दोनथानो हायो. गोफोर जायोब्लाबो जाथाव नङा; सिखां, गोहो गोमो गाबखौसो नायनांगौ.
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Being cloudy is also not a fault; a clear, deep yellow colour is what should be watched for.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Test 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: गोरान हालदै आबुं मोनसेखौ खावलि बाय. हालदैआ सिङाव-बाहिरा गोमो-कमला गाबनि, बेनिखायनो सिङाव बाहागोआ बाहिरनि बादिनो नुजानांगौ. गाब गैयि एबा गुरै गोमो सिङाव बाहागोनि सायाव सोरांथि गोमो बिगुर थायोब्ला, सायाव गाब दाजाबनाय जानो हागौ. बेनि बागै फानग्राखौ सों, एबा बेखौ आनजाद खालाम.
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one dry whole turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange in colour inside and outside, so the inner part should look the same as the outside. If there is a bright yellow skin over a colourless or light yellow inner part, colour may have been added on top. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: आयडिनआ स्टार्चजों लोगो मोनोब्ला गोसोम-नीला जायो, आरो हालदैआव आटा नायसंनो सरासनस्रायै बेखौ बुङो. नाथाय हालदैआव गावनोनो स्टार्च दं, बेनिखायनो जेरैबो बेयो गोसोम-नीला जायो. बेनिखायनो FSSAIनि गावनि मेनुयेलआ हालदैनि अनगायै गुबुन गुन्दै मसलानि थाखाय आयडिन आनजाद बाहायो.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine turns black-blue when it meets starch, and it is commonly said to check for flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself contains starch, so it turns black-blue anyway. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for other powdered spices besides turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हालदैआव लेड, मेटानिल येल' आरो चक नायसंनो FSSAIनि आनजादआव गोहो हाइड्रोक्लोरिक एबा सल्फिउरिक एसिड बाहायो. बे एसिडफोरा बिगुर आरो मेगनखौ साथियो. बेफोरा लेबआव थानांगौ, संनाय न'आव नङा.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use strong hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They should be in a lab, not in a kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: थि फिन मोननो: जानाय मुवा आनजाद खालामग्रा लेब
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: To be sure: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABLआ मान्यता होनाय जानाय मुवा आनजाद खालामग्रा लेबआ हालदैखौ लेड आरो दाजाबनाय गाबनि थाखाय आनजाद खालामनो हायो. लेबखौ बेसेबां नमुना नांगौ सों, गुन्दैखौ बेनि बन्द खालामनाय पेकआव एबा मोनसे सिखां बन्द खालामनाय बेगआव लाखि, आरो पेकआव दिहुननाय बेच नम्बरखौ लिरनानै लाखि. FSSAIआ गावनि वेबसाइटआव नटिफाइ खालामनाय जानाय मुवा आनजाद लेबफोरनि लिस्ट दिहुनो.
seg.1883beca4d73.back: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and added colour. Ask the lab how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and write down and keep the batch number shown on the pack. FSSAI shows a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI लाइसेन्स एबा रेजिस्ट्रेसन नम्बर. बेखौ नों FSSAIनि FoSCoS वेबसाइटआव नायनो हायो.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can check it on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: जाय बेखौ बानायबाय एबा पेक खालामबाय, बिनि मुं आरो ठिकाना.
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of whoever made it or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: नेट बिबां, MRP, बेच एबा लट नम्बर, आरो बेस्ट-बिफर तारिख.
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: बेखौ बबेयाव गायनाय. गुबुन गुबुन ओनसोलनि हालदैनि गाबआ गुबुन, बेनिखायनो ओनसोलनि मुं थाब्ला समान रोखोमनि हालदैखौ रुजुनो हेफाजाब होयो.
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. The colour of turmeric of different regions is different, so having the region's name helps to compare the same kind of turmeric.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पेकखौ जिप फांथेनानै लाखि, एबा गुन्दैखौ मोनसे गोरान, बार हाबनो हायि जारआव दोन.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack zipped shut, or put the powder in a dry, airtight jar.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: गोरान सामुस बाहाय. दैथि थानाय सामुसनि थाखायनो हालदैआ दला दला जायो.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. Because of a moist spoon the turmeric becomes lumpy.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: बेखौ सोजा सानि सोरांआव दा लाखि, मानोना सानि सोरांआ गाबखौ खमायो.
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Do not keep it in direct sunlight, because sunlight reduces the colour.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: जोबोद सोरांथि गोमो हालदैआ गाज्रि सिन नामा?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: गावसेयावनो नङा. गाबआ हालदैनि रोखोम, बबेयाव गायनाय आरो माबोरै फोरानना आरो गुन्दै खालामनाय, बेनि सायाव सोलायो, बेनिखायनो हालदैफोर गोबां गुबुन जायो. नायनांगौ खामानिआ: गाबआ गुन्दैनिफ्राय जोबोद गोरलैयै ओंखारोमा नाङा, दैनि नायसंनायाव नुनाय बादि.
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. The colour changes based on the turmeric's variety, where it was grown and how it was 'phoranna'(?) and powdered, so turmerics are very different. The work (thing) to check: whether the colour comes out very easily from the powder, as seen in the water test.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: दैनि नायसंनायआ हालदैआव लेड गैया होन्नो दिन्थिनो हागोमा?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water test show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: हाया. लेड क्रोमेटआ दैआव गलाया, बेनिखायनो दैनि नायसंनायआ बेखौ नुनो हाया. लेबनि आनजादलासिनो हायो.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: It cannot. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water test cannot see it. Only a lab can.

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: दैथि. दैथि थानाय सामुस एबा खेवनाय पेकआ गुन्दैखौ दै लानो होयो. गोरान सामुसजों दलाफोरखौ बाय आरो पेकखौ बन्द खालामनानै लाखि.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A moist spoon or an open pack lets the powder take water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What should be done if a fault appears in the test?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: बे बेचखौ बाहायनाय थाद', पेकखौ लाखि, आरो बेच नम्बरजों फानग्राजों सोमोन्दो दाथाय. नों FSSAIनि Food Safety Connect एपजोंबो FSSAIनो खिथानो हायो. बेयो जोंनि जायोब्ला, पेक आरो गिलासनि फटो जोंनो WhatsAppजों फाथाय.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using this batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also complain to FSSAI with FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, send a photo of the pack and the glass to us by WhatsApp.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: जोंनि हालदैआवबो बे नायसंनायफोर खालामनानै नाय. जायखिजाय गाज्रि नुजायोब्ला, पेकनि बेच नम्बरजों मोनसे फटो ⟦1⟧जोंनो WhatsApp खालाम⟦/1⟧.
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these tests on our turmeric too. If anything bad appears, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the pack's batch number.

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडी कूरा आ आन्ध्रनि न'फोराव रबिबारनि सान गेजेरनि उनाव संनाय दाव बेदोरनि ओंख्री: बेगेर थानाय दाव बेदोरखौ बानलु आरो हालदैआव फोथेरनानै, गोहो सोनानि गाब जानाय सामब्राम गोजा आरो टोमाटोनि झोलआव संनानै, गरम मसलाजों जोबनो हो. बेखौ गुदुं ओंखामजों जानो होयो, आरो बांसिनखौ हरनि समाव दोसा एबा चापातिजों.
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi kura is the chicken-meat curry cooked after midday on Sunday in Andhra homes: bone-in chicken meat marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked in a gravy of onion turned deep golden colour and tomato, finished with garam masala. It is served with hot rice, and the extra at night time with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: बेनि गुदुंआ जोंनि तेजा बानलु गुन्दैनिफ्राय फैयो, गुन्टुरनि जोबोद गुदुं बानलु, जाय आन्ध्रनि ओंख्रीफोरखौ बेनि जोबोद गुदुं सोवाद आरो गोजा रं होयो, आरो फोथेरनायाव जोंनि हालदै गुन्दै. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय आरो सैमायै गुदुं; खामानि बाथ्राफोराव बेखौ माबोरै खमाय खालामनो हायो बुंनाय दं.
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: Its heat comes from our Teja chilli powder, Guntur's very hot chilli, which gives Andhra curries their very hot taste and red colour, and our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe is for 4 people and properly hot; the tips say how it can be made less.

seg.9cb820880217.back: Marinate the chicken meat in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a gravy of onion turned deep golden and tomato. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧जोबोद गुदुं; माजारि गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस बाहाय⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.t: 1 फिसा सामुस संख्रि ⟦1⟧जोबनायाव सोवाद नायनानै गुबुन⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧taste at the end and add more⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस थाउ ⟦1⟧आन्ध्रआव सरासनस्रायै चिनाबादामनि थाउ बाहायो⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra groundnut oil is commonly used⟦/1⟧

seg.4a1335d92ae2.t: 2 गेदेर सामब्राम गोजा ⟦1⟧मिहि खावनाय, मोटामुटि 2 कप⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 कप गुदुं दै ⟦1⟧पातला झोलनि थाखाय इसे बांसिन⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for thin gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: Also goes well with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: दाव बेदोरखौ दहि, तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों हुर. 30 मिनिट थादनो हो. नोंनि संनाय न'आ गुदुं जायोब्ला बाटिखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Mix the chicken meat with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Let it rest 30 minutes. If your kitchen is hot, cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: मोनसे गोरोंथि सराय एबा कराइआव माजारि अराव थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम. लोंग, एलाची आरो दालचिनि दोन आरो सेकेन्ड खायसे छिं छिं जानो हो.
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat the oil on medium flame in a heavy pan or kadai. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: सामब्राम गोजा, सोमखोर बानलु आरो करि बिलाइ दोन.
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onion, green chilli and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: सामब्राम गोजाखौ थाउआव गोहो सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव. बेयो माजारि अराव 12–15 मिनिट लायो; खन खन लोरसोर, अब्ला बेफोरा सामानै बादामि जागोन आरो सावखांआ.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onion in the oil until deep golden colour. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium flame; stir now and then, then they will become evenly brown and will not burn.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट दोन, बेनि उनाव टोमाटो, आरो गुदुर जानो सिम सं. पेस्टखौ संजायि मुसुं थांनो सिम 1 मिनिट साव, बेनि उनाव टोमाटोखौ 5–6 मिनिट सं, निसि निसि, बेफोरा गलायनो आरो सेरफोराव थाउ नुनो सिम.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomato, and cook until soft. Fry the paste 1 minute until the uncooked smell goes, then cook the tomato 5–6 minutes, pressing, until they melt and oil shows at the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: धनिया गुन्दै दोननानै लोरसोर आरो 30 सेकेन्ड साव.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: दाव बेदोर दोन आरो बेगेरनि खाथियाव गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जानो सिम माजारि अराव खुबुमनानै सं. गिबि 5 मिनिट खुबुमै साव, दुकुराफोरा गेजेरजों नुनो हायै जानो सिम, बेनि उनाव गुदुं दैखौ फोनां, खुबुम आरो मोटामुटि 20 मिनिट सं, खन खन लोरसोरनानै.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken meat and cook covered on medium flame until there is not a single pink colour near the bone. First fry 5 minutes uncovered, until the pieces cannot be seen through in the middle, then pour the hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: मोनसे मोटा दुकुरा नाय: बेगेरनि खाथियाव गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जायोब्ला आरो रसआ साफ ओंखारोब्ला दाव बेदोरआ संजाबाय. झोलनि सोवाद नाय आरो नांब्ला संख्रि दोन.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check one thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम मसला आरो धनिया बिलाइ दोननानै लोरसोर. खुबुमै 3 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं, झोलआ नोंनो मोजां मोननाय बादि गाढा जानो सिम आरो सायाव थाउनि गोजा फान्दा बुहुनो सिम.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Add garam masala and coriander leaves and stir. Covered, simmer on low fire for 3 minutes, until the gravy is as thick as you like and red drops of oil come up on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: अरखौ थाद' आरो जानो होनायनि सिगां ओंख्रीखौ 10 मिनिट थादनो हो; झोलआ थिरो जायो आरो सोवादआ गासै गोरोबो.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Stop the flame and let the curry rest 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the taste all mixes.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: सामब्राम गोजाखौ गोहो सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव; झोलनि रं आरो गाढाथिआ बेफोरनिफ्रायनो फैयो.
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the red onions until deep golden colour; the gravy's colour and thickness come from them.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ जोबोद गुदुं. माजारि गुदुं ओंख्रीनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस बाहाय, एबा गुरै गुदुंजों गोजा रंनि थाखाय सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium-hot curry use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour with mild heat use Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: बेगेर थानाय दुकुरा बाहाय; बेगेरफोरा झोलखौ गोहो सोवाद होयो.
seg.57940a63282d.back: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy a deep taste.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: दाव बेदोर दोननायनि सिगां टोमाटो मसलानिफ्राय थाउआ गुबुन जानो हो, नङाब्ला झोलआ संजायि सोवाद मोनो.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Before adding the chicken meat, let the oil separate from the tomato masala, otherwise the gravy tastes uncooked.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: नारिकल कोडी कूरा: 3 गेदेर सामुस रुखुनाय नारिकल आरो 1 गेदेर सामुस पोस्तोखौ इसे दैजों गुन्दै खालाम, आरो गोहो झोलनि थाखाय पेस्टखौ गरम मसलाजों लोगोसे दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.164627c386b7.back: Coconut kodi kura: make a paste of 3 tablespoons grated coconut and 1 tablespoon poppy seed with a little water, and add the paste together with the garam masala and stir, for a deep (rich) gravy.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: गुन्दै खालामनाय मसला: 1 गेदेर सामुस धनियानि बिजि, 1 फिसा सामुस मौरिनि बिजि, 3 लोंग आरो फिसा दुकुरा दालचिनिखौ थाउ गैयै साव, गुन्दै खालाम, आरो धनिया गुन्दै आरो गरम मसलानि सोलायाव बाहाय.
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: fry without oil 1 tablespoon coriander seed, 1 teaspoon fennel seed, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेसार कुकार: दाव बेदोर आरो दै दोननायनि उनाव, 2 सिटि जानो सिम सं आरो प्रेसारखौ गावनो गावनो खमायनो हो.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken meat and water, cook until 2 whistles and let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: रबिबारनि आदबै, भाप गोनां ओंखाम आरो सामुस मोनसे घिजों गुदुंयै जानो हो. बेयो चापाति, दोसा एबा रागी संगटिजोंबो मोजां जायो.
seg.8b4376996905.back: In the Sunday way, serve hot with steamed rice and one spoon of ghee. It is also good with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव 2 सान सिम लाखि; गेजेर सिम भाप ओंखारनो सिम गुदुं खालाम. गाबोनआव ओंख्रीनि सोवादआ गोहो जायो.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Cover and keep in the fridge up to 2 days; heat until steam comes out through to the middle. The curry's taste becomes deep tomorrow.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: आन्ध्रनि दाव बेदोरनि ओंख्रीखौ माबोरै खमाय गुदुं खालामनो?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra chicken-meat curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दैखौ 1 फिसा सामुस सिम खमाय, एबा सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय, जाय समान गोजा रं होयो, नाथाय गुरै गुदुंजों. जोबनायाव सामुस मोनसे दहि दोननानै लोरसोरोब्लाबो गुदुंआ खमायो.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce the Teja chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour but with mild heat. Stirring in one spoon of curd at the end also reduces the heat.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: आन्ध्रनि दाव बेदोरनि ओंख्रीआ मानो जोबोद गुदुं?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken [lit. bird-meat] curry very hot [गुदुं: or spicy]?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आन्ध्रनि संनायाव तेजा बादि गुन्टुरनि बानलु बाहायो, जायफोरा गुबुन हादरनि गोबां ओंख्रीआव बाहायनाय बानलु गुन्दैनिख्रुइ खोब गुदुं. गुदुंआ बे जाथाइनि बाहागो.
seg.ada87f188506.back: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies like Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in many curries of other regions. The heat is part of this style.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: दाव बेदोरआ गेजेर सिम संजाबाय होन्नानै माबोरै मिथिनो?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How to know the chicken meat is cooked through to the middle?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: बेगेरनि खाथियाव खोब मोटा दुकुराखौ दान. बेगेरनि खाथियाव गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जायोब्ला आरो रसआ साफ ओंखारोब्ला दाव बेदोरआ संजाबाय.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains near the bone and the juice comes out clear.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: दहि गैयै कोडी कूरा बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can kodi kura be made without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: हागौ. दाव बेदोरखौ बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै, संख्रि आरो 1 गेदेर सामुस नेमुनि रसजों फोथेर, आरो झोलआव गुबुन मोनसे टोमाटो दोन.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the chicken meat with chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · आन्ध्र कोडी कूरानि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Recipe method of Andhra Kodi Kura | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. आन्ध्रनि रबिबारनि दाव बेदोरनि ओंख्री: तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो हालदै गुन्दैआव फोथेरनाय दाव बेदोर, गरम मसलाजों गोहो सामब्राम गोजा-टोमाटोनि झोलआव संनाय.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra's Sunday chicken-meat curry: chicken meat marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.49ffbe38c150.t: आन्ध्र कोडी कूरा (आन्ध्रनि दाव बेदोरनि ओंख्री) · 1acrefarms

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आन्ध्र कोडी कूरा: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ef9179c0bfa9.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दै 540 g नि पेक
seg.ef9179c0bfa9.back: Pack of Teja chilli powder 540 g

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · बेल्लम पोंगली · गुड़ वाला मीठा पोंगल
seg.d04209f30de4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · gud wala meetha pongal [this part is in Hindi, not Bodo]

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगली आ तेलुगु न'फोराव संक्रान्तिनि फुंआव संनाय गोदै पंगल: मायरं आरो सावनाय मुग दालखौ जोबोद गुदुर जानो सिम संनानै, बेनि उनाव गुरजों गोदै खालामनानै आरो घिजों गोहो खालामो. बेखौ फोरबोनि जानायनि सिगां नैवेद्यम महरै होयो, आरो बेयो गोबां मन्दिर आरो सुक्रबारनि पूजायाव प्रसादमबो.
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal cooked in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked until very soft, then made sweet with jaggery and made deep (rich) with ghee. It is given as naivedyam before the festival meal, and it is also prasadam in many temples and in Friday puja.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: खुसेरनि गुरआ बेखौ फिका बादामि रं आरो टफि बादि आबुं गोदैथि होयो. जोंनि जीडिपप्पु पेकेटनिफ्राय लानाय आबुं खाजुफोरखौ घिआव सावनानै दोनो, आरो बेफोरा खरखर होयो. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.17053455adbb.back: The jaggery of khuser [best reading: sugarcane] gives it a pale badami [almond-coloured, light brown] colour and a toffee-like rich [abwng: unclear, could mean rich/deep/full] taste. Roasting/frying in ghee the abwng [same unclear word: possibly rich/plump/whole] cashews taken from our Jeedipappu packet, put/add them, and they give crunch [kharkhar: crunchy/crisp]. This cooking method/recipe is for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: संनाय समआ प्रेसार कुकारनि थाखाय; हाण्डिआव मोटामुटि 15 मिनिट बांसिन लायो.
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is for a pressure cooker; in a pot it takes about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: सावनाय मुग दाल आरो मायरंखौ जोबोद गुदुर जानो सिम सं, गलायनाय खुसेरनि गुर दोननानै लोरसोर आरो जोंजों जानो सिम गुरै अराव फुदुं. घिआव सावनाय खाजु, किसमिस आरो एलाचीजों जोबनो हो.
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, stir in melted sugarcane jaggery and boil on low flame until joined together. Finish with cashews, raisins and cardamom fried in ghee.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ कप मुग दाल ⟦1⟧बायनाय गोमो मुग दाल (पेसरपप्पु), मोटामुटि 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 कप रुखुनाय खुसेरनि गुर ⟦1⟧गुरै नेनानै, मोटामुटि 150 g; बांसिन गोदै मोजां मोनोब्ला इसे बांसिन⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧pressed lightly, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: जानो हानाय कपुर (पच्चा कर्पूरम) इसे ⟦1⟧मोजां मोनोब्ला; जोबोद फिसा इसे⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: edible camphor (pachcha karpuram) a little ⟦1⟧if you like; very small amount⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मुग दालखौ इसे सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव, बेनि उनाव मायरंजों लोगोसे जोबोद गुदुर आरो लेबेलेबे जानो सिम सं. गिबियाव दालखौ प्रेसार कुकार एबा गोरोंथि हाण्डिआव गुरै अराव थाउ गैयै साव, लोरसोरनानै, बादाम बादि मुसुं होनो आरो इसे सोनानि गाब जानो सिम, मोटामुटि 3–4 मिनिट.
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Fry the moong dal until a little golden, then cook together with the rice until very soft and mushy. First, fry the dal in the pressure cooker or heavy pot on low flame without oil, stirring, to give a nut-like smell and until a little golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: सावनाय दालआव मायरं दोन, मोननैखौबो लोगोसे 2–3 मोन दै सोलायनानै सु, आरो दैखौ बोहैनो हो.
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add the rice to the fried dal, wash both together changing the water 2–3 times, and drain the water.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 कप दैखौ दोन. माजारि अराव 4–5 सिटि जानो सिम प्रेसार कुकारआव सं आरो प्रेसारखौ गावनो गावनो खमायनो हो, एबा हाण्डिआव खुबुमनानै 25–30 मिनिट गुरै अराव सं, गोरान जायोब्ला इसे गुदुं दै दोननानै.
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add the 3 cups water. Cook in the pressure cooker on medium flame until 4–5 whistles and let the pressure come down by itself, or cook covered in a pot on low flame 25–30 minutes, adding a little hot water when it gets dry.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: खेव आरो हातानि उनथिंजों मायरं आरो दालखौ इसे निसि. बेयो गुदुर आरो जाउ बादि जाथारनाय नांगौ, गोरान नङा.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Mash the rice and dal a little with the back of the ladle. It needs to be soft and like porridge, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: गुरखौ ¼ कप दैआव गलाय आरो मायरंआव फोनां. फिसा सरायआव गुर आरो दैखौ गुरै अराव लोरसोरनानै गलायनो सिम गुदुं खालाम, मोटामुटि 2–3 मिनिट; बेखौ फुदुंनो नाङा.
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in the ¼ cup water and pour into the rice. In a small pan heat the jaggery and water on low flame, stirring until it melts, about 2–3 minutes; it need not boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: लोरसोरनानै गाढा आरो जोंजों जानो सिम गुरै अराव फुदुं, 5–7 मिनिट; 2 गेदेर सामुस घि दोननानै लोरसोर. अरखौ गुरै दोन आरो सिंथार सिम लोरसोर, मानोना गुर दोननायनि उनाव पोंगलीआ गोख्रोंयै सिंथाराव गोबाखांयो.
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Stirring, simmer on low fire until thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; add 2 tablespoons ghee and stir. Keep the fire low and stir to the bottom, because after adding jaggery the pongali sticks hard to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: सोवाद नाय, आरो बांसिन गोदै नांब्ला इसे बांसिन गलायनाय गुर दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if more sweet is needed add a little more melted jaggery and stir.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: खाजुखौ बांसिन घिआव साव; एलाचीजों लोगोसे दोन. फिसा सरायआव बांसिन 2 गेदेर सामुस घिखौ माजारि-गुरै अराव गुदुं खालाम आरो खाजुफोरखौ सोनानि गाब जानो सिम लोरसोर, मोटामुटि 1 मिनिट, जोबथा सेकेन्ड खायसेआव किसमिस दोननानै बेफोरा फुलिनो सिम.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry the cashews in the remaining ghee; add together with cardamom. In a small pan heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee on medium-low flame and stir the cashews until golden colour, about 1 minute, adding the raisins in the last few seconds until they swell.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: खाजु, किसमिस आरो घिखौ पोंगलीनि सायाव फोनां, एलाची गुन्दै आरो कपुर, बाहायोब्ला, सिखार आरो मोजांङै लोरसोर.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee on top of the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and camphor, if using, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: अरखौ थाद' आरो गुदुंयै जानो हो. पोंगलीआ थायोब्ला गाढा जायो; नांब्ला सामुस खायसे गुदुं दै दोननानै पातला खालाम.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the fire and let it become warm. Pongali becomes thick when it sits; if needed, thin it by adding a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: मायरं आरो दालखौ आबुं गुदुर जानो सिम सं; गुर दोननायनि उनाव बेफोरा गुदुर जानो थादो.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal until fully soft; after adding jaggery they stop becoming soft.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मुग दालखौ सावनायनि जाहोनआव पोंगलीआ बादाम बादि मुसुं होयो; अरखौ गुरै दोन, अब्ला बेयो सोनानि गाब जायो, बादामि नङा.
seg.c5408f916731.back: Because the moong dal is fried, the pongali gives a nut-like smell; keep the flame low, then it becomes golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: गोरोंथि सिंथार गोनां सराय बाहाय आरो गुर दोननायनि उनाव लोरसोरनो थाखो; बेयो गोख्रोंयै गोबाखांयो आरो सावखांयो.
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring after adding jaggery; it sticks quickly and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगलीआ इसे पातला थानाय समावनो अरनिफ्राय बेखार ला; गुसुयोब्ला बेयो गाढा जायो.
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take it off the fire while the pongali is still a little thin; when cold it becomes thick.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: तालनि गुर: अनसाय खोमसि पोंगली आरो गोहो, धुवां बादि गोदैथिनि थाखाय समान बिबांनि रुखुनाय तालनि गुर बाहाय.
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: for a darker pongali and a deep, smoke-like sweetness use the same quantity of grated palm jaggery.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केरा पोंगली: गुफुर, चिनिनि गोदैथि गोनां पोंगलीनि थाखाय गुरनि सोलायाव ¾ कप चिनि बाहाय.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: for a white pongali with sugar sweetness use ¾ cup sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: संक्रान्तिनि फुंआव बेखौ नैवेद्यम महरै हो, बेनि उनाव फोरबोनि जानायजों, पुलिहोरा आरो गारेलुजों लोगोसे गुदुंयै जानो हो.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: On Sankranti morning give it as naivedyam, then serve it hot with the festival meal, together with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. जानो होनायनि सिगां इसे गुदुं दै आरो इसे घि दोननानै, लोरसोरनानै गुदुं खालाम.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Cover the extra and keep it in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving, heat it by adding a little hot water and a little ghee, stirring.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: पोंगली आरो चक्केरा पोंगलीनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: पोंगली बुंब्ला सरासनस्रायै गोलमरिच आरो जिराजों बानायनाय संख्रिनि सोवाद गोनां पोंगलीखौ बुङो. चक्केरा पोंगली आरो बेल्लम पोंगली आ गोदै पोंगली, चिनि एबा गुरजों बानायनाय.
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Pongali usually means the pongali with a salt taste made with black pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet pongali, made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: बेल्लम पोंगलीखौ प्रेसार कुकारआव बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can bellam pongali be made in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: हागौ. सावनाय दाल आरो मायरंखौ 3 कप दैजों 4–5 सिटि जानो सिम सं, प्रेसारखौ गावनो गावनो खमायनो हो, बेनि उनाव गलायनाय गुर दोन आरो खेवनाय कुकारआव गुरै अराव फुदुं.
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the fried dal and rice with 3 cups water until 4–5 whistles, let the pressure come down by itself, then add the melted jaggery and boil on low flame in the open cooker.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: आंनि पोंगलीआ गुसुनायनि उनाव मानो गोरा जाबाय?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: पोंगलीआ गुसुयोब्ला गाढा जायो, आरो गुर दोननायनि उनाव गोलाव समाव फुदुंब्ला बेयो बांसिन गोरा जायो. बेयो इसे पातला थानाय समावनो बेखार ला, आरो बांसिनखौ गुदुं दैजों पातला खालाम.
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali becomes thick when cold, and if boiled a long time after adding jaggery it becomes extra hard. Take it off while it is still a little thin, and thin the leftover with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: पोंगलीनि थाखाय तालनि गुर बाहायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can palm jaggery be used for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: हागौ. समान बिबांनि रुखुनाय तालनि गुर (ताटि बेल्लम) बाहाय. पोंगलीआ अनसाय खोमसि जायो आरो सोवादआ गोहो आरो इसे धुवां बादि जायो.
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same quantity of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes darker and the taste becomes deep and a little smoke-like.

seg.d63c3cc4eeac.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి · बेल्लम पोंगलीनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.d63c3cc4eeac.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి · Recipe method of Bellam Pongali | 1acrefarms

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. संक्रान्तिनि थाखाय बेल्लम पोंगली: मायरं आरो सावनाय मुग दालखौ गुदुर जानो सिम संनानै, खुसेरनि गुरजों गोदै खालामनानै आरो घिआव सावनाय खाजुजों जोबनो होनाय. 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked until soft, made sweet with sugarcane jaggery and finished with cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगली: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: आन्ध्र चेपला पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रनि तेंतेलि नानि ओंख्री)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra's tamarind fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.eb258fb767e0.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Chepala Pulusu · Andhra machhli curry [this part is Hindi, not Bodo]

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपला पुलुसु आ आन्ध्रनि लैथो सेरनि तेंतेलि नानि ओंख्री, जायखौ गोदावरी जिलाफोराव बिसेस जतनजों बानायो: मोटा दानजानाय नानि दुकुराखौ सामब्राम गोजा, सोमखोर बानलु आरो करि बिलाइ दोननानै, खाखि आरो गोजा तेंतेलिनि झोलआव गुरै अराव फुदुंनाय. बेयो रबिबारनि सान गेजेरनि जानाय, आरो गोबां न'आव बेखौ हानि हाण्डिआव संनानै गाबोननि थाखाय लाखियो, जेब्ला झोलआ नानि गेजेराव हाबबाय जायो.
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is a tamarind fish curry of Andhra's sea coast [लैथो सेरनि: read as 'sea-shore / coastal'], which is made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick-cut fish pieces, after putting on [दोननानै: 'putting/applying', possibly 'marinating with'] red [सामब्राम गोजा: unclear; possibly 'red chilli' or 'red spice'], [सोमखोर बानलु: unclear; possibly 'turmeric powder' or some spice powder] and curry leaves, simmered [फुदुंनाय: boiled/simmered] gently [गुरै अराव: 'slowly/softly'] in a sour [खाखि: best reading 'sour/tangy', uncertain] and red tamarind gravy. This is a Sunday midday meal [सान गेजेरनि जानाय: literally 'middle-of-the-day eating', i.e. lunch], and in many homes it is cooked in an earthen pot [हानि हाण्डि: literally 'pot of earth/clay'] and kept for the next day [गाबोन: 'tomorrow'], when the gravy has entered into the fish [हाबबाय जायो: 'has gone in / soaked in'].

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: जोंनि हालदै गुन्दैआ फोथेरनाय आरो झोलआव हाबो. सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ पुलुसुखौ गोहो गोजा रं आरो तेंतेलिजों समान जानाय थिर गुदुं होयो. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder enters the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and a steady heat equal with the tamarind. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: थियारिआव 15-मिनिटनि फोथेरनाय लाफाबाय. ओंख्रीखौ घन्टा खायसे थादनो होब्ला सोवादआ बांसिन मोजां जायो.
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: The 15-minute marinating is included in preparation. If the curry is left to rest a few hours the taste becomes better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: नाखौ संख्रि, हालदै आरो बानलु गुन्दैआव फोथेर, सामब्राम गोजा आरो मसलाखौ साव, बेफोरखौ तेंतेलिनि दैआव फुदुं, बेनि उनाव लोरसोरै नाखौ झोलआव गुरै गुरै फुदुं.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish in salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry the onion and masala, boil them in the tamarind water, then without stirring boil the fish slowly in the gravy.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g नानि दुकुरा ⟦1⟧गोसो दानजानाय गोरा ना: रोहु (बोचा), कोरामीनु (सौल ना) एबा सुरमाइ (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧thick-cut firm fish: rohu (bocha), korameenu (saul fish) or surmai (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g तेंतेलि ⟦1⟧नेमु महरनि मोनसे गुटि, 2 कप गुदुं दैआव 15 मिनिट हुबनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧one ball the size of a lemon, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups hot water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ फिसा सामुस हालदै गुन्दै ⟦1⟧फोथेरनायनि थाखाय ¼ फिसा सामुस, झोलनि थाखाय ¼ फिसा सामुस⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for marinating, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 गेदेर सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧फोथेरनायनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस, बांसिनखौ झोलनि थाखाय⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for marinating, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 फिसा सामुस संख्रि ⟦1⟧झोलनि थाखाय, एबा सोवाद नायनानै⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or by tasting⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: Also goes well with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: नानि दुकुराफोरखौ दैआव नै एबा थाम मोन गुरैयै सु आरो दैखौ मोजांङै बोहैनो हो.
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain the water well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: नाखौ संख्रि, हालदै आरो 1 फिसा सामुस बानलु गुन्दैजों हुर; 15 मिनिट थादनो हो. फोथेरनायनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस संख्रि आरो ¼ फिसा सामुस हालदै गुन्दै बाहाय.
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Mix the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder; let it rest 15 minutes. For marinating use 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: हुबनाय तेंतेलिखौ बेनि दैआव मोजांङै सिप आरो सेखा. नोंनि मोटामुटि 2 कप पातला तेंतेलिनि दै जानांगौ.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: मोनसे गुवार सराय एबा हानि हाण्डिआव माजारि अराव थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम. मेथि, बेसोर आरो जिरा दोन आरो फुटिनो हो, मेथिआ खोमसि जायाखै होन्नानै नेनाननै.
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat the oil on medium flame in a wide pan or earthen pot. Add fenugreek, mustard and cumin and let them splutter, watching that the fenugreek does not turn dark.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: सामब्राम गोजा, बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ थाउआव गुदुर जानो सिम साव; मसला गुन्दैफोर दोन. सामब्राम गोजाखौ गुदुर आरो इसे सोनानि गाब जानो सिम मोटामुटि 6–8 मिनिट साव, हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट आरो टोमाटो दोननानै 2 मिनिट सं, बेनि उनाव बांसिन हालदै गुन्दै, बांसिन सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै आरो धनिया गुन्दै दोननानै 30 सेकेन्ड लोरसोर.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry the onion, chilli and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the masala powders. Fry the onion about 6–8 minutes until soft and a little golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: तेंतेलिनि दै फोनां आरो थाउआ सायाव उदोंनो सिम 10 मिनिट फुदुं. झोलनि थाखाय संख्रि दोन; तेंतेलिनि संजायि मुसुंआ थांनांगौ आरो झोलआ इसे गाढा जानांगौ.
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until the oil separates on top. Add salt for the gravy; the raw smell of tamarind should go and the gravy should become a little thick.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: झोलनि सोवाद नाय. बेयो सोवाद मोनै खाखि, संख्रि आरो गुदुं जानांगौ, मानोना नाआ बेनि खायसेखौ हाबनानै लागोन.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should taste sour, salty and hot, because the fish will take in some of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: नाखौ गुरैयै हाबहो आरो खुबुमनानै 10–12 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं; सरायखौ गिदिं, लोरसोरनो नङा. दुकुराफोरखौ मोनसे सारिआव दोन, बेफोरनि सायाव सामुसजों झोल फोनां आरो अरखौ गुरै दोन.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Slide the fish in gently and boil covered 10–12 minutes on low flame; swirl the pan, do not stir. Put the pieces in one row, pour gravy on top of them with a spoon and keep the flame low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: मोनसे दुकुरानि खोब मोटा जायगाखौ नाय: बेदोरआ गेजेर सिम गुफुर एबा गेजेरजों नुनो हायै जायोब्ला आरो बेगेरनिफ्राय अंखाबै बारखांयोब्ला नाआ संजाबाय.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check the thickest part of one piece: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or cannot be seen through to the centre, and comes away easily from the bone.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: धनिया बिलाइ सिखार, अरखौ थाद' आरो जानो होनायनि सिगां पुलुसुखौ खुबुमनानै खमैबो 30 मिनिट थादनो हो.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander leaves, stop the flame and before serving let the pulusu rest covered at least 30 minutes.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: लोरसोरनायनि सोलायाव सरायखौ गिदिं, अब्ला नाआ आबुं थागोन.
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Swirl the pan instead of stirring, then the fish will stay whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: मोटा दानजानाय गोरा ना सायख'; पातला दुकुराफोरा गोलाव समाव फुदुंनायाव बायो.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose thick-cut firm fish; thin pieces break with long boiling.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ माजारि गुदुं होयो. गुरै पुलुसुनि थाखाय 1½ गेदेर सामुस बाहाय, एबा आन्ध्रनि सरासनस्राय गुदुंनि थाखाय आबुं 2 गेदेर सामुस बाहाय.
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a mild pulusu use 1½ tablespoons, or for usual Andhra heat use the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: ना दोननायनि सिगां तेंतेलिनि झोलखौ मोजांङै फुदुं; ना दोननायनि उनाव, नाआ बायाखै बेखौ गोलाव समाव संनो हाया.
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; after adding the fish, it cannot be cooked a long time without breaking.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दै: बांसिन गुदुं पुलुसुनि थाखाय झोलआव सन्नमनि सोलायाव 1 गेदेर सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय. तेजाआ जोबोद गुदुं; सन्देहो जायोब्ला 2 फिसा सामुसजों जागाय.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu use 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if in doubt start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्याला पुलुसु: 400 g साफ खालामनाय इचा ना बाहाय आरो गोलाबि जानो आरो बेंखेनो सिम 5–6 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं.
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and boil on low flame 5–6 minutes until they become pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाया पुलुसु: गुदुं बोथोराव गोदावरीनि न'फोरा मिनिया आमनि दुकुरा दोनो आरो खमाय तेंतेलि बाहायो.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in the hot season Godavari homes add pieces of unripe mango and use less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: गुदुं, भाप गोनां ओंखाम आरो दानजानाय सामब्राम गोजाजों जानो हो. गोदावरीनि गोबां न'आ बेखौ गाबोनआव जानो होयो, जेब्ला सोवादफोरा थिरो जाबाय.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and cut onion. Many Godavari homes serve it tomorrow, when the tastes have settled.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. सरायआव लोरसोरै गुरैयै फिन गुदुं खालाम.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Cover the extra, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat again gently in a pan without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: चेपला पुलुसुनि थाखाय बबे नाआ खोब मोजां?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: गोसो दानजानाय गोरा दैमानि एबा लैथोनि ना: रोहु (बोचा), सौल ना (कोरामीनु), कातला एबा सुरमाइ. गोबां बेगेर गोनां फिसा नाफोरबो जायो, नाथाय गुरैयै बाहायनांगौ.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Thick-cut firm river or sea fish: rohu (bocha), saul fish (korameenu), katla or surmai. Small fish with many bones also work, but must be used carefully.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपला पुलुसुनि सोवादआ गाबोनआव मानो बांसिन मोजां जायो?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste better tomorrow?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: थादनो होनायआ नाखौ तेंतेलि आरो बानलुनि झोल हाबनो सम होयो, आरो खाखि आरो गुदुंआ समान जायो. बेनिखायनो गोबां न'आ बेखौ हरनि जानायनि थाखाय फुंआव एबा गाबोननि थाखाय संयो.
seg.566bd302c316.back: Resting gives the fish time to take in the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sour and the heat become equal. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for the night meal or for tomorrow.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: ओंख्रीआव नाखौ बायनायनिफ्राय माबोरै रैखा खालामनो?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: How to protect the fish from breaking in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: मोटा दुकुरा बाहाय, झोलआ फुदुंनायनि उनावसो दोन, अरखौ गुरै दोन आरो सामुसजों लोरसोरनायनि सोलायाव सरायखौ गिदिं.
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Use thick pieces, add them only after the gravy boils, keep the fire low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: मोटामुटि 40 g, नेमु महरनि मोनसे गुटि, 2 कप गुदुं दैआव हुबनाय. टोमाटो एबा मिनिया आम दोनोब्ला इसे खमाय बाहाय.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, one ball the size of a lemon, soaked in 2 cups hot water. If you add tomato or unripe mango use a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: చేపల పులుసు · आन्ध्रनि नानि ओंख्रीनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Recipe method of Andhra's fish curry | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. गोदावरीनि आदबनि नानि ओंख्री: सामब्राम गोजा, जोंनि हालदै आरो सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैजों खाखि तेंतेलिनि झोलआव गुरै अराव फुदुंनाय ना. 4 मानसिनि थाखाय, खामानि बाथ्रा आरो सोंनायफोरजों.
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Fish curry of the Godavari style: fish boiled on low flame in a sour tamarind gravy with onion, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and questions.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: आन्ध्र चेपला पुलुसु (आन्ध्रनि तेंतेलि नानि ओंख्री) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra's tamarind fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आन्ध्र चेपला पुलुसु: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.2aa804fbf5dd.t: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै 540 g नि पेक
seg.2aa804fbf5dd.back: Pack of Sannam chilli powder 540 g

seg.a6f8caae0640.back: Gongura Mamsam ⟦1⟧(goat meat with gongura leaves)⟦/1⟧

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगुरा मामसम आ गोंगुराजों संनाय बरमा बेदोर, गोंगुरा आ खाखि बिलाइ, जायखौ आन्ध्रआ, आरो गासैनिख्रुइ गुन्टुरआ, गावनि बुङो. बरमा बेदोरखौ बानलु आरो हालदैजों गुदुर जानो सिम संनानै, बेनि उनाव खोमसि, खाखि पेस्ट जानो सिम सावनाय गोंगुराजों, ओंख्रीआ गाढा जानो आरो थाउआ सायाव उदोंनो सिम गुरै अराव फुदुंयो.
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour gongura leaf, which Andhra, and above all Guntur, calls its own. The mutton is cooked with chilli and turmeric until soft, then with gongura fried until it becomes a dark, sour paste, simmered on low fire until the curry is thick and oil rises on top.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगुरानि गोख्रों खाखिखौ सहायनो गोहो गुदुं नांगौ, आरो बेयो जोंनि तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, गुन्टुरनि जोबोद गुदुं बानलुनिफ्राय फैयो, लोगोसे जोंनि हालदै गुन्दै. ओंखामजों 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To stand up to gongura's strong sourness a deep heat is needed, and it comes from our Teja chilli powder, from Guntur's very hot chillies, together with our turmeric powder. With rice for 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: बरमा बेदोरखौ तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै आरो हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्टजों प्रेसार कुकारआव सं, बेनि उनाव सामब्राम गोजानि मसला आरो सावनाय गोंगुरा बिलाइजों गाढा जानो आरो थाउआ सायाव बुहुनो सिम गुरै अराव फुदुं.
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer on low fire with red onion masala and fried gongura leaves until thick and oil comes out on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g बरमा बेदोर ⟦1⟧बेगेर थानाय ओंख्रीनि थाखाय दानजानाय, सुनानै दै बोहैनो होनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g goat meat ⟦1⟧bone-in, cut for curry, washed and water drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा बिलाइ ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 2 मुथा (150 g), बिफांनिफ्राय सिफायनाय, सुनानै दैखौ मोजांङै बोहैनो होनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and water drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 गेदेर सामुस थाउ ⟦1⟧सरासनस्रायै चिनाबादामनि थाउ बाहायो⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.back: 4 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: बरमा बेदोरखौ तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै, हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट आरो संख्रिजों प्रेसार कुकारआव दोन, मोजांङै गलाय आरो 15 मिनिट थादनो हो.
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the goat meat in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix (melt) well and let it rest 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: बरमा बेदोरखौ तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै, हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट, संख्रि आरो दैजों प्रेसार कुकारआव सं. 1½ कप दै दोन आरो माजारि अराव 5–6 सिटि जानो सिम सं, बेनि उनाव प्रेसारखौ गावनो गावनो खमायनो हो.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the goat meat in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and cook on medium flame until 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure come down by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकारखौ खेव आरो मोनसे दुकुरा नाय: बरमा बेदोरआ गुदुर जायोब्ला आरो सामुसजों बेगेरनिफ्राय अंखाबै बारखांयोब्ला संजाबाय. नङाब्ला, गुबुन 1–2 सिटि जानो सिम सं.
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check one piece: the goat meat is cooked when it is soft and comes away easily from the bone with a spoon. Otherwise, cook until 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: बरमा बेदोरआ संनाय समाव, मोनसे सरायआव माजारि अराव 1 गेदेर सामुस थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the goat meat is cooking, heat 1 tablespoon oil on medium flame in a pan.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगुराखौ सोमखोर बानलुजों इसे थाउआव खोमसि पेस्ट जानो सिम साव. बेयो 8–10 मिनिट लायो; खन खन लोरसोर आरो बिलाइफोरा गुसुर जायोब्ला सामुसनि उनथिंजों निसि.
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with the green chillies in a little oil until a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir now and then and when the leaves become wilted mash them with the back of the spoon.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: मोनसे गोरोंथि कराइआव माजारि अराव 4 गेदेर सामुस थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम आरो लोंग, एलाची आरो दालचिनि दोन.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil on medium flame in a heavy kadai and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: सामब्राम गोजाखौ आबुं मसलाजों सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव. सामब्राम गोजाजों लोगोसे करि बिलाइ दोन, आरो खन खन लोरसोरनानै 10–12 मिनिट हो.
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onion with the whole masala until golden colour. Add curry leaves together with the onion, and give it 10–12 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धनिया गुन्दै दोननानै लोरसोर आरो 30 सेकेन्ड साव. बरमा बेदोर आरो बेनि झोल दोन, बेनि उनाव गोंगुरा.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds. Add the goat meat and its juice, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: गाढा जानो आरो थाउआ सायाव बुहुनो सिम गुरै अराव फुदुं. अरखौ गुरै दोन, खन खन लोरसोर, आरो 12–15 मिनिट हो. गोंगुरानि खाखिआ हाबनायनि उनाव दानोसो सोवाद नाय आरो संख्रि नायनानै दोन.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Simmer on low fire until thick and oil comes out on top. Keep the fire low, stir occasionally, and give it 12–15 minutes. Only after the gongura's sourness has soaked in, taste and check the salt and add.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम मसला दोननानै लोरसोर. गुबुन 2 मिनिट सं, बेनि उनाव अरखौ थाद' आरो जानो होनायनि सिगां 10 मिनिट थादनो हो.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Add garam masala and stir. Cook 2 more minutes, then stop the flame and let it rest 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगुरा दोननायनि उनाव सोवाद नाय; बेनि खाखिआ मुथा मुथायाव गुबुन गुबुन जायो.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding the gongura; its sourness is different from bunch to bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ जोबोद गुदुं. माजारि गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस बाहाय, एबा सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै; बेखौ आबुं बोखार दिनो नङा, नङाब्ला गोंगुराआ सोवाद गैयै आरो खाखि मोनो.
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not throw it out fully, otherwise the gongura tastes tasteless and sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगुरानि थाखाय एलुमिनियामनि सराय बाहायनो नङा; बेनि खाखिआ धातुजों गलायो आरो ओंख्रीखौ खोमसि खालामो. स्टिल एबा लोहानि सराय बाहाय.
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness melts with the metal and makes the curry dark. Use a steel or iron pan.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: गोंगुराआ जोबोद खाखि जायोब्ला, समान खालामनो मसलायाव गुबुन 1 सामब्राम गोजा दोन.
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to make it equal.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगुरा दाव बेदोर: 750 g बेगेर थानाय दाव बेदोर बाहाय, प्रेसार कुकार बाहायनो नङा आरो गोंगुरा दोननायनि सिगां, बेगेरनि खाथियाव गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जानो सिम मसलायाव खुबुमनानै 20–25 मिनिट सं.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken meat, do not use the pressure cooker, and before adding gongura cook covered in the masala 20–25 minutes until there is not a single pink colour near the bone.
