seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: 500 g साफ खालामनाय इचा ना बाहाय, सामब्राम गोजानि उनाव दोन आरो गोलाबि जानो आरो बेंखेनो सिमसो 5–6 मिनिट सं, बेनि उनाव गोंगुरा दोन.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onion and cook 5–6 minutes only until they become pink and curl, then add the gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: गोजा बानलुनि गोंगुरा: बांसिन खोमसि आरो गोख्रों ओंख्रीनि थाखाय 6 गोरान गोजा बानलुखौ गोंगुराजों साव आरो लोगोसे गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red-chilli gongura: for a darker and stronger curry fry 6 dry red chillies with the gongura and grind together.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: भाप गोनां ओंखाम आरो सामुस मोनसे घिजों, एबा जोन्ना रोट्टेजों गुदुंयै जानो हो. सेराव संजायि सामब्राम गोजा मोनसे दोननाया गुन्टुरनि आदब.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and one spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. Adding one raw onion at the side is the Guntur way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव 3 सान सिम लाखि; गेजेर सिम भाप ओंखारनो सिम गुदुं खालाम. गोबां खाखि ओंख्रीनि बादि, गाबोनआव बेनि सोवादआ बांसिन मोजां जायो.
seg.a4e072616940.back: Cover and keep in the fridge up to 3 days; heat until steam comes out through to the middle. Like many sour curries, its taste is better tomorrow.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगुरा आ सरेल बिलाइ, जायखौ रोजेल एबा रेड सरेल बुङो (मराठियाव अम्बाडी, हिन्दीयाव पितवा). बिलाइफोरा खाखि आरो संनायाव खोमसि पेस्ट जायो.
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is sorrel leaf, called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and become a dark paste in cooking.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: गोंगुरा बिलाइनि सोलायाव गोंगुरानि आसार बाहायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can gongura pickle be used instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: हागौ, गोनांथि जायोब्ला. सावनाय बिलाइनि सोलायाव 3–4 गेदेर सामुस गोंगुरा आसार दोननानै लोरसोर आरो संख्रि आरो बानलु गुन्दै खमाय, मानोना आसाराव मोननैबो दङ्गासिनो.
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, if needed. Instead of the fried leaves stir in 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce the salt and chilli powder, because the pickle contains both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगुरा मामसमनि थाखाय बरमा बेदोरखौ प्रेसार कुकारआव माखाव समाव संनांगौ?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long should the goat meat be cooked in the pressure cooker for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: बेगेर थानाय ओंख्रीनि दुकुरा बरमा बेदोरनि थाखाय माजारि अराव मोटामुटि 5–6 सिटि. बेदोरआ बेगेरनिफ्राय अंखाबै बारखांयोब्ला संजाबाय; बुरै जानाय बरमानि बेदोरनि थाखाय गुबुन 1–2 सिटि नांनो हागौ.
seg.5888ba63831a.back: About 5–6 whistles on medium flame for bone-in curry-cut goat meat. The meat is cooked when it comes away easily from the bone; for old goat meat 1–2 more whistles may be needed.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: गोंगुरा मटनखौ माबोरै खमाय गुदुं खालामनो?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय एबा सोलायनानै सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय, आरो 2 सोमखोर बानलु बाहाय. इसे गुदुं थादनो हो, मानोना बेयो गोंगुरानि खाखिखौ समान खालामो.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or instead use Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Leave a little heat, because it makes the gongura's sourness equal.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. गुन्टुरनि आदबै गोंगुरा मटन: तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो हालदै गुन्दैजों संनाय बरमा बेदोर, बेनि उनाव गाढा जानो सिम खाखि सरेल बिलाइजों गुरै अराव फुदुंनाय.
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Guntur-style gongura mutton: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered on low fire with sour sorrel leaves until thick.

seg.ba26416f3fd1.back: Gongura Mamsam (goat meat with gongura leaves) · 1acrefarms

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगुरा मामसम: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी आ आन्ध्रनि खोब मुंदांखा चाटनि: खाखि गोंगुरा (सरेल) बिलाइखौ थाउआव सावनानै सावनाय मसला, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो गोजा बानलुजों गुन्दै खालामनाय. गुन्टुर आरो पलनाडुआव बेयो मोटामुटि सानफ्रोमबो जानायाव थायो, सामुस मोनसे घिजों गुदुं ओंखामआव गलायनानै, सेराव दानजानाय सामब्राम गोजाजों.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is Andhra's most famous chutney: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried in oil and ground with fried masala, garlic and red chilli. In Guntur and Palnadu it is at almost every day's meal, mixed into hot rice with one spoon of ghee, with cut onion at the side.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ बेखौ गोहो गोजा रं आरो बिलाइनि खाखिखौ सहायनो हानाय गोख्रों गुदुं होयो. बे संनाय आदबआव मोटामुटि 1½ कप जायो, 6 मानसिनि थाखाय गोनां.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a strong heat that can stand up to the leaf's sourness. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: गासैआव गुन्दै खालामनायनि सिगां बिलाइ आरो मसलाखौ गुसुनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.1689d390a49e.back: Letting the leaves and masala cool before grinding is included in the total.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगुरा बिलाइखौ खोमसि निसिनाय जानो सिम थाउआव साव, बेनि उनाव सावनाय धनिया, मेथि, सामब्राम गुफुर, तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों गुन्दै खालाम. बेसोर आरो दालनि फोरनजों जोबनो हो.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry the gongura leaves in oil until dark and mashed, then grind with fried coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a tempering of mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा बिलाइ ⟦1⟧2 गेदेर मुथानिफ्राय सिफायनाय, मोटामुटि 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 big bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 गेदेर सामुस सिबिं थाउ ⟦1⟧तिलनि थाउ, बिलाइ सावनो⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧til oil, to fry the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ फिसा सामुस मेथि ⟦1⟧मेन्थुलु; बेनिख्रुइ बांसिन नङा, नङाब्ला पच्चडीआ गोखा जायो⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧जोबोद गुदुं; गुरै पच्चडीनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस बाहाय⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a mild pachadi use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.7e344ce94138.t: ¾ फिसा सामुस संख्रि ⟦1⟧एबा सोवाद नायनानै⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगुरा बिलाइफोरखौ बिफांनिफ्राय सिफाय आरो 2–3 मोन दै सोलायनानै सु. बेफोरखौ मोनसे सिआव फारा आरो आबुं गोरान जानो सिम मोजांङै मोसो; बिलाइयाव थानाय दैआ थाउआव फुटियो आरो पच्चडीआ गोलाव समाय थानायखौ खमायो.
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pick the gongura leaves from the stems and wash, changing the water 2–3 times. Spread them on a cloth and dry well until fully dry; water in the leaves splutters in the oil and reduces how long the pachadi keeps.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धनिया, जिरा आरो मेथिखौ मुसुं होनो सिम साव; गुसुनो हो. गोरान सरायखौ गुरै अराव बाहाय आरो सारासे लोरसोर: मेथिआ मोटामुटि 2 मिनिटआव इसे खोमसि जानांगौ, नाथाय बादामि नङा.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Fry the coriander, cumin and fenugreek until they give smell; let cool. Use a dry pan on low flame and stir all the time: the fenugreek should become a little dark in about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगुरा बिलाइखौ 1 गेदेर सामुस थाउआव गुसुर जानानै खोमसि निसिनाय जानो सिम साव, 6–8 मिनिट. माजारि अराव मोनसे गुवार सराय बाहाय आरो खन खन लोरसोर; बिलाइफोरा गोख्रोंयै फिसा जायो, सोमखोरनिफ्राय सिखों जलपाइ-बादामि रं जायो, आरो बेफोरनि मोटामुटि गासै दैआ संनायाव गोमायो.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil until wilted and dark mashed, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium flame and stir now and then; the leaves become small quickly, turn from green to a deep olive-brown colour, and almost all their water is lost in the cooking.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: बिलाइफोरखौ मोनसे थालियाव फारा आरो आबुं गुसुनो सिम थादनो हो, मोटामुटि 10 मिनिट.
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool fully, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसलाखौ सामब्राम गुफुर, बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों गुन्दै खालाम, बेनि उनाव बिलाइफोर दोननानै फिसा फिसा गिदिं. गिबियाव सावनाय मसला, 6 सामब्राम गुफुरनि खोंसे, तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रिखौ खरखरै गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the masala with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse little by little. First grind the fried masala, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt coarsely.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: गुसुनाय बिलाइफोर दोन आरो दै गैयै 3–4 मोन फिसा फिसा गिदिंनानै खरखरा पेस्ट खालाम. आन्ध्रनि गोबां न'आ बेनि सोलायाव बेखौ अन्थाइनि उरुनआव (रोलु) सेबो.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and without water pulse little by little 3–4 times to make a coarse paste. Many Andhra homes instead pound it in a stone mortar (rolu).

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: सोवाद नाय: बेयो खाखि, गुदुं आरो मोजां संख्रि गोनां जानांगौ. खाखिआ जोबोद गोख्रों मोनोब्ला इसे बांसिन संख्रि दोन.
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness feels very strong add a little more salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: बेसोर, दाल, गोजा बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ बांसिन थाउआव फोरन हो; बेखौ गलाय. फिसा सरायआव 2 गेदेर सामुस सिबिं थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम, बेसोरखौ फट फट जानो हो, बुट दाल आरो उरद दालखौ सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव, बेनि उनाव गोजा बानलु, सेबनाय सामब्राम गुफुर, करि बिलाइ आरो हिंगखौ सेकेन्ड खायसेनि थाखाय दोन. बेखौ पच्चडीनि सायाव फोनां आरो मोजांङै लोरसोर.
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: Temper the mustard, dal, red chilli and curry leaves in the remaining oil; mix it in. In a small pan heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil, let the mustard crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal until golden colour, then add red chilli, crushed garlic, curry leaves and hing for a few seconds. Pour it on top of the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: हायोब्ला पच्चडीखौ 30 मिनिट थादनो हो, अब्ला सोवादफोरा गोरोबो, बेनि उनाव सामुसजों मोनसे साफ, गोरान काँचनि जारआव दोन.
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible let the pachadi rest 30 minutes so the tastes mix, then put it with a spoon into a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: सावनायनि सिगां बिलाइफोरखौ आबुं गोरान खालाम, अब्ला पच्चडीआ गोलाव समाय थागोन.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Make the leaves fully dry before frying, then the pachadi will keep a long time.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ जोबोद गुदुं. गुरै पच्चडीनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस बाहाय, एबा खावसे तेजा आरो खावसे सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै.
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a mild pachadi use 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथिखौ ¼ फिसा सामुसआव थादनो हो आरो बेखौ इसेल' खोमसि जानो सिम साव; बांसिन, एबा बांसिन खोमसि, पच्चडीखौ गोखा खालामो.
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep the fenugreek at ¼ teaspoon and fry it only until a little dark; more, or more dark, makes the pachadi bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: फिसा फिसा गिदिं, मिहि गुन्दै खालामनो नङा: गोंगुरा पच्चडीआ खरखरा जानांगौ, नुनो हानाय बिलाइनि दुकुराजों.
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse little by little, do not grind fine: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with leaf pieces that can be seen.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: थाउ खमाय होनो नङा; सायाव थानाय थाउनि फान्दाआ पच्चडीखौ गोलाव समाय थानायाव मदद होयो.
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not reduce the oil; the oil layer on top helps the pachadi keep a long time.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: सामब्राम गोजाजों: जानो होनायनि सिगांसो बाहागो मोनसेआव मिहि खावनाय 1 फिसा सामब्राम गोजा दोननानै लोरसोर, आरो बेखौ बेनो सानाव जा.
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: only just before serving stir 1 small finely chopped onion into one portion, and eat it that same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: आबुं गोजा बानलु: बानलु गुन्दैनि सोलायाव 12–15 गोरान गोजा बानलुखौ इसे थाउआव साव आरो मसलाजों गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chilli: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dry red chillies in a little oil and grind with the masala.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: सोमखोर बानलुनि गोंगुरा: बांसिन गोख्रों, सोमखोर बानलुनि गुदुंनि थाखाय 6–8 सोमखोर बानलुखौ बिलाइजों साव आरो बानलु गुन्दैखौ 1 फिसा सामुस सिम खमाय.
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green-chilli gongura: for a stronger green-chilli heat fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce the chilli powder to 1 teaspoon.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: सामुस मोनसेखौ घिजों गुदुं ओंखामआव गलाय आरो सेराव दानजानाय संजायि सामब्राम गोजाजों जा. बेयो दोसा, इडलि आरो आन्ध्रनि जायखिजाय जानाय थालिनि सेराव मोजां जायो.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix one spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with raw onion cut at the side. It is also good at the side of dosa, idli and any Andhra meal thali.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: बेखौ मोनसे साफ, गोरान काँचनि जारआव फ्रिजआव 2 सप्ताह सिम लाखि, सारासे गोरान सामुस बाहायनानै. सायाव थानाय पातला थाउनि फान्दाआ बेखौ गोलाव समाय थानायाव मदद होयो.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. The thin oil layer on top helps it keep a long time.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगुरा आ रोजेल बिफांनि बिलाइ, जायखौ सरासनस्रायै सरेल बिलाइ एबा रेड सरेल महरै फानो. हिन्दी आरो मराठी रावखौ बुंग्रा हादरफोराव बेखौ अम्बाडी बुङो.
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, usually known as sorrel leaf or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking regions it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडीखौ माबोरै खमाय खाखि खालामनो?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: इसे बांसिन संख्रि आरो बानलु दोन, एबा 1 फिसा सामुस रुखुनाय गुर दोननानै लोरसोर. बिलाइफोरखौ मोजांङै सावनायाबो बेफोरनि खाखिखौ गुरै खालामो.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves well also makes their sourness mild.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: सरासनस्रायै जोबोद बांसिन मेथि, एबा मेथिखौ जोबोद खोमसि जानो सिम सावनायनि जाहोनाव. बेखौ ¼ फिसा सामुसआव थादनो हो आरो इसेल' खोमसि जायोब्लानो सावनायखौ थाद'.
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually because of too much fenugreek, or frying the fenugreek until very dark. Keep it at ¼ teaspoon and stop frying as soon as it is a little dark.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How long does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: फ्रिजआव गोरान काँचनि जारआव मोटामुटि 2 सप्ताह, बिलाइफोरखौ मोजांङै गोरान खालामनाय जायोब्ला आरो नों सारासे गोरान सामुस बाहायोब्ला. फ्रिजनि बाहिरआव, 2–3 साननि सिङाव जा.
seg.693b158b80df.back: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat within 2–3 days.

seg.2202d49bd92b.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి · गोंगुरा पच्चडीनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.2202d49bd92b.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి · Recipe method of Gongura Pachadi | 1acrefarms

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. गुन्टुरनि आदबै गोंगुरा पच्चडी: सावनाय सरेल बिलाइ, सावनाय मसला, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो तेजा बानलु गुन्दैजों गुन्दै खालामनानै, बेनि उनाव फोरन होनाय. 6 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi in the Guntur way: fried sorrel leaves, fried masala, garlic and Teja chilli powder ground, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(तेंतेलिनि झोलआव आन्ध्रनि दाउदैनि ओंख्री)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु आ आन्ध्रनि दाउदैनि ओंख्री, जायखौ गोबां न'आ न'आव बेदोर गैयाब्ला बानायो: फुदुंनानै गोरा खालामनाय दाउदैखौ तेंतेलि आरो गुरैयै सावनाय सामब्राम गोजानि खाखि झोलआव गुरै अराव फुदुंनाय. बेयो सा भारतनि दाउदैनि ओंख्रीनिख्रुइ बांसिन पातला आरो बांसिन खाखि, गोबां गुदुं ओंखामजों गलायनानै जानो बानायनाय.
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is Andhra's egg curry, made in many homes when there is no meat: eggs boiled hard, boiled on low flame in a sour gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onion. It is thinner and more sour than north India's egg curries, made to mix and eat with plenty of hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: जोंनि सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ पुलुसुखौ गोजा रं आरो थिर माजारि गुदुं होयो, आरो जोंनि हालदै गुन्दै (पसुपु) आ सोनानि गाबनि बिथा होयो. इसे गुरआ खाखिखौ समान खालामो.
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden-colour glow. A little jaggery makes the sourness equal.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: दाउदैखौ फुदुं आरो बेफोरआव इसेल' दान. सामब्राम गोजा साव, हालदै, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै आरो तेंतेलिनि दै दोन, गुरै अराव फुदुं, बेनि उनाव झोलआ गाढा जानो सिम दाउदैखौ झोलआव सं.
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and make small cuts [इसेल' दान: lit. 'cut a little'; or light slits; number not stated] on them. Fry red onion [सामब्राम गोजा: or red chilli?], add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder [सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै: सन्नम read as the name 'Sannam' (or 'fine'?); बानलु read as chilli] and tamarind water [the commas could also read: fry the red onion/chilli, turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, then add tamarind water], boil on a low flame, then cook the eggs in the gravy until the gravy becomes thick.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: a little turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (if you like)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g तेंतेलि ⟦1⟧नेमु महरनि मोनसे गुटि, 1½ कप गुदुं दैआव हुबनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧one ball the size of a lemon, soaked in 1½ cups hot water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस थाउ ⟦1⟧चिनाबादाम एबा सिबिं थाउ⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 फिसा सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧माजारि गुदुं; गुरैनि थाखाय 1½ फिसा सामुस बाहाय⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for mild use 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: तेंतेलिखौ गुदुं दैआव 15 मिनिट हुब. बेखौ मोजांङै सिप, सेखा आरो तेंतेलिनि दैखौ लाखि; सुता आरो बिजिफोरखौ बोखार.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in hot water 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: दाउदैखौ 10 मिनिट फुदुं, बिगुर एखेर आरो मोनफ्रोमबोआव 3–4 इसेल' दान. बेफोरखौ न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिनि दैआव जागाय, फुदुंनायनिफ्राय 10 मिनिट सान, बेनि उनाव बिगुर एखेरनायनि सिगां दैआव गुसुनो हो. गोमो बाहागोआ गेजेर सिम गोरा आरो फिका गोमो जानांगौ.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel the shell and make 3–4 shallow cuts in each. Start them in room-temperature water, 10 minutes from boiling, then let them cool in water before peeling. The yellow part should be firm to the centre and pale yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: मोजां मोनोब्ला: 1 फिसा सामुस थाउखौ इसे हालदैजों गुदुं खालाम आरो दाउदैफोरखौ बेयाव 2 मिनिट इसे फुदुं फुदुं जानो सिम गिदिं. सेराव लाखि.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: If you like: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a little turmeric and toss the eggs in it for 2 minutes until a little blistered. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: बांसिन थाउखौ मोनसे कराइआव माजारि अराव गुदुं खालाम. मेथि दोन आरो इसे बादामि जानो हो; खोमसि जायोब्ला बेफोरा गोखा जायो.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil on medium flame in a kadai. Add fenugreek and let it become a little brown; if it becomes dark they become bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: बेसोर, करि बिलाइ आरो सामब्राम गोजाखौ थाउआव गुदुर आरो सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव. गिबियाव बेसोर दोन आरो फुटिनो हो, बेनि उनाव करि बिलाइ, सोमखोर बानलु आरो हिंग, बेनि उनाव सामब्राम गोजाखौ मोटामुटि 8 मिनिट.
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onion in the oil until soft and golden colour. First add mustard and let it splutter, then curry leaves, green chilli and hing, then the onion about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: अरखौ गुरै खालाम. हालदै, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रि दोन, बेनि उनाव तेंतेलिनि दै; 10 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं. धनिया गुन्दैखौ बानलु गुन्दैजों लोगोसे दोननानै लोरसोर, अब्ला बेयो गिबियाव सेकेन्ड खायसे सावगोन.
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Make the flame low. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; boil on low flame 10 minutes. Add coriander powder together with the chilli powder and stir, so it fries a few seconds first.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: तेंतेलिनि संजायि मुसुंआ थांनांगौ आरो झोलआ जोंजों नुजाथिनांगौ. बेयो जोबोद गोख्रोंयै गाढा जायोब्ला ½ कप दै दोन.
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of tamarind should go and the gravy should look glossy. If it becomes too thick, add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: दाउदैफोरखौ गुरैयै हाबहो आरो झोलआ गाढा जानो सिम गुबुन 5 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं. खन खन दाउदैनि सायाव सामुसजों झोल फोनां.
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Let the eggs soak in gently and simmer on low fire another 5 minutes until the gravy is thick. Occasionally spoon gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: गुर दोननानै लोरसोर, सोवाद नाय आरो संख्रि एबा खाखिखौ समान खालाम, आरो धनिया बिलाइ सिखार.
seg.299781c49104.back: Add jaggery and stir, taste and make the salt or sourness equal, and sprinkle coriander leaves.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: अरखौ थाद' आरो जानो होनायनि सिगां पुलुसुखौ 10 मिनिट थादनो हो, अब्ला दाउदैफोरा झोलनि सोवाद लागोन.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Stop the flame and let the pulusu rest 10 minutes before serving, so the eggs take the taste of the gravy.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: दाननाय जायगाफोरा खाखि झोलखौ दाउदैनि गेजेराव हाबहोयो.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: The cut places let the sour gravy go into the middle of the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: फुदुंनाय दाउदैखौ बिगुर एखेरनायनि सिगां दैआव गुसुनो हो; बिगुरफोरा साफै ओंखारो.
seg.98394356bb39.back: Let the boiled eggs cool in water before peeling the shell; the shells come off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ माजारि गुदुं होयो; बांसिन गुदुं पुलुसुनि थाखाय बेजों लोगोसे ½ फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै दोन.
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder together with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: पुलुसुखौ थादनो होब्ला सोवादआ बांसिन मोजां जायो, आरो गाबोनआव बांसिनसिन, मानोना दाउदैफोरा तेंतेलिखौ हाबनानै लायो.
seg.fc1643db807e.back: If the pulusu is left to rest the taste becomes better, and tomorrow even more, because the eggs take in the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: टोमाटो: बांसिन गुदुर, खमाय खाखि झोलनि थाखाय सामब्राम गोजानि उनाव 1 खावनाय टोमाटो दोन.
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a softer, less sour gravy add 1 chopped tomato after the onion.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: सिबिं: गाढा, बादाम बादि सोवाद गोनां झोलनि थाखाय जोबथा 5 मिनिटआव 1 गेदेर सामुस सावनाय सिबिं गुन्दै दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thick, nutty-tasting gravy, add 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes and stir.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाया: गुदुं बोथोराव, तेंतेलिनि खावसेनि सोलायाव झोलआव संनाय मिनिया आमनि दुकुरा खायसे बाहाय.
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in the hot season, instead of half the tamarind use a few unripe mango pieces cooked in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: भाप गोनां ओंखाम आरो सामुस मोनसे घिजों, सेराव खरखरा भाजा एबा अप्पडालुजों गुदुंयै जानो हो. बेयो चापाति एबा दोसाजोंबो जायो.
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and one spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu at the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. पुलुसुखौ मोनसे सरायआव इसे दैजों गुरैयै गुदुं खालाम.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Cover the extra, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu gently in a pan with a little water.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: दाउदैनि ओंख्रीनि थाखाय दाउदैखौ माखाव समाव फुदुंनांगौ?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long should eggs be boiled for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: दैआ फुदुंनायनि समनिफ्राय मोटामुटि 10 मिनिट. दाउदैफोरखौ झोलआव दोननायनि सिगां गोमो बाहागोआ गेजेर सिम गोरा आरो फिका गोमो जानांगौ, गेजेराव दै बादि बोहैनाय गैयै.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. Before adding the eggs to the gravy, the yellow part should be firm to the centre and pale yellow, with nothing flowing like water in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why cut the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: इसेल' दाननाया तेंतेलिनि झोलखौ दाउदैनि गुफुर बाहागोआव हाबहोयो. बेफोर गैयाब्ला झोलआ सायावल' थायो आरो दाउदैआ सोवाद गैयै मोनो.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: The small cuts let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg's white part. Without them the gravy stays only on top and the egg feels tasteless.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: बेखौ गुबुन मिनिट खायसे गुरै अराव फुदुं, मोनसे फिसा सामुस रुखुनाय गुर दोन, एबा इसे दै दोननानै लोरसोर. गुबुन समाव तेंतेलिनि फिसा गुटि बाहाय.
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Boil it a few more minutes on low flame, add one small spoon grated jaggery, or add a little water and stir. Next time use a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: दाउदैनि पुलुसु आरो दाउदैनि ओंख्रीनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु आ ओंखामजों गलायनो बानायनाय पातला, खाखि तेंतेलिनि झोल. सरासनस्राय दाउदैनि ओंख्रीआ सामब्राम गोजा आरो टोमाटोनि सायाव बानायो, तेंतेलि गैयै आरो गाढा मसलाजों.
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy made for mixing with rice. The usual egg curry is made on a base of red onion and tomato, without tamarind and with thick masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · दाउदैनि पुलुसुनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Recipe method of egg pulusu | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु, आन्ध्रनि दाउदैनि ओंख्री: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै आरो हालदैजों रं होनाय खाखि तेंतेलि-सामब्राम गोजानि झोलआव गुरै अराव फुदुंनाय फुदुंनाय दाउदै. 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra's egg curry: boiled eggs boiled on low flame in a sour tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु (तेंतेलिनि झोलआव आन्ध्रनि दाउदैनि ओंख्री) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra's egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.583485fac40c.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रनि मसला हाबनाय फान्थावनि ओंख्री)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra's masala-stuffed brinjal curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा आ मसला हाबनाय फान्थावनि ओंख्री, जायखौ आन्ध्रनि न'फोरा रबिबारनि सान गेजेरनि जानाय, हाबा आरो आलासिफोर फैयोब्ला बानायो. फिसा, गुलुम गुलुम, बेंगुनि रंनि फान्थावफोरखौ दाननानै, सावनाय चिनाबादाम, सिबिं आरो नारिकलनि मसला हाबहोनानै, गुदुर जानो आरो मसलाआ बेफोराव गोबाखांनो सिम थाउआव गुरैयै संनाय.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya kura is the masala-stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for the Sunday midday meal and when relatives and guests come. Small, round, purple-colour brinjals are cut, stuffed with a masala of fried groundnut, sesame and coconut, and cooked slowly in oil until soft and the masala sticks onto them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: जोंनि सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ हाबहोनाय मसलाखौ गोजा रं आरो माजारि गुदुं होयो, आरो हालदै गुन्दैआ बेखौ जोबनो होयो. बेखौ गुदुं ओंखाम एबा चापातिजों जानो हो. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffed masala red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder finishes it. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: चिनाबादाम, सिबिं, गोरान नारिकल आरो धनियानि बिजिखौ साव, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों गुन्दै खालाम, फिसा फान्थावफोराव हाबहो आरो गुदुर जानो सिम थाउआव गुरैयै सं.
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Fry groundnut, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seed, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff into small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस चिनाबादाम ⟦1⟧संजायि, बिगुरजों एबा बिगुर गैयै⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnut ⟦1⟧raw, with skin or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 फिसा सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧बांसिन गुदुं ओंख्रीनि थाखाय 1 गेदेर सामुस सिम⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small, round, purple-colour⟦/1⟧

seg.00abde42908e.back: 1 small red onion (if you like) ⟦1⟧finely chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: चिनाबादाम, सिबिं, नारिकल आरो धनियानि बिजिखौ थाउ गैयै साव; मसलाफोरजों गुन्दै खालाम. गिबियाव चिनाबादामखौ माजारि-गुरै अराव 3–4 मिनिट साव, बेनि उनाव धनियानि बिजि, जिरा आरो सिबिं दोननानै 1 मिनिट, आरो नारिकलखौ जोबथा 30 सेकेन्डआव, इसे सोनानि गाब जानो सिम. गुसुनो हो.
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Fry the groundnut, sesame, coconut and coriander seed without oil; grind with the masalas. First fry the groundnut on medium-low flame 3–4 minutes, then add coriander seed, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut in the last 30 seconds, until a little golden colour. Let it cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिक्सिआव सावनाय गासैखौ सामब्राम गुफुर, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै, संख्रि आरो तेंतेलिजों दै गैयै खरखरा गुन्दै खालाम. नेसेब्ला बेयो गुटि जानांगौ.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In the mixie grind all the fried things with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind coarsely without water. When pressed it should become a ball.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: फान्थावफोरखौ सु आरो बिथिंखौ दोननानै सोमखोर टुपिखौ इसे दान.
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and, keeping the stalk, cut the green cap a little.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: मोनफ्रोम फान्थावखौ सिंथारनिफ्राय बिथिं दोननानै क्रस बादि दान, आरो मसला हाबहो. मोटामुटि ब्रै बाहागोनि मोनथाम बाहागो सिम सायाव दान, अब्ला ब्रैबो बाहागोआ सायाव लोगो थायो. दाननायनि उनाव मोनफ्रोमखौ संख्रि दोननाय दैनि बाटियाव दोन, बेनि उनाव दै बोहैनो हो.
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Cut each brinjal from the bottom in a cross, keeping the stalk, and stuff the masala. Cut upward to about three of four parts, so all four parts stay joined at the top. After cutting put each one in a bowl of water with salt added, then drain the water.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: मोनफ्रोम फान्थावआव मोटामुटि 1 गोबां फिसा सामुस मसला नेसे हाबहो. बांसिन मसलाखौ सेराव लाखि.
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 heaped teaspoon of masala into each brinjal. Keep the extra masala at the side.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: मोनसे गुवार, गोरोंथि सरायआव माजारि अराव थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम. बेसोर दोन आरो फुटियोब्ला, करि बिलाइ आरो सामब्राम गोजा, बाहायोब्ला, दोन. सामब्राम गोजाखौ गुदुर जानो सिम साव, मोटामुटि 3 मिनिट.
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat the oil on medium flame in a wide, heavy pan. Add mustard and when it splutters, add curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: मसला हाबनाय फान्थावफोरखौ सरायआव मोनसे सारिआव दोन.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Put the masala-stuffed brinjals in the pan in one row.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: फान्थावफोरखौ गुदुं थाउआव, खुबुमनानै, गुरै अराव सं, 4–5 मिनिट फ्रोमबो गुरैयै बोलाय. मसलाआ हाबनायाव थानो सामुस एबा चिमटा बाहाय, आरो बिगुरफोरा सुरुं जानो सिम 15–18 मिनिट सं.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals in the hot oil, covered, on low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the masala stays stuffed, and cook 15–18 minutes until the skins become wrinkled.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: बांसिन मसलाखौ ½ कप दैजों दोन; फान्थावफोरा गुदुर जानो सिम गुरै अराव फुदुं. खुबुम आरो मसलाआ गाढा जानो आरो सेरफोराव थाउ नुनो सिम गुरै अराव गुबुन 8–10 मिनिट सं.
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the remaining masala with ½ cup water; simmer on low fire until the brinjals are soft. Covered, cook on low fire another 8–10 minutes until the masala is thick and oil is seen at the sides.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: संजाबाय नामा नाय: खोब मोटा फान्थावनि गेजेरजों छुरिआ हेंथा गैयै थांनांगौ. धनिया बिलाइ सिखार आरो अरखौ थाद'.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check if cooked: the knife should go without obstruction through the middle of the thickest brinjal. Sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the fire.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: बिथिंफोरखौ दोन, अब्ला संनाय आरो बोलायनाय समाव फान्थावफोरा लोगो थायो.
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Keep the stalks, so the brinjals stay joined while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: समान महरनि फिसा, जोंजों फान्थाव सायख', अब्ला बेफोरा समानै संजायो; गेदेरफोरा गेजेराव गोरा थायो.
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small brinjals of the same size, smooth, so they cook evenly; big ones stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: चिनाबादाम आरो सिबिंखौ माजारि-गुरै अराव साव; सावखांनाय सिबिंआ गासै मसलाखौ गोखा खालामो.
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Fry the groundnut and sesame on medium-low flame; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: गुरै ओंख्रीनि थाखाय 1½ फिसा सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय; बांसिन गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 गेदेर सामुस सिम बाहाय.
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a mild curry use 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat use up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: सामब्राम गोजानि मसलाजों: बांसिन गुदुर, इसे गोदै झोलनि थाखाय मसलायाव 1 फिसा सामब्राम गोजा गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer, a little sweet gravy grind 1 small onion into the masala.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: नारिकल गैयै: नारिकलखौ बोखार आरो 1 गेदेर सामुस बांसिन चिनाबादाम आरो सिबिं बाहाय.
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: throw out the coconut and use 1 tablespoon more groundnut and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: झोलनि आदब: ओंखामआव गलायनो पातला ओंख्रीनि थाखाय जोबथा आदबआव ½ कपनि सोलायाव 1 कप दै दोन.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy style: for a thin curry to mix with rice add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup in the last step.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: भाप गोनां ओंखाम आरो सामुस मोनसे घिजों, एबा चापाति एबा जोन्ना रोट्टेजों गुदुंयै जानो हो.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and one spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. इसे दैजों गुरैयै गुदुं खालाम.
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Cover, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat gently with a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: गुत्ति वंकायानि थाखाय बबे फान्थावआ खोब मोजां?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjal is best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: दाउदै महरनि फिसा, गुलुम बेंगुनि रंनि फान्थाव, जोंजों बिगुर आरो सोमखोर बिथिंजों. मसलाआ लानाय समनि सिङावनो बेफोरा संजायो आरो मसलाखौ मोजांङै धरा खालामो.
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-size small, round, purple-colour brinjals, with smooth skin and a green stalk. They cook within the time the masala takes and hold the masala well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How to know the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: बिगुरफोरा सुरुं आरो गुदुर जायो, आरो खोब मोटा फान्थावनि गेजेरजों छुरिआ हेंथा गैयै थांयो. संजायि फान्थावफोरा गेजेराव गोरा आरो स्पन्ज बादि मोनो.
seg.c65656faa952.back: The skins become wrinkled and soft, and the knife goes without obstruction through the middle of the thickest brinjal. Raw brinjals feel hard and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: नारिकल गैयै गुत्ति वंकाया बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can gutti vankaya be made without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: हागौ. नारिकलनि सोलायाव 1 गेदेर सामुस बांसिन चिनाबादाम आरो 1 गेदेर सामुस बांसिन सिबिं बाहाय; मसलानि सोवादआ बांसिन बादाम बादि जायो.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut use 1 tablespoon more groundnut and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the masala taste becomes more nut-like.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why did my brinjals break apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: बिथिंखौ बोखारनाय जायो एबा क्रसखौ आबुं सिम दाननाय जायो. बिथिंखौ दोन, सायनिफ्राय मोटामुटि ब्रै बाहागोनि मोनसे बाहागो थानो होनानै दाननायखौ थाद' आरो बेफोरखौ गुरैयै बोलाय.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stalk was thrown out or the cross was cut all the way. Keep the stalk, stop cutting leaving about one of four parts from the top, and turn them gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · गुत्ति वंकाया कूरानि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Recipe method of Gutti Vankaya Kura | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. सावनाय चिनाबादाम, सिबिं आरो नारिकलखौ सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै आरो हालदै गुन्दैजों गुन्दै खालामनानै हाबहोनाय फिसा फान्थाव, बेनि उनाव थाउआव गुरैयै संनाय.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with fried groundnut, sesame and coconut ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked slowly in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा (आन्ध्रनि मसला हाबनाय फान्थावनि ओंख्री) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra's masala-stuffed brinjal curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: गुत्ति वंकाया कूरा: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.5fd655ec9c39.t: साहा जानाय समनि जानाय · 4 मानसिनि थाखाय

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी आ खाजुनि पकौडा, जायखौ आन्ध्रनि मिथायनि दकानफोर आरो न'फोरा साहा जानाय सम, फोरबो आरो आलासिफोरनि थाखाय सावो: आबुं खाजुखौ बेसन आरो मायरंनि गुन्दैनि पातला, मसला गोनां बिगुरआव, खरखरा जानो सिम सावनाय. सामब्राम गोजा गैयै बानायनाय जाहोनाव, बेयो जारआव गोबां सान थायो, बेनिखायनो गोबां न'आ दिवालि आरो संक्रान्तिनि आलासिफोरनि थाखाय मोनसे बिबां सावो.
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is cashew pakora that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coating of besan and rice flour, fried until crisp. Because it is made without onion it keeps many days in a jar, so many homes fry one quantity for Diwali and Sankranti guests.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: जोंनि जीडिपप्पु पेकनि आबुं खाजुफोरा बिगुरनि गेजेराव खरखरा थायो, आरो सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ माजारि गुदुं आरो गुदुं गोजा रं होयो. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews of our Jeedipappu pack stay crisp inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: गासैआव पकोडीखौ गुसुनो आरो खरखरा जानो 5 मिनिट लाफाबाय.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and become crisp is included in the total.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: आबुं खाजुखौ बेसन, मायरंनि गुन्दै, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै, संख्रि आरो सामुस मोनसे गुदुं थाउजों गलाय, बिगुर जानो गोनांसो दै सिखार, आरो सोनानि गाब आरो खरखरा जानो सिम गोबां थाउआव साव.
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix the whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and one spoon hot oil, sprinkle only as much water as needed to make a coating, and fry in plenty of oil until golden colour and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 कप आबुं खाजु ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 150 g; जोबोद गेदेरफोरखौ खावसे बाय⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; break very big ones in halves⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ कप बेसन ⟦1⟧बुट दालनि गुन्दै, मोटामुटि 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧chana dal flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 गेदेर सामुस मायरंनि गुन्दै ⟦1⟧बांसिन खरखरा बिगुरनि थाखाय⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 फिसा सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧माजारि गुदुं; बांसिन गुदुं पकोडीनि थाखाय ½ फिसा सामुस बांसिन दोन⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for a hotter pakodi add ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.40a2a51a64aa.t: ½ फिसा सामुस संख्रि ⟦1⟧एबा सोवाद नायनानै⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 गेदेर सामुस गुदुं थाउ ⟦1⟧सावनाय थाउनिफ्राय लानाय⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: गोबां थाउआव सावनो थाउ ⟦1⟧सरासनस्रायै चिनाबादामनि थाउ बाहायो⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for frying in plenty of oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: खाजुफोरखौ सु आरो दैखौ मोजांङै बोहैनो हो; इसे सेंसेरनाय सायआ गुन्दैखौ गोबाखांनायाव मदद होयो.
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain the water well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: मोनसे कराइआव माजारि अराव सावनायनि थाखाय थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम.
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat the oil for frying on medium flame in a kadai.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: बेसन, मायरंनि गुन्दै, बानलु गुन्दै, संख्रि, हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट आरो करि बिलाइखौ गलाय. मोनसे गुवार बाटि बाहाय, आरो सोमखोर बानलु, धनिया बिलाइ आरो हिंगखौ बेनो समाव दोन.
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chilli, coriander leaves and hing at that same time.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 गेदेर सामुस गुदुं थाउ दोननानै हुर, खाजु दोन आरो गुन्दैआ बेफोरखौ इसे बिगुर जानो सिम दै सिखार. कराइनिफ्राय गुदुं थाउखौ नेनाननै सामुसजों ला आरो गिबियाव आसिनि बिथिंजों गुन्दैआव हुर, बेनि उनाव खाजु दोन आरो दैखौ 1 गेदेर सामुस फ्रोम सिखार, गिदिंनानै, गुन्दैआ मोनफ्रोम खाजुआव गोबाखांनो सिम. गासैआ सेंसेरनाय गुटि बादि नुजाथिनांगौ, पातला दैगुन्दै बादि नङा.
seg.346911fb291b.back: Add 1 tablespoon hot oil and mix, add the cashews and sprinkle water until the flour coats them a little. Carefully take hot oil from the kadai with a spoon and first rub it into the flour with the fingertips, then add the cashews and sprinkle water 1 tablespoon at a time, tossing, until the flour sticks on each cashew. All of it should look like damp lumps, not like a thin batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: थाउखौ नाय: गासैनि इसे दोनोब्ला 2–3 सेकेन्डआव थिर बुरबुरिजों सायाव उदोंनांगौ. बेयो गोख्रोंयै बादामि जायोब्ला, थाउआ जोबोद गुदुं.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Test the oil: when a little of the mix is added it should rise to the top with steady bubbles in 2–3 seconds. If it becomes brown quickly, the oil is very hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: माजारि-गुदुं थाउआव फिसा फिसा गुटि दोन. 3–4 बिगुर गोनां खाजुखौ आसिजों मोनसेथिं ला आरो कराइखौ गोबां बेंखन गैयै थाउआव गुरैयै गोग्लैनो हो.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Add small lumps to the medium-hot oil. Take 3–4 coated cashews together with the fingers and drop them gently into the kadai without crowding the oil.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: बोलायनानै सोनानि गाब आरो खरखरा जानो सिम साव, 5–6 मिनिट; कागजआव थाउ बोहैनो हो. संजाब्ला पकोडीनि खाथियाव बुरबुरिफोरा फिसा जायो आरो गुरै जायो.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Turning, fry until golden colour and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain the oil on paper. When cooked, the bubbles around the pakodi become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: बांसिनखौ समान आदबै बाहागो बाहागो साव, बाहागोफोरनि गेजेराव थाउखौ फिन गुदुं जानो हो.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest in the same way in parts, letting the oil become hot again between the parts.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडीखौ कागजआव 5 मिनिट थादनो हो; गुसुनायाव बेफोरा बांसिन खरखरा जायो. मोजां मोनोब्ला, सायाव इसे संख्रि एबा बानलु गुन्दै सिखार.
seg.8ab193492427.back: Let the pakodi rest on paper 5 minutes; on cooling they become more crisp. If you like, sprinkle a little salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: गुन्दैखौ गाढा आरो गोरान दोन, पातला नङा, नङाब्ला पकोडीआ गुदुर जायो.
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Add the powder thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi becomes soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: माजारि अराव साव: खाजुआ गोख्रोंयै बादामि जायो, आरो गोहो अराव गेजेरनि खाजुआ सावनायनि सिगां बिगुरआ रं लायो.
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium flame: cashews become brown quickly, and on high flame the coating takes colour before the cashew in the middle is fried.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: गुन्दैआव हुरनाय सामुस मोनसे गुदुं थाउआ पकोडीखौ रायखा आरो खरखरा खालामो.
seg.76602f605fc8.back: One spoon hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi [raykha: unclear, maybe 'light/flaky'] and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ माजारि गुदुं आरो मोजां गोजा रं होयो; गथ'फोरनि थाखाय ½ फिसा सामुस बाहाय.
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a good red colour; for children use ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: बांसिन गुदुं: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैनि खावसेनि सोलायाव तेजा बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय, जायआ खोब बांसिन गुदुं.
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: instead of half the Sannam chilli powder use Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: सामब्राम गोजाजों: बांसिन गुदुर, बांसिन गोदै पकोडीनि थाखाय खाजुजों लोगोसे पातलायै दानजानाय 1 फिसा सामब्राम गोजा दोन, आरो बेखौ बेनो सानाव जा.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer, sweeter pakodi add 1 thinly cut small onion together with the cashews, and eat it that same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदिना: धनिया बिलाइजों लोगोसे 2 गेदेर सामुस खावनाय पुदिना बिलाइ दोन.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves together with the coriander leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: बेलासिनि साहा एबा फिल्टार कफिजों गुदुंयै जानो हो. बेफोरखौ टिफिन बाकसो आरो ओंखाम-पप्पुनि जानायनि सेरावबो दोनो हायो.
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve hot with evening tea or filter coffee. They can also be put in the tiffin box and at the side of a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: आबुं गुसुनायनि उनाव, बार हाबनो हायि जारआव न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव लाखि आरो 4–5 साननि सिङाव जा. गुदुर जायोब्ला, गोरान सरायआव गुरै अराव 2–3 मिनिट गुदुं खालाम.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After fully cooling, keep in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they become soft, heat in a dry pan on low flame 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: आंनि खाजुनि पकोडीआ मानो गुदुर जाबाय?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi become soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: गुन्दैआव जोबोद बांसिन दै, एबा गुरै अराव सावनाय. गासैखौ सेंसेरनाय गुटि बादि दोन आरो बुरबुरिफोरा गुरै जानो सिम माजारि अराव साव.
seg.346050614d3a.back: Too much water in the flour mix, or fried on low flame. Add it all like damp lumps and fry on medium flame until the bubbles become slow.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.t: पकोडी बानायनायनि सिगां खाजुखौ हुबनांगौ नामा?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Must the cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: हुबनो नाङा. गुन्दैआ गोबाखांनो गोख्रोंयै मोनसे मोन सुनायानो गोनां; गोलाव समाय हुबनाय खाजुआ बेनि खरखराखौ इसे गोमायो.
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. Only one quick wash is needed for the flour to stick; cashews soaked a long time lose a little of their crispness.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: मायरंनि गुन्दै गैयै खाजुनि पकोडी बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can cashew pakodi be made without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: हागौ. 2 गेदेर सामुस बांसिन बेसन, एबा 1 गेदेर सामुस कर्नफ्लावार बाहाय. मायरंनि गुन्दैआ खोब खरखरा बिगुर होयो, बेनिखायनो बेनि गैयै पकोडीआ इसे गुदुर जागोन.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Use 2 tablespoons more besan, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour gives a very crisp coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: खाजुनि पकोडीआ माखाव सम खरखरा थायो?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: बार हाबनो हायि जारआव मोटामुटि 4–5 सान, जारआव दोननायनि सिगां आबुं गुसुयोब्ला.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, if fully cooled before putting in the jar.

seg.60df05d4b9d3.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ · खाजुनि पकोडीनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.60df05d4b9d3.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ · Recipe method of cashew pakodi | 1acrefarms

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. जोंनि जीडिपप्पु पेकनि आबुं खाजु, बेसन, मायरंनि गुन्दै आरो सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैजों खरखरा खाजुनि पकोडी. आदब आदबै बानायनाय, खामानि बाथ्रा आरो सोंनायफोर.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with the whole cashews of our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Made step by step, with tips and questions.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.7d26dc20462c.back: Oil for frying in plenty of oil

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उपमा आ आन्ध्रनि सानफ्रोमबोनि टिफिन: सामब्राम गोजा, सोमखोर बानलु आरो करि बिलाइजों फोरन होनाय दैआव गुदुर जानो सिम संनाय सुजि. जीडिपप्पु उपमा आ बेनि सावगारि खालामनाय रूप, घिआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम सावनाय गोबां खाजुजों, आलासि, फोरबोनि फुं आरो हाबायाव बानायनाय बादि, सरासनस्रायै पेसरट्टुनि सेराव एबा सामुस मोनसे चिनिजों जानो होयो.
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's everyday tiffin: semolina cooked until soft in water tempered with onion, green chilli and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its special form, with plenty of cashews fried golden colour in ghee, made as for guests, festival mornings and weddings (haba), usually served at the side of pesarattu or with one spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: जोंनि जीडिपप्पु खाजुआ आबुं आरो सादा, बेनिखायनो बेफोरा समानै सावजायो आरो गुदुर रवानि गेजेराव खरखरा थायो. बेयो मोटामुटि 25 मिनिटआव जानायाव थियारि जायो. बे संनाय आदबआ 3 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and white, so they fry evenly and stay crisp in the soft rava. It is ready to eat in about 25 minutes. This recipe is for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: रवाखौ साव, खाजुखौ घिआव साव, बेनि उनाव फोरन हो आरो सामब्राम गोजा आरो बानलुखौ गुदुर खालाम. संख्रिजों दै फुदुं, रवा दोननानै लोरसोर, खुबुम आरो खाजुजों जोबनो हो.
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Fry the rava, fry the cashews in ghee, then temper and make the onion and chilli soft. Boil water with salt, add the rava and stir, cover and finish with the cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 कप बम्बे रवा ⟦1⟧माजारि सुजि, मोटामुटि 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ कप दै ⟦1⟧बांसिन गोरा उपमानि थाखाय 2 कप बाहाय⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a harder upma use 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ कप खाजु ⟦1⟧आबुं एबा खावसे, मोटामुटि 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or half, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस घि ⟦1⟧एबा 2 गेदेर सामुस थाउ आरो 1 गेदेर सामुस घि⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 सोमखोर बानलु ⟦1⟧सेरजों दानजानाय; बांसिन गुदुं उपमानि थाखाय 3 बाहाय⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧cut along the side; for a hotter upma use 3⟦/1⟧

seg.46ba774a4c39.t: 2 गेदेर सामुस धनिया बिलाइ ⟦1⟧खावनाय, मोजां मोनोब्ला⟦/1⟧
seg.46ba774a4c39.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, if you like⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: सामब्राम गोजा, हादान आरो धनिया बिलाइखौ खाव, सोमखोर बानलुखौ सेरजों दान, आरो दैखौ जोखा खालामनानै थियारि खालाम.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, cut the green chillies along the side, and get ready by measuring the water.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: रवाखौ गोरान सरायआव सावनाय मुसुं होनो सिम साव, मोटामुटि 5 मिनिट. बेखौ फिका रंआव दोन. माजारि-गुरै अराव सारासे लोरसोर, बेनि उनाव मोनसे थालियाव दोन.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the rava in a dry pan until it gives a roasted smell, about 5 minutes. Put it at a pale colour [keep it pale]. Stir constantly on medium-low fire, then put it onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: मोनसे गुवार, गोरोंथि सरायआव माजारि-गुरै अराव घिखौ गुदुं खालाम.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat the ghee on medium-low flame in a wide, heavy pan.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: खाजुखौ घिआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव; बेफोरखौ बेखार ला. बेयो मोटामुटि 1–2 मिनिट लायो; घिखौ सरायआवनो दोन.
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in the ghee until golden colour; take them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan itself.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: बेसोर, दाल आरो करि बिलाइखौ फोरन हो. सामब्राम गोजा आरो बानलुखौ गुदुर खालाम, दै आरो संख्रि दोन, आरो फुदुं. करि बिलाइ दोननायनि सिगां बेसोरखौ फुटिनो हो आरो दालफोरखौ इसे सोनानि गाब जानो हो, बेनि उनाव सामब्राम गोजाजों हादान दोन आरो सामब्राम गोजाआ गुदुर जानो सिम 3–4 मिनिट सं.
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Temper the mustard, dal and curry leaves. Make the onion and chilli soft, add water and salt, and boil. Before adding curry leaves let the mustard splutter and let the dals become a little golden, then add the ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: दैआ फुदुंनायनि उनाव सोवाद नाय; बेयो इसे संख्रि बादि मोननांगौ, मानोना रवाआ संख्रिखौ हाबनानै लायो.
seg.be01d433ae80.back: Taste after the water boils; it should taste a little like salt, because the rava takes in the salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: अरखौ गुरै खालाम. रवाखौ पातला सारि बादि फोनां, लोरसोरनानै. गुरै अराव 3 मिनिट खुबुम; सायाव खाजु दोन.
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Make the flame low. Pour the rava in like a thin line, stirring. Cover on low flame 3 minutes; add the cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: खाजु दोननायनि सिगां, उपमाखौ नाय: रवाआ गोरा बिजि गैयै गुदुर जानांगौ, आरो उपमाआ सरायनि सेरनिफ्राय बारनांगौ. दासिमबो बिजि बिजि मोनोब्ला, 2 गेदेर सामुस गुदुं दै सिखार, खुबुम आरो गुबुन 1 मिनिट सं.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft without hard grains, and the upma should come away from the side of the pan. If it still feels grainy, sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 more minute.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: बांसिन सामुस घि आरो धनिया बिलाइ, बाहायोब्ला, गोबां खाजुजों लोगोसे दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Stir in the remaining spoon of ghee and coriander leaves, if using, together with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: बांसिन खाजुखौ सायाव दोननानै गुदुंयै जानो हो.
seg.351e9512c914.back: Serve hot with the remaining cashews put on top.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: गुटि जायाखै होन्नानै रवाखौ पातला सारि बादि लोरसोरनानै फोनां.
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Pour the rava in like a thin line, stirring, so that it does not become lumps.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: रवाखौ गिबियाव सावब्ला मोनफ्रोम बिजिआ गुबुन गुबुनै थायो; सावनायखौ बोखारोब्ला उपमाआ गोबाखांनाय जायो.
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: If the rava is fried first, each grain stays separate; if the frying is thrown out, the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: खाजुखौ माजारि-गुरै अराव साव आरो सोनानि गाब जायोब्लाबो बेखार ला; गुदुं घिआव बेफोरा खोमसि जानो थाखोयो.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on medium-low flame and take them out as soon as golden; in hot ghee they keep on becoming dark.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: उपमाआ थायोब्ला गोरा जायो, बेनिखायनो नोंनो नांनायनिख्रुइ इसे गुदुर थानाय समावनो अरनिफ्राय बेखार ला.
seg.975560a8a158.back: Upma becomes hard when it rests, so take it off the flame while it is a little softer than you need.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: मैगं उपमा: सामब्राम गोजाजों लोगोसे ½ कप खावनाय गाजर, बिन आरो मटर दोन आरो दै दोननायनि सिगां 3–4 मिनिट सं.
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and peas together with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: टोमाटो उपमा: सामब्राम गोजानि उनाव 1 खावनाय टोमाटो दोन आरो दै दोननायनि सिगां गुदुर जानो सिम सं.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook until soft before adding water.
