seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुमा रवा उपमा: समान बिबांनि गमनि रवाखौ 3 कप दैजों बाहाय आरो खुबुमनानै 5–6 मिनिट सं.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: use the same quantity of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: नारिकलनि चाटनि, अल्लम पच्चडी एबा सामुस मोनसे चिनिजों फुंनि टिफिन महरै गुदुंयै जानो हो, एबा पेसरट्टु उपमानि थाखाय पेसरट्टुनि सेराव.
seg.01300d94ad36.back: Serve hot as the morning tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or one spoon of sugar, or at the side of pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उपमाखौ बानायनायनि उनाव गोख्रोंयै गुदुंयै जाब्ला खोब मोजां. बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव 1 सान सिम लाखि आरो फिन गुदुं खालामनायनि सिगां दै सिखार.
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten hot quickly after making. Cover the extra and keep in the fridge up to 1 day, and sprinkle water before heating again.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: दैखौ फुदुंनो थादनो हो, अरखौ गुरै खालाम आरो मोनसे आखायजों रवाखौ पातला सारि बादि फोनां, गुबुन आखायजों लोरसोरनानै.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Let the water boil, make the flame low and with one hand pour the rava like a thin line, stirring with the other hand.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: उपमानि थाखाय रवा आरो दैनि थिक बिबांआ मा?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right quantity of rava and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: गुदुर आन्ध्रनि आदबनि उपमानि थाखाय, 1 कप बम्बे रवानि थाखाय 2½ कप दै बाहाय. बांसिन गोरा, बिजि बिजि उपमानि थाखाय 2 कप बाहाय.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water for 1 cup Bombay rava. For a harder, grainy upma use 2 cups.

seg.2cc94b02b5b4.back: Why does my upma become sticky?

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: रवाखौ सावाखै, एबा जोबोद बांसिन दै दोनबाय. सावनाय मुसुं होनो सिम रवाखौ साव, आरो कप मोनफ्रोमनि थाखाय 2½ कप दैनि खाथियाव था.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The rava was not fried, or too much water was added. Fry the rava until it gives a fried smell, and stay near 2½ cups water for each cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When should the cashews be added to the upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: गिबियाव बेफोरखौ घिआव साव आरो बेखार ला, बेनि उनाव जोबनायाव दोननानै लोरसोर. गोख्रोंयै दोनोब्ला, बेफोरा उपमायाव गुदुर जायो.
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry them in ghee and take them out, then add at the end and stir. If added early, they become soft in the upma.

seg.6cb14eaca16a.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా · जीडिपप्पु उपमानि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.6cb14eaca16a.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా · Recipe method of Jeedipappu Upma | 1acrefarms

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. घिआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम सावनाय जीडिपप्पु खाजुजों आन्ध्रनि रवा उपमा, गुदुर आरो गोख्रोंयै थियारि जानाय फुंनि टिफिन. आदब आदबै बानायनाय, खामानि बाथ्रा आरो सोंनायफोर. 3 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden colour in ghee, a soft and quickly-ready morning tiffin. Made step by step, with tips and questions. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उपमा: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c944ba9a331c.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · कोडी वेपुडु · आन्ध्रनि दाव बेदोर भाजा

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडी वेपुडु आ आन्ध्रनि गोरान दाव बेदोर भाजा: फिसा फिसा दाव बेदोरखौ बेनि गावनि रसआव संनानै, बेनि उनाव करि बिलाइ, सोमखोर बानलु आरो दासिमसो सावनाय मसलाजों थाउआव खोमसि आरो मसलाजों गोबाखांनाय जानो सिम गोख्रों अराव सावनाय. बेयो आन्ध्रनि हाबायाव गिबि जानाय आरो न'आव रसम ओंखाम एबा पप्पुनि सेराव थानाय जानाय.
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is Andhra's dry chicken-meat fry: small pieces of chicken meat cooked in their own juice, then fried on strong flame in oil with curry leaves, green chilli and just-now-fried masala until dark and coated with masala. It is the first dish at Andhra weddings (haba) and the side dish at home beside rasam rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: जोंनि तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ बेखौ गोहो गोजा रं आरो आन्ध्रनि भाजाफोरनि मुंदांखा गुदुं होयो, जोंनि हालदै गुन्दैआ फोथेरनायाव हाबो, आरो जोंनि आबुं खाजु, सोनानि गाब जानो सिम सावनाय, जोबनायाव हाबो. सेरनि जानाय महरै 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and the famous heat of Andhra fries, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashews, fried until golden colour, go in at the end. For 4 people as a side dish.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: दाव बेदोरखौ तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै, हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट आरो नेमुआव फोथेर, बेनि गावनि रसआव सं, बेनि उनाव करि बिलाइ, सोमखोर बानलु, सावनाय मसला आरो खाजुजों गोरानै साव.
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Marinate the chicken meat in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juice, then fry dry with curry leaves, green chilli, fried masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g बेगेर गैयि दाव बेदोर ⟦1⟧1-इन्सि दुकुरा दानजानाय; एबा 600 g फिसा बेगेर थानाय दुकुरा⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken meat ⟦1⟧cut in 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashews; break the big ones in halves⟦/1⟧

seg.444a0a15a466.back: 1 medium red onion (if you like) ⟦1⟧thinly sliced⟦/1⟧

seg.7716b571732d.back: 4 green chillies ⟦1⟧cut along the side lengthwise⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: फोथेरनाया गोबाखांनो दाव बेदोरखौ मोनसे सिजों मोसोनानै गोरान खालाम.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Wipe the chicken meat dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: दाव बेदोरखौ तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै, हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट, नेमुनि रस आरो संख्रिआव 30 मिनिट फोथेर. आखायजों मोजांङै गलाय अब्ला मोनफ्रोम दुकुरायाव लागोन.
seg.075327f4deca.back: Marinate the chicken meat in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt 30 minutes. Mix well with the hand so it gets onto each piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: बेनि गेजेराव, धनियानि बिजि, जिरा, मौरिनि बिजि, लोंग आरो दालचिनिखौ मोनसे फिसा सरायआव गुरै अराव मुसुं होनो आरो इसे खोमसि जानो सिम थाउ गैयै साव, मोटामुटि 2 मिनिट. गुसुनो हो आरो खरखरा गुन्दै खालाम. बेयो भाजानि मसला.
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile, fry the coriander seed, cumin, fennel seed, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low flame without oil until they give smell and become a little dark, about 2 minutes. Let it cool and grind coarsely. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: दाव बेदोरखौ दै गैयै मोनसे गोरोंथि कराइआव दोन, खुबुम आरो माजारि अराव दोन.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken meat in a heavy kadai without water, cover and put on medium flame.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: बेखौ बेनि गावनि रसआव खुबुमनानै गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जानो सिम सं, मोटामुटि 12 मिनिट. मोनसे एबा नै मोन लोरसोर; संनाय समाव दाव बेदोरआ दै ओंखारो.
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook it covered in its own juice until there is not a single pink colour, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; while cooking the chicken meat lets out water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: खुबुमखौ ला आरो लोरसोरनानै गोहो अराव सं, दैआ मोटामुटि गोरान जानो सिम, 3–4 मिनिट. दाव बेदोरखौ मोनसे थालियाव दोन आरो कराइखौ मोसो.
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Take off the lid and cook stirring on strong flame until the water is almost dry, 3–4 minutes. Put the chicken meat on a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: कराइआव माजारि अराव थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium flame.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: खाजुखौ थाउआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव; बेखार ला. बेफोरा मिनिट मोनसेनि सिङावनो जायो, बेनिखायनो सारासे लोरसोर आरो खोर गोनां सामुसजों बेखार ला.
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden colour; take them out. They are done within one minute, so stir all the time and take them out with a spoon with holes.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: सामब्राम गोजा, बाहायोब्ला, दोन आरो सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव. सोमखोर बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ साव. गोजान था; बिलाइफोरा फट फट जायो आरो थाउ बारहोयो.
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden colour. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand far away; the leaves crackle and throw out oil.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: दाव बेदोर आरो भाजानि मसला दोन. गोरान आरो खोमसि जानो सिम गोहो अराव साव, बेनि उनाव खाजु दोननानै गिदिं. 6–8 मिनिट गिदिंनो थाखो, मसलाआ दुकुराफोराव गोबाखांनो आरो सेरफोरा खोमसि आरो खरखरा जानो सिम.
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken meat and the fry masala. Fry on strong flame until dry and dark, then add the cashews and toss. Keep tossing 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become dark and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: सोवाद नाय, नांब्ला संख्रि दोन, धनिया बिलाइ सिखार आरो गुदुंयै जानो हो.
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle coriander leaves and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: जोबनायाव गोहो अराव साव, अब्ला मसलाआ मोनफ्रोम दुकुरायाव गोबाखांगोन.
seg.349c72ce839a.back: Fry on strong flame at the end, so the masala will stick to each piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ जोबोद गुदुं. माजारि गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस बाहाय, एबा खमाय गुदुंजों गोजा रंनि थाखाय सोलायनानै सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour with less heat use Sannam chilli powder instead.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: दुकुराफोरखौ फिसा आरो समानै दान, अब्ला बेफोरा समान समाव गेजेर सिम संजायो आरो भाजायाव मोजांङै खरखरा जायो.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and even, so they cook to the middle in the same time and become well crisp in the fry.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: संनायनि सिगांसो भाजानि मसलाखौ गुन्दै खालाम; सावनाय मसलानि मुसुंआनो मोजां वेपुडुनि गोहो.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala only just before cooking; the smell of the fried masala is the depth of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: बेगेर थानाय: 600 g फिसा बेगेर थानाय दुकुरा बाहाय आरो बेगेरनि खाथियाव गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जानो सिम बेफोरनि रसआव 18–20 मिनिट सं.
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook in their juice 18–20 minutes until there is not a single pink colour near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: नारिकल वेपुडु: मसलाजों भाजायाव 3 गेदेर सामुस रुखुनाय गोरान नारिकल दोन आरो बादामि जानो सिम गिदिं.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Coconut vepudu: add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g बेगेर गैयि बरमा बेदोरखौ फोथेरनाय मसला आरो ½ कप दैजों प्रेसार कुकारआव 5–6 सिटि जानो सिम सं, बेनि उनाव समान आदबै साव.
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless goat meat in the pressure cooker with the marinade masala and ½ cup water until 5–6 whistles, then fry in the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम ओंखाम, पप्पु आरो ओंखाम एबा साम्बार ओंखामनि सेराव गुदुंयै जानो हो, एबा दानजानाय सामब्राम गोजा आरो नेमुनि दुकुराजों गिबि जानाय महरै.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot at the side of rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or as a first dish with cut onion and lemon pieces.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव 2 सान सिम लाखि. गुदुं सरायआव इसे थाउजों गेजेर सिम भाप ओंखारनो सिम फिन गुदुं खालाम; बेयो फिन खरखरा जायो.
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Cover and keep in the fridge up to 2 days. Heat again in a hot pan with a little oil until steam comes out through to the middle; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आन्ध्रआव दाव बेदोर भाजा आरो दाव बेदोरनि ओंख्रीनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.551573b4b443.back: In Andhra, what is the difference between chicken-meat fry and chicken-meat curry?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडुआ गोरान: दाव बेदोरखौ बेनि गावनि रसआव संनानै, बेनि उनाव झोल गैयै मसलाआ बेखौ बिगुर जानो सिम सावो. कोडी कूराआ ओंखामनि थाखाय सामब्राम गोजा-टोमाटोनि झोल गोनां ओंख्री.
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the chicken meat is cooked in its own juice, then the masala fries it without gravy until it is coated. Kodi kura is a curry with onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडुनि थाखाय बेगेर गैयि एबा बेगेर थानाय दाव बेदोर बाहायनांगौ?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should boneless or bone-in chicken meat be used for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: मोननैबो जायो. बेगेर गैयिआ गोख्रोंयै संजायो आरो बांसिन खरखरा जायो; फिसा बेगेर थानाय दुकुराफोराव बांसिन सोवाद दं नाथाय बेफोरनि रसआव मोटामुटि 8 मिनिट बांसिन नांगौ.
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes more crisp; small bone-in pieces have more taste but need about 8 minutes more in their juice.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: खोब मोटा दुकुराखौ दान. गेजेराव (एबा बेगेरनि खाथियाव) गोलाबि रं मोनसेबो गैयै जायोब्ला आरो रसआ साफ ओंखारोब्ला दाव बेदोरआ संजाबाय.
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink colour remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice comes out clear.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: कोडी वेपुडुखौ माबोरै खमाय गुदुं खालामनो?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय, एबा सोलायनानै सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय, आरो 2 सोमखोर बानलुखौल' दान. खाजु आरो करि बिलाइआ सोवादखौ आबुं दोनथायो.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or use Sannam chilli powder instead, and cut only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the taste whole.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: కోడి వేపుడు · कोडी वेपुडु (आन्ध्रनि दाव बेदोर भाजा) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra's chicken-meat fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. आन्ध्रनि दाव बेदोर भाजा: तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो हालदै गुन्दैआव दाव बेदोर, करि बिलाइ, सोमखोर बानलु, सावनाय मसला आरो जोंनि खाजुजों गोरानै सावनाय.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra's chicken-meat fry: chicken meat in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chilli, fried masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडी वेपुडु: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा आ आन्ध्रनि न'फोरनि जोंजों गोमो नेमु ओंखाम: संनाय ओंखामखौ चिनाबादाम, बुट दाल, उरद दाल, बेसोर, सोमखोर बानलु आरो करि बिलाइनि फट फट जानाय फोरनजों गलायनानै, बेनि उनाव नेमुनि रसजों खाखि खालामनाय. बेयो रेल दाबाय, फरायसालिनि टिफिन बाकसो आरो मन्दिरनि साननि थाखाय दोननाय ओंखाम, आरो फोरबो आरो पूजानि थाखाय गोबां बानायो.
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice mixed with a crackling tempering of groundnut, chana dal, urad dal, mustard, green chilli and curry leaves, then made sour with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made a lot for festivals and puja.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: जोंनि हालदै गुन्दैआ सेकेन्ड खायसेनि थाखाय गुदुं थाउआव हाबो, जायआ मोनफ्रोम बिजिखौ समान सोनानि गोमो रं खालामो आरो बेनि संजायि सोवादखौ बोखारो. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which makes every grain an even golden-yellow colour and removes its uncooked taste. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: गासैआव ओंखाम संनाय आरो सोवादफोरा थिरो जानो 15 मिनिट थादनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: Cooking the rice and letting it rest 15 minutes so the tastes settle is included in the total.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: चिनाबादाम, दाल, बेसोर, बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ थाउआव साव, हालदै गुन्दै आरो हिंग दोन, बेनि उनाव गुसुनाय ओंखाम, संख्रि आरो नेमुनि रसजों गलाय.
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry the groundnut, dal, mustard, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then mix with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 कप मायरं ⟦1⟧सोना मसुरि, मोटामुटि 200 g; संनायनि उनाव मोटामुटि 3 कप जायो⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masuri, about 200 g; after cooking it becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 कप संनाय ओंखाम ⟦1⟧इसे गोरा संनाय, बिजिफोरा गुबुन गुबुन⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little hard, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस नेमुनि रस ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 2 नेमुनिफ्राय; सोवाद नायनानै बांसिन दोन⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more by tasting⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस थाउ ⟦1⟧सरासनस्रायै चिनाबादामनि थाउ बाहायो⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.831b2d7872a6.back: 3 green chillies ⟦1⟧cut along the side lengthwise⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: मायरंखौ सु आरो 2 कप दैजों दासिम संजानो सिम सं, अब्ला बिजिफोरा गुबुन गुबुनै थायो. नोंनो मोटामुटि 3 कप संनाय ओंखाम नांगौ.
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook with 2 cups water until just cooked, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups cooked rice.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: संनाय ओंखामखौ गुसुनो मोनसे थालियाव फारा; संख्रि दोन. काँटा चामुसजों खुलि खालाम आरो गुदुं जोबोद नङै, इसे गुदुं जानो सिम मोटामुटि 10 मिनिट थादनो हो, अब्ला गलायनाय समाव बिजिफोरा बायाखै.
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Loosen it with a fork and let it rest about 10 minutes until a little warm, not very hot, so the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम; चिनाबादाम, दाल, बेसोर, बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ साव. चिनाबादामजों माजारि अराव जागाय आरो बेफोरा फट फट जानो आरो बिगुरफोरा खोमसि जानो सिम मोटामुटि 2 मिनिट साव.
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat the oil; fry the groundnut, dal, mustard, chilli and curry leaves. Start with the groundnuts on medium flame and fry about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins become dark.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: बुट दाल आरो उरद दाल दोन आरो इसे सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव, मोटामुटि 1 मिनिट.
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until a little golden colour, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: बेसोर दोन आरो फुटिनो हो, बेनि उनाव गोरान गोजा बानलु, सोमखोर बानलु, हादान आरो करि बिलाइ दोन आरो बिलाइफोरा खरखरा जानो सिम सेकेन्ड खायसे साव.
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add the mustard and let it splutter, then add dry red chilli, green chilli, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves become crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: हालदै गुन्दै आरो हिंग दोननानै लोरसोर; अरखौ थाद'. हालदैआ गुदुं थाउआव सावखांनो गैयै संजानो 5–10 सेकेन्डल' लोरसोर.
seg.6e856356980b.back: Add turmeric powder and hing and stir; stop the flame. Stir only 5–10 seconds so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: ओंखामनि सायाव फोनां, नेमुनि रस दोन आरो गुरैयै गलाय. आसि एबा मोनसे फारा सामुस बाहाय आरो ओंखामखौ सिंथारनिफ्राय सायाव ला, अब्ला मोनफ्रोम बिजिआ लेबेलेबे जायै गोमो जायो.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour on top of the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use the fingers or a flat spoon and lift the rice from the bottom upward, so every grain becomes yellow without becoming mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: सोवाद नाय आरो नांब्ला बांसिन संख्रि एबा नेमुनि रस दोन. ओंखामआ सोवाद मोनै खाखि आरो संख्रि गोनां जानांगौ, मानोना थायोब्ला सोवादआ गुरै जायो.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice should taste sour and salty, because when it rests the taste becomes mild.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: जानो होनायनि सिगां पुलिहोराखौ खुबुमनानै 15 मिनिट थादनो हो, अब्ला ओंखामआ नेमु आरो फोरनखौ हाबनानै लागोन.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving let the pulihora rest covered 15 minutes, so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: नेमुनि रसखौ अरनिफ्राय बेखार लानानै दोन, अब्ला बेयो गोख्रों थायो. संनाय नेमुनि रसआ गोखा जायो.
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice after taking off the flame, then it stays strong. Cooked lemon juice becomes bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: ओंखामखौ इसे गोरा सं आरो गलायनायनि सिगां गुसुनो हो; गुदुं, गुदुर ओंखामआ पेस्ट बादि जायो.
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little hard and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice becomes like paste.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: हालदै गुन्दैखौ थाउआव सेकेन्ड खायसेल' दोन; सावखांनाय हालदैआ खोमसि रं आरो गोखा सोवाद होयो.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Add the turmeric powder to the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: फुंनि बांसिन ओंखामआ मोजां जायो, मानोना बिजिफोरा आगोलानो गोरा आरो गुबुन गुबुन.
seg.747474140bbf.back: Extra rice from the morning works well, because the grains are already hard and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: खाजु: फोरबोनि पुलिहोरानि थाखाय चिनाबादामजों लोगोसे 10 खावसे खाजु साव.
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 halved cashews together with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाया पुलिहोरा: नेमुनि रसनि सोलायाव, फोरनजों 1 कप रुखुनाय मिनिया आम गलाय.
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice, mix 1 cup grated unripe mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: रुखुनाय नारिकल: बांसिन गुरै ओंखामनि थाखाय नेमुनि रसजों लोगोसे 2 गेदेर सामुस रुखुनाय नारिकल दोन.
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a milder rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut together with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव दहि, आसार एबा अप्पडमजों जानो हो. बेयो टिफिन बाकसो आरो दाबायनि नामि ओंखाम.
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or appadam. It is the famous rice of the tiffin box and of journeys.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: बेयो न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव मोटामुटि 6 घन्टा मोजांङै थायो, बेनिखायनो बेखौ दाबायाव लाङो. बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो सान मोनसेनि सिङाव जा.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: It keeps well about 6 hours at room temperature, that is why it is taken on journeys. Cover the extra and keep in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: आंनि नेमु ओंखामआ मानो गोखा मोनो?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: नेमुनि रसखौ संनाय जायो एबा हालदैआ थाउआव सावखांबाय. हालदै दोननायनि सिगां अरखौ थाद', आरो नेमुनि रसखौ अरनिफ्राय बेखार लानानै ओंखामआवल' दोन.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: The lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Stop the flame before adding the turmeric, and add the lemon juice only to the rice after taking it off the flame.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: पुलिहोरा आरो नेमु ओंखामनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा आ खाखि खालामनाय ओंखामनि तेलुगु मुं. चिन्तापंडु पुलिहोराखौ तेंतेलिनि पेस्टजों खाखि खालामो; निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा आ नेमुनि रूप, बानायनो गोख्रों आरो रंआ फिका.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon form, quicker to make and paler in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: नेमु ओंखामखौ लेबेलेबे जानायनिफ्राय माबोरै रैखा खालामनो?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How to protect lemon rice from becoming mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: ओंखामखौ खमाय दैजों इसे गोरा सं, मोनसे थालियाव गुसुनो हो, आरो नेसेनायनि सोलायाव सिंथारनिफ्राय सायाव लानानै गुरैयै गलाय.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little hard with less water, let it cool on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from the bottom upward instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 कप ओंखामनि थाखाय माखाव नेमुनि रस?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: मोटामुटि 3 गेदेर सामुस, 2 माजारि नेमुनि रस. गुरैयै दोन आरो सोवाद नाय, मानोना नेमुफोरनि खाखिआ गुबुन गुबुन.
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and taste, because the sourness of lemons differs.

seg.0251508f9c8b.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర · नेमु ओंखामनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.0251508f9c8b.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర · Recipe method of lemon rice | 1acrefarms

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. आन्ध्रनि नेमु ओंखाम: गुसुनाय ओंखामखौ चिनाबादाम आरो दालनि फोरन, जोंनि हालदै गुन्दै आरो नेमुनि रसजों गलायनाय. आदब आदबै बानायनाय, खामानि बाथ्रा आरो सोंनायफोर.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra's lemon rice: cooled rice mixed with a tempering of groundnut and dal, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Made step by step, with tips and questions.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम आ हालदैजों जोंजों गोमो खालामनाय सादा ओंखाम, बेसोर, बुट दाल, करि बिलाइ आरो सोमखोर बानलुनि फट फट जानाय फोरनजों गलायनाय, सायाव सावनाय खाजुजों. आन्ध्रनि न'फोरा बेखौ टिफिन बाकसो, खामानि साननि गोख्रों जानाय आरो पूजानि सानाव प्रसादम महरै बानायो, सरासनस्रायै फुंनि बांसिन ओंखामजों.
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice made bright yellow with turmeric, mixed with a crackling tempering of mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and green chilli, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for the tiffin box, the quick meal of everyday, and as prasadam on puja day, usually with extra rice from the morning.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: जोंनि हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै (कोंडा पसुपु) आ ओंखामखौ गोहो गोमो रं आरो हानि बादि हालदैनि मुसुं होयो, बेनिखायनो 4 मानसिनि थाखाय खावसे फिसा सामुसनो गोनां. बेनो थाउआव सावनाय आबुं खाजु (जीडिपप्पु) आ खरखरा होयो.
seg.510252086556.back: Our mountain turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earth-like turmeric smell, so for 4 people only half a teaspoon is needed. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in that same oil give crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: गासैआव संनाय ओंखाम गुसुनो मोटामुटि 15 मिनिट लाफाबाय.
seg.38badedc8d11.back: About 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool is included in the total.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: ओंखाम सं आरो गुसुनो हो. खाजु, बेसोर, बुट दाल, बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ थाउआव साव, हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै दोन आरो ओंखामजों गलाय.
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add mountain turmeric powder and mix with the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 कप मायरं ⟦1⟧सोना मसुरि, मोटामुटि 200 g; संनायनि उनाव मोटामुटि 3 कप जायो⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masuri, about 200 g; after cooking it becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.e6e8d944080b.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧cut along the side lengthwise⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ फिसा सामुस हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon mountain turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.t: 1 गेदेर सामुस घि (मोजां मोनोब्ला) ⟦1⟧जोबनायाव दोननानै लोरसोरनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (if you like) ⟦1⟧added and stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.t: मायरंखौ 2–3 मोन दै सोलायनानै सु आरो दैखौ बोहैनो हो.
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: बिजिफोरा गुबुन गुबुनै थानो ओंखामखौ सं, बेनि उनाव गुसुनो मोनसे थालियाव फारा. हाण्डि एबा प्रेसार कुकारआव 1 कप मायरंनि थाखाय 2 कप दै बाहाय (2 सिटि), आरो फारानायनि सिगां काँटा चामुसजों खुलि खालाम.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a pot or pressure cooker use 2 cups water for 1 cup rice (2 whistles), and loosen with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: ओंखामखौ इसे गुदुं जानो सिम मोटामुटि 15 मिनिट गुसुनो हो. बेनि सायाव संख्रि सिखार.
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until a little warm. Sprinkle salt on top of it.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: मोनसे गुवार कराइआव माजारि अराव थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम.
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat the oil on medium flame in a wide kadai.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: खाजुखौ थाउआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव; बेखार ला. बेसोर आरो बुट दाल दोन. खाजुखौ मोनसे थालियाव लाखि; बेफोरा मोटामुटि 1 मिनिटआव सोनानि गाब जायो.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden colour; take them out. Add mustard and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they become golden colour in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: बेसोरा फुटियोब्ला, उरद दाल आरो गोरान गोजा बानलु दोन आरो लोरसोर.
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard splutters, add urad dal and dry red chilli and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: दालआ सोनानि गाब जायोब्ला, बानलु आरो करि बिलाइ दोन, बेनि उनाव गुरै अराव हालदै. करि बिलाइजों हादान आरो हिंग दोन, आरो हालदैखौ 5–10 सेकेन्डल' लोरसोर.
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal becomes golden colour, add chilli and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low flame. Add ginger and hing together with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: हालदैआ सावखांयाखै होन्नानै गोख्रोंयै अरखौ थाद'.
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Stop the flame quickly so that the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: ओंखाम, खाजु आरो संख्रि दोन आरो समानै गोमो जानो सिम गुरैयै गलाय. मोनसे फारा सामुस बाहाय आरो नेसेनायनि सोलायाव ला आरो खुम, अब्ला बिजिफोरा आबुं थायो.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add the rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until evenly yellow. Use a flat spoon and lift and fold instead of pressing, so the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: संख्रिनि सोवाद नाय, बाहायोब्ला घि दोननानै लोरसोर, खुबुम आरो जानो होनायनि सिगां 5 मिनिट थादनो हो, अब्ला ओंखामआ फोरननि सोवाद लागोन.
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste for salt, add ghee if using and stir, cover and let rest 5 minutes before serving, so the rice takes the taste of the tempering.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: बिजिफोरा बायाखै होन्नानै गिबियाव ओंखामखौ गुसुनो फारा.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread the rice to cool so that the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: हालदैखौ गुरै अराव दोन आरो सेकेन्ड खायसेल' लोरसोर; सावखांनाय हालदैआ ओंखामखौ गोखा खालामो.
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add the turmeric on low flame and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दैआ गोहोयै रं होयो; 1 कप मायरंनि थाखाय ½ फिसा सामुसजों जागाय आरो गोहो गोमो नांब्लासो इसे बांसिन दोन.
seg.394d01a50207.back: Mountain turmeric powder gives deep colour; start with ½ teaspoon for 1 cup rice and add a little more only if a deep yellow is needed.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: फुंनि बांसिन ओंखामआ मोजां जायो, बिजिफोरा गुबुन गुबुन थाब्ला.
seg.505872469eb9.back: Extra rice from the morning works well, if the grains stay separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: हालदै गुन्दै: जोंनि सानफ्रोमबोनि पसुपु हालदै गुन्दैआबो समान आदबै जायो; समान ½ फिसा सामुस बाहाय.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; use the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: चिनाबादाम: बांसिन खरखरानि थाखाय खाजुनि सिगां 2 गेदेर सामुस संजायि चिनाबादामखौ थाउआव साव.
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnut: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: नेमु: खाखि, पुलिहोरा बादि ओंखामनि थाखाय ओंखामजों खावसे नेमुनि रस सिप.
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a sour, pulihora-like rice squeeze half a lemon's juice into the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: नारिकल: ओंखामजों लोगोसे 2 गेदेर सामुस रुखुनाय नारिकल दोननानै गलाय.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: add 2 tablespoons grated coconut together with the rice and mix.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: दहि, अप्पडालु एबा गोरान आलु भाजाजों गुदुंयै एबा न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव जानो हो. बेयो टिफिन बाकसो आरो दाबायनि थाखायबो मोजांङै पेक जायो.
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve hot or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for the tiffin box and journeys.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: बेनो सानाव जाब्ला खोब मोजां. बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव 1 सान सिम लाखि आरो इसे दै सिखारनानै गुदुं खालाम.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: It is best eaten that same day. Cover the extra and keep in the fridge up to 1 day and heat after sprinkling a little water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: बिजिफोरा गुबुन गुबुनै थानो ओंखाम सं आरो गुसुनो हो. खाजु, बेसोर, बुट दाल, बानलु आरो करि बिलाइखौ थाउआव साव, गुरै अराव सेकेन्ड खायसेनि थाखाय हालदै दोन, बेनि उनाव संख्रिजों ओंखाम दोननानै गलाय.
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low flame for a few seconds, then add the rice with salt and mix.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: हालदै ओंखामआव माखाव हालदै गुन्दै हाबो?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 कप मायरंनि थाखाय मोटामुटि ½ फिसा सामुस (संनायनि उनाव मोटामुटि 3 कप). हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दैआ गोहोयै रं होयो, बेनिखायनो खमायजों जागाय आरो नांब्ला इसे बांसिन दोन.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: About ½ teaspoon for 1 cup rice (about 3 cups after cooking). Mountain turmeric powder gives deep colour, so start with less and add a little more if needed.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: हालदैआ गुदुं थाउआव सावखांबाय, एबा जोबोद बांसिन हाबबाय. बेखौ गुरै अराव दोन, सेकेन्ड खायसेल' लोरसोर आरो ओंखाम दोननायनि सिगां अरखौ थाद'.
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low flame, stir only a few seconds and stop the flame before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: बांसिन ओंखामजों पसुपु अन्नम बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can pasupu annam be made with extra (leftover) rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: हागौ. बिजि गुबुन गुबुन थानाय बांसिन ओंखामआ मोजां जायो. फोरनआव गलायनायनि सिगां गुटिफोरखौ आसिजों बाय.
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break the lumps with the fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.42238d687a8f.t: పసుపు అన్నం · पसुपु अन्नमनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.42238d687a8f.back: పసుపు అన్నం · Recipe method of Pasupu Annam | 1acrefarms

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. पसुपु अन्नम, आन्ध्रनि हालदै ओंखाम: संनाय ओंखामखौ बेसोर, बुट दाल आरो करि बिलाइनि फोरन, हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै आरो सावनाय खाजुजों गलायनाय. 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra's turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed with a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves, mountain turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ फिसा सामुस हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागी जावा आ दैआव संनाय रागीनि गुन्दैनि फोनांनो हानाय जाउ, आन्ध्र आरो रायलसीमानि गोबां न'आव सानफ्रोमबोनि लोंनाय. संख्रि गोनां रूपखौ घोलजों बानायो; बे गोदै रूपखौ गाइखेरजों पातला खालामनानै गुरजों गोदै खालामो, आरो फुंनि जानाय एबा बेलासि स्टिलनि टाम्बलारनिफ्राय गुदुंयै लोंयो.
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, the everyday drink in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty form is made with buttermilk; this sweet form is made thin with cow's milk and sweet with jaggery, and drunk hot from a steel tumbler at the morning meal or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: जोंनि ताटि बेल्लम तालनि गुरआ रागीनि हानि बादि सोवादजों मोजां लोगो जायो आरो जावाखौ टफि बादि बादामि रं होयो. जागायनायनिफ्राय जोबनाय सिम मोटामुटि 15 मिनिट लायो. बे संनाय आदबआ 2 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery goes well with ragi's earth-like taste and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. From start to finish it takes about 15 minutes. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: गासैआव गुर दोननायनि सिगां 2 मिनिट थादनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: Letting it rest 2 minutes before adding jaggery is included in the total.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: रागीनि गुन्दैखौ दैआव लोरसोरनानै गलाय, फुदुंनाय दैआव गाढा आरो जोंजों जानो सिम सं, बेनि उनाव गाइखेर दोन. अरनिफ्राय बेखार लानानै, तालनि गुर आरो एलाची दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Dissolve the ragi powder by stirring in water, cook it in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Taking it off the fire, add palm jaggery and cardamom and stir.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ कप रागीनि गुन्दै ⟦1⟧माडुवानि गुन्दै, मोटामुटि 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧maduva flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 कप दै ⟦1⟧गुन्दै गलायनो 1 कप, फुदुंनो 1 कप⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 गेदेर सामुस रुखुनाय तालनि गुर ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 30 g; बांसिन गोदै मोजां मोनोब्ला सामुस मोनसे बांसिन दोन⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; if you like more sweet add one spoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: रागीनि गुन्दैखौ 1 कप दैआव गुटि गैयै गुदुर जानो सिम लोरसोरनानै गलाय. हुइस्क एबा काँटा चामुस बाहाय आरो जायखिजाय गुटिखौ बाटिनि सेराव नेसेनानै बाय.
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Mix the ragi flour in 1 cup water by stirring until soft without lumps. Use a whisk or fork and break any lump by pressing at the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: बांसिन 1 कप दैखौ सिंथार गोरोंथि सरायआव फोनां आरो माजारि अराव दोन.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup water into a heavy-bottomed pan and put on medium flame.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: गुबुन कप दैखौ फुदुं, रागी फोनां आरो गाढा आरो जोंजों जानो सिम गुरै अराव लोरसोर, 6–8 मिनिट. फोनांनायनि सिगां गासैखौ मोनसे मोन लोरसोर, मानोना गुन्दैआ बाटिनि सिंथाराव थिरो जायो.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low fire until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir everything once before pouring, because the powder settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: सारासे लोरसोरनो थाखो. सोवाद गैयि गोलाबि-बादामि रंनिफ्राय बांसिन खोमसि, जोंजों बादामि रं जायोब्ला आरो सामुसनि उनथिंआव बिगुर जायोब्ला जावाआ संजाबाय.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from a dull pinkish-brown colour to darker, glossy brown colour and coats the back of the spoon.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: गाइखेर दोन आरो 2 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं. अरखौ थाद' आरो 2 मिनिट थादनो हो. गुरै अराव फुदुंनाय समाव मोनसे एबा नै मोन लोरसोर, अब्ला बेयो सिंथाराव गोबाखांयाखै.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add the milk and boil on low flame 2 minutes. Stop the flame and let it rest 2 minutes. While boiling on low flame stir once or twice, so that it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जावाआ थानाय समाव तालनि गुरखौ मिहि रुखु, अब्ला बेयो गोख्रोंयै गलायो.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java is resting, grate the palm jaggery fine, so that it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: तालनि गुर आरो एलाची दोननानै लोरसोर. गुदुंयै जानो हो. गुरआ आबुं गलायनो सिम लोरसोर, बेनि उनाव सोवाद नाय आरो नांब्ला इसे बांसिन दोन.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Add palm jaggery and cardamom and stir. Serve hot. Stir until the jaggery fully melts, then taste and add a little more if needed.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: टाम्बलार एबा बाटियाव फोनां. लोंनो जोबोद गाढा जायोब्ला, सामुस खायसे गुदुं गाइखेर दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into a tumbler or bowl. If too thick to drink, add a few spoons of hot milk and stir.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: सारासे रागीनि गुन्दैखौ गिबियाव दैआव गलाय; फुदुंनाय दैआव सरासरि दोननाय गुन्दैआ बायनो हायि गुटि जायो.
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix the ragi flour first in water; flour added straight into boiling water becomes lumps that cannot be broken.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: संनायाव गोख्रों खालामनो नङा; आबुं संजायि रागीआ संजायि आरो गुन्दै बादि सोवाद मोनो.
seg.966098732312.back: Do not hurry the cooking; not-fully-cooked ragi tastes uncooked and like flour.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: टाम्बलारनिफ्राय लोंनो पातला जावानि थाखाय, 2 गेदेर सामुस रागीनि गुन्दै बाहाय; सामुसजों जानो हानाय जाउनि थाखाय, ⅓ कप बाहाय.
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For a thin java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tablespoons ragi flour; for a porridge that can be eaten with a spoon, use ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: गोरान फिथाइजों: जोबनायाव खावनाय खाजु एबा बादाम खायसे आरो सामुस मोनसे किसमिस दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end add a few chopped cashews or almonds and one spoon of raisins and stir.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: गाइखेर गैयै: बांसिन पातला, खोमसि जावानि थाखाय रागीखौ 2½ कप दैआव सं आरो बुरबुरि जानो थादोब्ला गुर दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: for a thinner, darker java cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and when it stops bubbling add the jaggery and stir.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: फुंनि जानायनि थाखाय स्टिलनि टाम्बलार एबा बाटियाव गुदुंयै जानो हो, एबा बेलासिनि लोंनाय महरै बिस्कुट एबा मुरुकुलुजों. खायसेआ गुदुं बोथोराव गुसु खालामनानै मोजां मोनो.
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve hot in a steel tumbler or bowl for the morning meal, or as the evening drink with biscuits or murukulu. Some like it cooled in the hot season.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: बेनो सानाव लोंब्ला खोब मोजां. बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव 1 सान सिम लाखि आरो फिन गुदुं खालामनाय समाव, अरनिफ्राय बेखार लानानै इसे गुदुं गाइखेर दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: It is best drunk that same day. Cover the extra and keep in the fridge up to 1 day, and when heating again, after taking it off the flame add a little hot milk and stir.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: गुटि गैयै रागी जावा माबोरै बानायनो?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: रागीनि गुन्दैखौ गिबियाव न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिनि दैआव गुदुर जानो सिम लोरसोरनानै गलाय, बेनि उनाव सारासे लोरसोरनानै बेखौ फुदुंनाय दैआव फोनां.
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First mix the ragi flour in room-temperature water by stirring until soft, then pour it into boiling water stirring all the time.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: रागी जावा संजाबाय होन्नानै माबोरै मिथिनो?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How to know ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: बेयो खोमसि आरो जोंजों जायो, सामुसनि उनथिंआव बिगुर जानो गोनां गाढा जायो, आरो गुन्दै बादि सोवाद मोनाखै. गुरै अराव बेयो मोटामुटि 6–8 मिनिट लायो.
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes dark and glossy, thick enough to form a skin on the back of a spoon, and stops tasting like powder. On low fire it takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: रागी जावायाव तालनि गुर बाहायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can palm jaggery be used in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: हागौ. तालनि गुरखौ (ताटि बेल्लम) मिहि रुखु आरो अरखौ थादनायनि उनाव दोननानै लोरसोर, अब्ला गाइखेरआ बायाखै. बेयो गोहो रं आरो इसे धुवां बादि गोदैथि होयो.
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (tati bellam) fine and add and stir after stopping the flame, so that the milk does not break. It gives a deep colour and a little smoke-like sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागी जावा आरो रागी माल्टनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: बेफोर गुबुन गुबुन मुंनि मोनसेनो लोंनाय. रागी जावा आ तेलुगु मुं; रागी माल्ट आ दकान आरो मेनुआव सरासनस्रायै बुंनाय मुं.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: They are one drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is the name usually said in shops and menus.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · गोदै रागी जावानि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Recipe method of sweet ragi java | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. आन्ध्रनि आदबै गोदै रागी जावा: रागीनि गुन्दैखौ जोंजों जानो सिम दैआव संनानै, गाइखेरजों पातला खालामनानै आरो ताटि बेल्लम तालनि गुरजों गोदै खालामनाय. आदब आरो खामानि बाथ्राफोर.
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java in the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water until glossy, made thin with cow's milk and made sweet with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: रागी जावा: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु आ बेदोर एबा इचा नाखौ गाढा सामब्राम गोजानि मसलायाव मोटामुटि गोरान जानो सिम संनाय आन्ध्रनि आदब, अब्ला मसलाआ मोनफ्रोम दुकुरायाव गोबाखांयो. रोय्याला इगुरु आ लैथो सेरनि जिलाफोरनिफ्राय, नेल्लोरनिफ्राय गोदावरी आरो श्रीकाकुलाम सिम, जेराव बिलनि आरो लैथोनि इचा नाआ ओंखामजों रबिबारनि सान गेजेरनि जानाय.
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is an Andhra style of meat or prawns cooked in thick red onion masala until almost dry, so the masala sticks to each piece. Royyala iguru is from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where lake and sea prawns with rice are the Sunday midday meal.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: जोंनि हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै (कोंडा पसुपु) आ गिबियाव इचा नायाव आरो मसलायाव हाबो. तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ लैथो सेरनि न'फोरा मोजां मोननाय गोहो गोजा रं आरो गोख्रों गुदुं होयो, बेनिखायनो नोंनि जानायनि मानसिफोर नायनानै बिबांखौ फोसलाय.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our mountain turmeric powder (konda pasupu) goes first into the prawns and into the masala. Teja chilli powder gives the deep red colour and strong heat that sea-coast homes like, so choose the quantity looking at the people you are feeding.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: थियारिआव इचा नाखौ साफ खालामनाय आरो हालदैजों 10-मिनिट थादनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.885826f68de3.back: Cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric are included in preparation.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: इचा नाखौ हालदै आरो संख्रिजों हुर. सामब्राम गोजा आरो हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्ट साव, तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो धनिया गुन्दै दोन, बेनि उनाव मसलाआ बिगुर जानो सिम इचा नाखौ मसलायाव सं.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Mix the prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g इचा ना ⟦1⟧माजारि महरनि, बिगुर आरो खोमसि रान बोखारनाय, साफ खालामनायनि उनाव जोखानाय⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell and black vein removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ फिसा सामुस संख्रि ⟦1⟧रान्नानै, एबा सोवाद नायनानै⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧divided, or by tasting⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ फिसा सामुस हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु; इचा नानि थाखाय ¼ फिसा सामुस, मसलानि थाखाय ¼ फिसा सामुस⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon mountain turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧जोबोद गुदुं; माजारि गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस, गुरैनि थाखाय ½ फिसा सामुस बाहाय⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, for mild ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: इचा नानि बिगुर आरो खोमसि रान बोखार, मोजांङै सु आरो छालनियाव दै बोहैनो हो.
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the prawns' shell and black vein, wash well and drain the water in a strainer.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: इचा नाखौ खावसे हालदै आरो इसे संख्रिजों हुर; 10 मिनिट सेराव लाखि. ¼ फिसा सामुस हालदै आरो ¼ फिसा सामुस संख्रि बाहाय.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Mix the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; keep at the side 10 minutes. Use ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: मोनसे गोरोंथि कराइआव माजारि अराव थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम आरो बेसोर दोन. बेफोरा फुटियोब्ला, सोमखोर बानलु आरो करि बिलाइ दोन.
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat the oil on medium flame in a heavy kadai and add mustard. When it splutters, add green chilli and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: सामब्राम गोजाखौ थाउआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव, बेनि उनाव हादान-सामब्राम गुफुरनि पेस्टखौ संजानाय मुसुं होनो सिम. सामब्राम गोजाआ मोटामुटि 8–10 मिनिट लायो; पेस्टआ मोटामुटि 1 मिनिट, संजायि मुसुं थांनो सिम.
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onion in the oil until golden colour, then the ginger-garlic paste until it gives a cooked smell. The onion takes about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the uncooked smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: टोमाटो बाहायोब्ला, दानो दोन आरो गुदुर आरो लेबेलेबे जानो सिम सं, मोटामुटि 4 मिनिट.
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If using tomato, add it now and cook until soft and mushy, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: अरखौ गुरै खालाम. बांसिन हालदै, तेजा बानलु गुन्दै आरो धनिया गुन्दै दोन; 1 मिनिट साव. बांसिन संख्रि दोन आरो मसलाफोरा सिंथाराव गोबाखांयाखै होन्नानै लोरसोर.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Make the flame low. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so that the masala does not stick at the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: दै फोनां आरो सेरफोराव थाउआ गुबुन जानो जागायनो सिम मसलाखौ माजारि अराव सं, मोटामुटि 3–4 मिनिट.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour water and cook the masala on medium flame until oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: इचा ना दोन आरो बेफोरा बेंखेनो आरो गोलाबि जानो सिम सं, 5–6 मिनिट. गरम मसलाजों जोबनो हो. माजारि-गोहो अराव खन खन लोरसोर, अब्ला मसलाआ गोरान जानानै इचा नाखौ बिगुर जायो.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until they curl and become pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. On medium-strong flame stir now and then, so the masala becomes dry and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: संजाबाय नामा नाय: इचा नाआ गेजेर सिम गोलाबि आरो गेजेरजों नुनो हायै जायोब्ला आरो गुदुर C महराव बेंखेयोब्ला संजाबाय. सन्देहो जायोब्ला मोनसेखौ दान; गेजेराव धुसर, गेजेरजों नुनो हानाय बाहागो थानो नङा.
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check whether cooked: the prawns are cooked when pink and not see-through to the middle and curled in a soft C shape. If in doubt cut one; there should be no grey, see-through part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: संख्रिनि सोवाद नाय, धनिया बिलाइ सिखार आरो अरखौ थाद'. इचा नाआ संजानायनि उनाव संनो थाखोनो नङा, नङाब्ला बेफोरा राबार बादि जायो.
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste for salt, sprinkle coriander leaves and stop the flame. Do not keep cooking the prawns after they are cooked, otherwise they become like rubber.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजाआ जोबोद गुदुं: 1½ फिसा सामुसआ लैथो सेरनि न'फोरा मोजां मोननाय बादि जोबोद गुदुं इगुरु बानायो; माजारि गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस, एबा गुरैनि थाखाय ½ फिसा सामुस बाहाय.
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot: 1½ teaspoons makes a very hot iguru as sea-coast homes like; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for mild ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: सामब्राम गोजाखौ मोजांङै सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव; इगुरुनि रं आरो गाढाथिआ मोजांङै बादामि जानाय सामब्राम गोजानिफ्राय फैयो.
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the red onions well until golden colour; iguru's colour and thickness come from well-browned red onions.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: इचा नाआ गोख्रोंयै संजायो. गुदुर C महरआ संजाबाय बुङो; आबुं गुलुम O महरआ जोबोद संनाय आरो गोरा बुङो.
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A soft C shape says cooked; a full round O shape says overcooked and hard.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: सुनायनि उनाव इचा नाखौ मोसोनानै गोरान खालाम, अब्ला बेफोरा दैआव संनायनि सोलायाव मसलायाव सावगोन.
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing, wipe the prawns dry, so they fry in the masala instead of cooking in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: इचा नाजों लोगोसे, इसे थाउआव गुसुर खालामनाय आरो निसिनाय ½ कप गोंगुरा बिलाइ दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: together with the prawns, stir in ½ cup gongura leaves wilted and mashed in a little oil.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: नारिकल: बांसिन गुदुर, गोहो मसलानि थाखाय जोबथा 2 मिनिटआव 2 गेदेर सामुस रुखुनाय नारिकल एबा 3 गेदेर सामुस गाढा नारिकलनि गाइखेर दोन.
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a softer, deeper masala, add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: झोलनि आदब: ओंखामनि सायाव फोनांनो पातला रोय्याला कूरानि थाखाय इचा नानि उनाव ¾ कप दै दोन.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy style: for a thin royyala kura to pour on rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: भाप गोनां ओंखाम आरो सामुस मोनसे घिजों, एबा रसम एबा साम्बार ओंखामजों गुदुंयै जानो हो. बेयो चापातिजोंबो मोजां जायो.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and one spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It is also good with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 1 साननि सिङाव जा. सरायआव गुरैयै गुदुं खालाम; गोलाव समाव फिन गुदुं खालामोब्ला इचा नाआ गोरा जायो.
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Cover the extra, keep in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat gently in a pan; if heated again a long time the prawns become hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: इचा नाआ माब्ला संजायो होन्नानै माबोरै मिथिनो?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How to know when prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: बेफोरा गेजेर सिम गोलाबि आरो गेजेरजों नुनो हायै जायो आरो गुदुर C महराव बेंखेयो, सरासनस्रायै गुदुं मसलायाव 5–6 मिनिटआव. गेजेराव धुसर, गेजेरजों नुनो हानाय बाहागो थाब्ला बेफोरनो इसे बांसिन सम नांगौ.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and not see-through to the middle and curl in a soft C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in hot masala. If there is a grey, see-through part in the middle, they need a little more time.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: इगुरु आरो वेपुडुनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरुखौ सामब्राम गोजानि मसलायाव गाढा आरो मोटामुटि गोरान जानो सिम संयो, मसलाआ इचा नायाव गोबाखांनानै. वेपुडु आ भाजा, खमाय एबा सामब्राम गोजानि झोल गैयै, इचा नानि सेरफोरा खरखरा जानो सिम संनाय.
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in red onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala sticking to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, cooked with little or no red onion gravy, until the sides of the prawns are crisp.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: रोय्याला इगुरुखौ माबोरै खमाय गुदुं खालामनो?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: माजारि गुदुंनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै एबा गुरैनि थाखाय ½ फिसा सामुस बाहाय, आरो सोमखोर बानलु दोननो नङा. जोबनायाव गेदेर सामुस मोनसे दहि एबा नारिकलनि गाइखेरआबो गुदुंखौ गुरै खालामो.
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: For medium heat use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or for mild ½ teaspoon, and do not add green chilli. At the end one tablespoon of curd or coconut milk also makes the heat mild.

seg.d024c66a11b8.t: फ्रोजेन इचा ना बाहायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.d024c66a11b8.back: Can frozen prawns [इचा ना: read as prawns/shrimp] be used?

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: हागौ. बेफोरखौ फ्रिजआव गलायनो हो, दैखौ मोजांङै बोहैनो हो आरो हालदै आरो संख्रिजों हुरनायनि सिगां मोसोनानै गोरान खालाम. गोसु खालामनाय इचा नाआ बांसिन दै ओंखारो, बेनिखायनो मसलाखौ इसे बांसिन सं.
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Let them thaw in the fridge, drain the water well and wipe dry before mixing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns let out more water, so cook the masala a little more.

seg.3120e29b987a.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు · रोय्याला इगुरुनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.3120e29b987a.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు · Recipe method of Royyala Iguru | 1acrefarms

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. रोय्याला इगुरु, आन्ध्रनि लैथो सेरनि इचा ना रोस्ट: हाजोनि हालदै गुन्दै आरो जोबोद गुदुं तेजा बानलु गुन्दैजों सामब्राम गोजानि मसलायाव संनाय इचा ना. 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, Andhra's sea-coast prawn roast: prawns cooked in onion masala with mountain turmeric powder and very hot Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्याला इगुरु: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour.
