Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुंडलु आ आन्ध्रनि उरद दालनि लाडु: बायनाय उरद दालखौ बादाम बादि मुसुं होनो सिम सावनानै, गुरजों मिहि गुन्दै खालामनानै आरो गुदुं घिजों नेसेनानै गोरोबनाय. सिरा संनो नाङा, बेनिखायनो बेफोरा मोटामुटि खावसे घन्टायाव थियारि जायो. आन्ध्रनि न'फोरा संक्रान्ति आरो दिवालिनि थाखाय मोनसे टिन बानायो, गुबुन हादराव थांग्रा सुमफोरनि थाखाय पेक खालामो, आरो साहाजों बेलासिनि मिथाय महरै लाखियो.
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: split urad dal fried until it gives a nut-like smell, ground fine with jaggery and joined by pressing with hot ghee. No need to cook a syrup, so they are ready in about half an hour. Andhra homes make one tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives going to other places, and keep them as the evening sweet with tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: जोंनि ताटि बेल्लम तालनि गुरआ सुन्नुंडलुखौ गोहो बादामि रं आरो सावनाय दालजों मोजां लोगो जानाय गोहो, इसे धुवां बादि गोदैथि होयो. बे संनाय आदबआव मोटामुटि 15 लाडु जायो.
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a deep, a little smoke-like sweetness that goes well with the fried dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: गासैआव गुन्दै खालामनायनि सिगां सावनाय दालखौ गुसुनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: Letting the fried dal cool before grinding is included in the total.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: उरद दालखौ सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव, गुसुनो हो आरो मिहि गुन्दै खालाम, बेनि उनाव तालनि गुर आरो एलाचीखौ गुन्दै खालाम. गुदुं घिजों गलाय आरो लाडु बानाय.
seg.6c6369238635.back: Fry the urad dal until golden colour, let cool and grind fine, then grind the palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and make laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 कप गुफुर उरद दाल ⟦1⟧बायनाय, बिगुर गैयि (मिनपप्पु), मोटामुटि 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, without skin (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 कप रुखुनाय तालनि गुर ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 180 g, गुरै नेनानै; गिबियाव दुकुराफोरखौ सेब एबा रुखु⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed; first crush or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ कप घि ⟦1⟧गलायनाय आरो गुदुं; 1–2 गेदेर सामुस बांसिन आखायाव लाखि⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons extra at hand⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: उरद दालनि गेजेरनिफ्राय फिसा अन्थाइफोरखौ बासिनानै बोखार. बेखौ सुनो नङा; सावनो बेयो गोरान थानांगौ.
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick out the small stones from the urad dal and throw them away. Do not wash it; for frying it must stay dry.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: दालखौ मोनसे गोरोंथि सरायआव गुरै अराव दोन.
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Put the dal in a heavy pan on low flame.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: उरद दालखौ गुरै अराव सोनानि गाब आरो बादाम बादि मुसुं होनो सिम थाउ गैयै साव, मोटामुटि 10 मिनिट. सारासे लोरसोर अब्ला मोनफ्रोम बिजिआ समानै रं लागोन; बेयो सावनाय मुसुं होनांगौ आरो मोनसे बिजि हामोब्ला खट जानांगौ.
seg.65588a76c883.back: Fry the urad dal without oil on low flame until golden colour and it gives a nut-like smell, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so each grain takes colour evenly; it should give a fried smell and one grain should go 'khat' (snap) when bitten.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: दालखौ मोनसे थालियाव दोन आरो फारा. गुसुनो हो, बेनि उनाव मिहि गुन्दै खालाम. मिक्सिआ गुदुं जायाखै होन्नानै फिसा फिसा समाव गुन्दै खालाम, आरो खरखरा दुकुराफोरखौ छालनिजों बेखार लानानै फिन गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Put the dal on a plate and spread it. Let it cool, then grind fine. Grind in short times so that the mixie does not become hot, and take out the coarse pieces with a sieve and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: तालनि गुरखौ मिहि रुखु, एबा दुकुराफोरखौ उरुनआव सेब, गोरा गुटिफोरखौ बायनानै.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery fine, or crush the pieces in a mortar, breaking the hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिक्सिनि जारआव दालनि गुन्दैजों गुर आरो एलाची गुन्दै दोन. गुर आरो एलाचीखौ समानै गलायनो सिम गुन्दै खालाम. खायसे मोन गिदिंनायानो गोनां; गासैखौ मोनसे गुवार बाटियाव दोन.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal flour in the mixie jar. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom mix evenly. A few pulses are enough; put it all into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: फिसा सरायआव घिखौ गुदुं जानो सिम गलाय, नाथाय धुवां ओंखारनो नङा.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: In a small pan melt the ghee until hot, but it must not give smoke.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: गुदुं घिखौ फोनां, मोजांङै गलाय आरो फिसा लाडु नेसेनानै बानाय. गोबां घिजों जागाय, सामुसजों गलाय, बेनि उनाव आखायजों मानो हानाय गुसुयोब्ला आखाय बाहाय.
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour the hot ghee, mix well and make small laddus by pressing. Start with a lot of ghee, mix with a spoon, then when it cools enough to bear with the hand, use the hand.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: फिसा मुथा मोनसे ला आरो आखायाव गोख्रोंयै सिप, बेनि उनाव आखायनि गेजेराव गुलुम बानायनानै बोलाय. बेयो बायजोब्लायोब्ला, बाटियाव सामुस मोनसे बांसिन गुदुं घि दोन आरो गलाय.
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take one small handful and squeeze firmly in the hand, then roll into a round in the middle of the hands. If it breaks apart, add one more spoon of hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: लाखिनायनि सिगां लाडुफोरखौ गोरा जानो 15–20 मिनिट मोनसे थालियाव दोन.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Before storing, put the laddus on a plate 15–20 minutes to become hard.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: दालखौ गुरै अराव साव अब्ला बेयो सावखांयै गेजेर सिम संजायो.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Fry the dal on low flame so it cooks to the middle without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: दालखौ आबुं गुसुनायनि उनावल' गुन्दै खालाम; गुदुं दालआ मिक्सिआव पेस्ट बादि जायो.
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it is fully cool; hot dal becomes like paste in the mixie.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: गासैआ दासिमबो गुदुं थानाय समावनो लाडु बानाय; घिनि गुदुंजोंनो बेयो खोब मोजांङै फोनांजायो.
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Make the laddus while it is all still hot; with the heat of the ghee it binds very well.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: तालनि गुरनि दुकुराफोरा गोराथिआव गुबुन गुबुन, बेनिखायनो मिक्सिआव दोननायनि सिगां बेफोरखौ रुखु एबा सेबनानै फिसा खालाम.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Palm jaggery pieces differ in hardness, so grate or crush them small before putting in the mixie.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: खुसेरनि गुर: बांसिन फिका रं आरो केरामेल बादि गोदैथिनि थाखाय समान बिबांनि रुखुनाय खुसेरनि गुर बाहाय.
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a paler colour and caramel-like sweetness, use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: बिगुरजों: गामिनि खायसे न'आ बानायनाय बादि, बांसिन खोमसि आरो खरखरा सुन्नुंडलुनि थाखाय बिगुर गोनां गोसोम बायनाय उरद दाल बाहाय.
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: as some village homes make it, for darker and crunchier sunnundalu use split black urad dal with skin.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: चिनिजों: फिका रंनि, खरखरा-गलायनाय लाडुनि थाखाय गुरनि सोलायाव ¾ कप चिनि गुन्दै बाहाय.
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: for a pale-coloured, crunchy-melting laddu, use ¾ cup sugar powder instead of jaggery.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: साहा एबा कफिजों बेलासिनि मिथाय महरै, एबा संक्रान्ति आरो दिवालिनि मिथायनि थालिनि बाहागो महरै जानो हो.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as the evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: बार हाबनो हायि स्टिलनि टिनआव न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव लाखि आरो 2 सप्ताहनि सिङाव जा. गुदुं बोथोराव बेफोरा फ्रिजआव गोलाव समाय थायो; जानायनि सिगां न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथि जानो हो.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In the hot season they keep a long time in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why do my sunnundalu not keep their shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: गासैआव बांसिन गुदुं घि नांगौ, एबा बेयो गुसुबाय. सामुस मोनसे एबा नैनि घिखौ गुदुं खालाम, गलाय आरो गासैआ दासिमबो गुदुं थानाय समावनो लाडु बानाय.
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mix needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled. Heat one or two spoons of ghee, mix, and make the laddus while it is all still hot.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: तालनि गुरजों सुन्नुंडलु बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can sunnundalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: हागौ. तालनि गुरखौ (ताटि बेल्लम) मिहि रुखु एबा सेब आरो खुसेरनि गुरनि समान बिबां बाहाय. लाडुफोरा अनसाय खोमसि जायो आरो सोवादआ गोहो आरो इसे धुवां बादि जायो.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or crush the palm jaggery (tati bellam) fine and use the same quantity as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become darker and the taste becomes deep and a little smoke-like.

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: बार हाबनो हायि टिनआव न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव मोटामुटि 2 सप्ताह, आरो फ्रिजआव बांसिन सम. बेफोरखौ लानो गोरान सामुस एबा गोरान आखाय बाहाय.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hand to take them.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: बिगुरजों एबा बिगुर गैयि उरद दाल बाहायनांगौ?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should urad dal with skin or without skin be used?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आन्ध्रआव मोननैबो बानायो. गुफुर बिगुर गैयि उरद दालआ गुदुर, फिका बादामि लाडु होयो; बिगुर गोनां गोसोम उरद दालआ बांसिन खोमसि आरो खरखरा लाडु होयो.
seg.b12320430e22.back: Both are made in Andhra. White urad dal without skin gives a soft, pale brown laddu; black urad dal with skin gives a darker and crunchier laddu.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. आन्ध्रनि सुन्नुंडलु: सावनाय उरद दालखौ ताटि बेल्लम तालनि गुरजों गुन्दै खालामनानै आरो गुदुं घिजों फोनांजानानै बानायनाय लाडु. आदब आदबै बानायनाय, खामानि बाथ्रा आरो सोंनायफोर.
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra's sunnundalu: laddus made by grinding fried urad dal with tati bellam palm jaggery and binding with hot ghee. Made step by step, with tips and questions.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुंडलु: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी आ आन्ध्रनि संनाय न'फोरनि सानफ्रोमबोनि चाटनि: मिनि टोमाटोफोरखौ सावनाय दालजों थाउआव संनानै, बेनि उनाव बानलु, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो इसे तेंतेलिजों खरखरा गुन्दै खालामनाय. गोबां न'आ दासिमबो बेखौ अन्थाइ रोटियाव गुन्दै खालामो, खरखरा आरो सामुसजों जानो हानाय गाढानि थाखाय, नाथाय फिसा फिसा समाव गिदिंनाय मिक्सिआबो खामानिखौ मावो. बेयो गुदुं ओंखाम आरो घि, दोसा, इडलि आरो पेसरट्टुजों जायो.
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra cooking homes: mini (small) tomatoes cooked in oil with fried dal, then ground coarse with chilli, white onion [garlic] and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it on the stone grinder, for a coarse thickness that can be eaten with a spoon, but a mixie pulsed in bits also does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: जोंनि सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ बेखौ गोहो गोजा रं आरो थिर, माजारि गुदुं होयो, आरो टोमाटोजों इसे हालदै गुन्दै हाबो. बे संनाय आदबआव मोटामुटि 1½ कप जायो.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomato. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: गासैआव गुन्दै खालामनायनि सिगां टोमाटो गुसुनो 5 मिनिट लाफाबाय.
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: 5 minutes for the tomato to cool before grinding is included in the total.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: दाल आरो मेथिखौ थाउआव साव, टोमाटोखौ हालदै आरो संख्रिजों सं, बेनि उनाव सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो तेंतेलिजों खरखरा गुन्दै खालाम. बेसोर आरो करि बिलाइनि फोरनजों जोबनो हो.
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry the dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the tomato with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a tempering of mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 गेदेर सामुस थाउ ⟦1⟧चिनाबादाम एबा सिबिं थाउ⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ फिसा सामुस मेथि ⟦1⟧मेथिनि बिजि; बेनिख्रुइ बांसिन नङा, नङाब्ला पच्चडीआ गोखा जायो⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 माजारि टोमाटो ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 500 g, मिनि आरो गोजा, खावनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 फिसा सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧बांसिन गुदुं पच्चडीनि थाखाय 1 गेदेर सामुस सिम⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: गुलि महरनि तेंतेलि ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 5 g, बिजि बोखारनाय⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.t: ¼ कप धनिया बिलाइ (मोजां मोनोब्ला) ⟦1⟧खरखरै खावनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.back: ¼ cup coriander leaves (if you like) ⟦1⟧coarsely chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: मोनसे कराइआव माजारि-गुरै अराव 2 गेदेर सामुस थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil on medium-low flame in a kadai.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: उरद दाल, बुट दाल आरो मेथिखौ थाउआव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव; बेखार ला. बेयो 2–3 मिनिट लायो; सारासे लोरसोर, मानोना मेथिआ गोख्रोंयै सावखांयो आरो गोखा जायो.
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in the oil until golden colour; take them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, because fenugreek burns quickly and becomes bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: बेनो थाउआव, खावनाय टोमाटोफोर दोन आरो माजारि अराव मिनिट मोनसे लोरसोर.
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In that same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir one minute on medium flame.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: टोमाटोखौ हालदै आरो संख्रिजों गुदुर जानो आरो रसआ गोरान जानो सिम सं. गिबि 5 मिनिट खुबुम, बेनि उनाव खुबुमै सं, खन खन लोरसोरनानै, गासैयै मोटामुटि 12–15 मिनिट, टोमाटोफोरा लेबेलेबे जानो आरो सेरफोराव थाउ नुनो सिम.
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomato with turmeric and salt until soft and the juice is dry. First 5 minutes covered, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, in all about 12–15 minutes, until the tomatoes are mushy and oil shows at the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: अरखौ थाद', गुदुंआव गुदुर जानो तेंतेलि दोननानै लोरसोर, आरो गासैखौ मोटामुटि 5 मिनिट गुसुनो हो.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Stop the flame, add the tamarind and stir so it becomes soft in the heat, and let it all cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: अन्थाइ रोटि एबा मिक्सिनि जारआव, गिबियाव सावनाय दाल आरो मेथिखौ खरखरा गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.c1820dcae462.back: In a stone grinder or mixie jar, first grind the fried dal and fenugreek coarsely.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: दाल, सामब्राम गुफुर, तेंतेलि, बानलु गुन्दै आरो टोमाटोखौ खरखरै गुन्दै खालाम. मिक्सिआव, दालनि गुन्दैआव सामब्राम गुफुर, बानलु गुन्दै आरो संनाय टोमाटो दोन आरो दै गैयै 4–5 मोन फिसा फिसा गिदिं; खरखरा थानाय समावनो थाद'. धनिया बिलाइ, बाहायोब्ला, दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind the dal, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomato coarsely. In the mixie, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomato to the dal powder and pulse little by little 4–5 times without water; stop while it is still coarse. Add coriander leaves, if using, and stir.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: सोवाद नाय आरो समान खालाम: इसे बांसिन संख्रि, एबा बांसिन गुदुं नांब्ला इसे बांसिन बानलु गुन्दै दोननानै गिदिं.
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and make equal: a little more salt, or if more heat is needed add a little more chilli powder and pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडीखौ मोनसे बाटियाव दोन. फिसा सरायआव 1 गेदेर सामुस थाउखौ गुदुं खालाम आरो बेसोर दोन; फुटियोब्ला, उरद दाल दोन आरो सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Put the pachadi in a bowl. In a small pan heat 1 tablespoon oil and add mustard; when it splutters, add urad dal and fry until golden colour.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: गोजा बानलु, हिंग आरो करि बिलाइ दोन आरो सेकेन्ड खायसे लोरसोर.
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chilli, hing and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: बेसोर, गोजा बानलु आरो करि बिलाइजों फोरन हो; सायाव फोनां. जानो होनायनि सिगांसो गलाय.
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Temper with mustard, red chilli and curry leaves; pour on top. Mix only just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: टोमाटोनि रसआ गोरान जानो सिम सं, अब्ला पच्चडीआ गोलाव समाय थायो आरो संजायि सोवाद मोनाखै.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook until the tomato juice is dry, then the pachadi keeps a long time and does not taste uncooked.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: मिनि, गोहो गोजा टोमाटोआ खोब मोजां रं होयो; नोंनि टोमाटोआ खाखि जायोब्ला, तेंतेलिखौ खावसे खालाम.
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour, make the tamarind half.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: फिसा फिसा गिदिं, मिक्सिखौ गोलाव समाय गिदिंनो नङा: खरखरा पच्चडीनो आन्ध्रनि न'फोरा मोजां मोनो, आरो गुदुर पेस्टआ बे खरखरा महरखौ गोमायो.
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse in bits, do not run the mixie long: Andhra homes like coarse pachadi, and a smooth paste loses that coarse texture.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ माजारि गुदुं होयो. 2 फिसा सामुसजों जागाय आरो सोवाद नायनायनि उनाव बांसिन दोन; पच्चडीआ थायोब्ला गुदुंआ इसे गुरै जायो.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and add more after tasting; when the pachadi rests the heat becomes a little mild.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: सोमखोर बानलु: बानलु गुन्दैनि सोलायाव दालफोरजों सावनाय 4–5 सोमखोर बानलु बाहाय.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder use 4–5 green chillies fried with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: सामब्राम गोजा-टोमाटो: टोमाटो दोननायनि सिगां 1 दानजानाय सामब्राम गोजाखौ गुदुर जानो सिम साव.
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding the tomato, fry 1 cut onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: बांसिन गुदुं: 1 फिसा सामुस सन्नमनि सोलायाव 1 फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय; तेजाआ जोबोद गुदुं, बेनिखायनो गुरैयै दोन.
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of 1 teaspoon Sannam; Teja is very hot, so add it slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: सामब्राम गुफुर गैयै: सामब्राम गुफुरखौ बोखार आरो फोरनआव इसे बांसिन हिंग दोन.
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: throw out the garlic and add a little more hing in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: सामुस मोनसे इसे घिजों गुदुं ओंखामआव गलाय, एबा दोसा, इडलि, पेसरट्टु एबा उपमानि सेराव जानो हो.
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix one spoon with a little ghee into hot rice, or serve at the side of dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: बेखौ मोनसे साफ, गोरान काँचनि जारआव फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 4 साननि सिङाव जा. सारासे गोरान सामुस बाहाय.
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: उरद दाल, बुट दाल आरो मेथिखौ थाउआव साव, खावनाय टोमाटोखौ हालदै आरो संख्रिजों रसआ गोरान जानो सिम सं, बेनि उनाव गासैखौ बानलु गुन्दै, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो तेंतेलिजों खरखरा गुन्दै खालाम. बेसोर, गोजा बानलु आरो करि बिलाइनि फोरनजों जोबनो हो.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook chopped tomato with turmeric and salt until the juice is dry, then grind it all coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a tempering of mustard, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: सरासनस्रायै मेथिआ सावखांबाय एबा जोबोद बांसिन जाबाय. 500 g टोमाटोनि थाखाय ¼ फिसा सामुसल' बाहाय आरो माजारि-गुरै अराव साव, सोनानि गाब जायोब्लाबो बेखार ला.
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually the fenugreek burnt or there was too much. For 500 g tomato use only ¼ teaspoon and fry on medium-low flame, taking it out as soon as it is golden colour.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: तेंतेलि गैयै टोमाटो पच्चडी बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can tomato pachadi be made without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: हागौ, नोंनि टोमाटोआ गोनां खाखि जायोब्ला. संनायनि उनाव सोवाद नाय; मिनि, गोदै टोमाटोनो समान खालामनो तेंतेलिनि फिसा दुकुराखौ नांगौ.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need a small piece of tamarind to make it equal.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How long does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: मोनसे साफ, गोरान जारआव फ्रिजआव मोटामुटि 4 सान, टोमाटोफोरखौ मोजांङै संनाय जायोब्ला आरो नों गोरान सामुस बाहायोब्ला.
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, if the tomatoes were cooked well and you use a dry spoon.

seg.4dbd4103e7fb.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి · टोमाटो पच्चडीनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.4dbd4103e7fb.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి · Recipe method of tomato pachadi | 1acrefarms

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. आन्ध्रनि टोमाटो पच्चडी: हालदै गुन्दैजों संनाय टोमाटो, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो तेंतेलिजों खरखरा गुन्दै खालामनानै, बेनि उनाव फोरन होनाय.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra's tomato pachadi: tomato cooked with turmeric powder, ground coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टोमाटो पच्चडी: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.6357099a14e8.back: ¼ cup coriander leaves (if you like)

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आ आन्ध्रनि न'फोरनि सानफ्रोमबोनि दाल: अरहर दाल (कंडि पप्पु) खौ टोमाटो आरो सोमखोर बानलुजों गुदुर जानो सिम संनानै, गुदुरै निसिनानै आरो सामब्राम गुफुरनि फोरनजों जोबनो होनाय. बेखौ सप्ताहनि गोबां सानाव संयो आरो गुदुं ओंखाम, सामुस मोनसे घि आरो सेराव अप्पडम एबा आसारजों जायो.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked until soft with tomato and green chilli, mashed softly and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked many days of the week and eaten with hot rice, one spoon of ghee and appadam or pickle at the side.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: जोंनि हालदै गुन्दैआ दालजों लोगोसे कुकारआव हाबो आरो बेखौ गोहो गोमो रं होयो. सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ गोजा रं आरो खाखि टोमाटोनि उनाव थानाय थिर, माजारि गुदुं होयो. बे संनाय आदबआ 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker together with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder gives red colour and a steady, medium heat that stays after the sour tomato. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: गासैआव कुकारनि भाप ओंखारनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: Letting the cooker's steam come out is included in the total.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: अरहर दालखौ टोमाटो, सोमखोर बानलु आरो हालदै गुन्दैजों प्रेसार कुकारआव सं, सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों निसि, आरो सामब्राम गुफुर आरो बेसोरनि फोरनजों जोबनो हो.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook the toor dal in the pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a tempering of garlic and mustard.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ कप अरहर दाल ⟦1⟧कंडि पप्पु, मोटामुटि 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ फिसा सामुस हालदै गुन्दै ⟦1⟧कुकारआव हाबो⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes into the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 फिसा सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧निसिनायनि उनाव हाबो; बांसिन गुदुंनि थाखाय 2 फिसा सामुस सिम⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ कप दै ⟦1⟧आरो समान खालामनो ½ कप⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup to make equal (adjust)⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 गेदेर सामुस तेंतेलिनि दै (मोजां मोनोब्ला) ⟦1⟧टोमाटोआ जोबोद खाखि नङाब्ला⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (if you like) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: अरहर दालखौ 2–3 मोन दै सोलायनानै सु आरो दैखौ बोहैनो हो.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal changing the water 2–3 times and drain the water.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: दालखौ टोमाटो, सोमखोर बानलु, सामब्राम गोजा आरो 2½ कप दैजों प्रेसार कुकारआव दोन.
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with the tomato, green chilli, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: दालखौ टोमाटो, सोमखोर बानलु आरो हालदै गुन्दैजों 4 सिटि जानो सिम प्रेसार कुकारआव सं. खुबुमखौ बन्द खालामनायनि सिगां हालदै गुन्दैखौ दैआव गलाय, बेनि उनाव माजारि अराव सं.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder in the pressure cooker until 4 whistles. Before closing the lid, mix the turmeric powder into the water, then cook on medium flame.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: प्रेसारखौ गावनो गावनो खमायनो हो, मोटामुटि 10 मिनिट. मोनसे बिजिआ आसि नैनि गेजेराव आबुं निसिजायोब्ला दालआ संजाबाय.
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure come down by itself, about 10 minutes. The dal is cooked when one grain fully mashes between two fingers.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: मोजांङै निसि; बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रि दोन. बोंफांनि निसिग्रा (पप्पु गुत्ति) एबा हातानि उनथिं बाहाय आरो दालआ दासिमबो गुदुं थानाय समावनो निसि, टोमाटो आरो दालआ मोनसे गुदुर गासै जानो सिम.
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until tomato and dal become one soft whole.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: इसे दैजों 5 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं. फोनांनो हानाय पातलाथिनि थाखाय ½ कप सिम दै, आरो बाहायोब्ला तेंतेलिनि दै दोन, आरो सिंथाराव गोबाखांयाखै होन्नानै अरखौ गुरै दोन.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Simmer 5 minutes on low fire with a little water. For a pourable thinness add water up to ½ cup, and tamarind water if using, and keep the fire low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: संख्रि आरो खाखिनि सोवाद नाय, बेनि उनाव धनिया बिलाइ दोननानै लोरसोर आरो अरखौ थाद'.
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste for salt and sourness, then add coriander leaves, stir and stop the flame.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: फिसा सरायआव माजारि अराव घिखौ गुदुं खालाम आरो बेसोर दोन; फुटिनो हो.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: In a small pan heat the ghee on medium flame and add mustard; let it splutter.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: बेसोर, जिरा, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो करि बिलाइखौ घिआव साव; सायाव फोनां. बेसोरनि उनाव जिरा, सामब्राम गुफुर आरो गोरान गोजा बानलु दोन आरो सामब्राम गुफुरआ सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव, बेनि उनाव करि बिलाइ आरो हिंग दोन, आरो छिं छिं जानाय फोरनखौ दालनि सायाव फोनां.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour on top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dry red chilli and fry until the garlic is golden colour, then add curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering on top of the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: फोरनआ दालखौ सोवाद होनो 2 मिनिट खुबुम, बेनि उनाव लोरसोर आरो गुदुंयै जानो हो.
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so the tempering gives taste to the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: गुदुर पप्पुनि थाखाय दालखौ गुदुं थानाय समावनो निसि. गुसुयोब्ला बिजिफोरा गोरा जायो आरो गुटि गुटि थायो.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For a soft pappu mash the dal while it is still hot. When it cools the grains become hard and stay in lumps.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैआ माजारि गुदुं. 1 फिसा सामुसजों जागाय; बांसिन गुदुं पप्पुनि थाखाय 2 फिसा सामुस सिम दोन.
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium heat. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu add up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: मिनि, खाखि गामिनि टोमाटो (नाटु टोमाटो) आ खोब मोजां सोवाद होयो; गुरै हाइब्रिड टोमाटोजों तेंतेलिनि दै दोन.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour village tomatoes (natu tomato) give the best taste; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: करि बिलाइ दोननायनि सिगां फोरनआव सामब्राम गुफुरखौ सोनानि गाब जानो हो; फिका सामब्राम गुफुरआ संजायि सोवाद मोनो.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Let the white onion [garlic] become golden colour in the tempering before adding curry leaves; pale white onion [garlic] tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा बानलु गुन्दै: बांसिन गुदुं पप्पुनि थाखाय सन्नमनि सोलायाव ½ फिसा सामुस तेजा बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय. तेजाआ जोबोद गुदुं, बेनिखायनो 1 फिसा सामुसनिख्रुइ बांसिन दोननो नङा.
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu use ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not add more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकुरा टोमाटो पप्पु: निसिनायनि उनाव दालआव 2 कप खावनाय पालं दोन आरो 5 मिनिट गुरै अराव फुदुं.
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and boil on low flame 5 minutes.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: गोमो मुग दालजों बानाय आरो 2 सिटिल' सं.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook only 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: भाप गोनां ओंखाम, सामुस मोनसे घि आरो सेराव अप्पडम एबा आवकायाजों गुदुंयै जानो हो. बेयो चापातिजोंबो मोजां जायो.
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with steamed rice, one spoon of ghee and appadam or avakaya at the side. It is also good with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. गुसुयोब्ला दालआ गाढा जायो; जानो होनायनि सिगां इसे गुदुं दै दोन आरो गेजेर सिम गुदुं खालाम.
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within 2 days. When cold the dal becomes thick; before serving add a little hot water and heat it to the centre.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: प्रेसार कुकारआव अरहर दालनि थाखाय माखाव सिटि?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in the pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: माजारि अराव मोटामुटि 4 सिटि, बेनि उनाव प्रेसारखौ गावनो गावनो खमायनो हो. गोजाम दाल एबा मोजांङै सुयै थानाय दालनि थाखाय 5 नांनो हागौ.
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium flame, then let the pressure come down by itself. For old dal or dal that was not washed well [suyai] 5 may be needed.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आरो साम्बारनि गेजेराव मा फाराग?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टोमाटो पप्पु आ सादा फोरन गोनां गाढा, निसिनाय दाल, साम्बार गुन्दै एबा मैगं गैयै. साम्बारआ बांसिन पातला, तेंतेलि, मैगं आरो सावनाय मसला गुन्दै बाहायो.
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with simple tempering, without sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: प्रेसार कुकार गैयै टोमाटो पप्पु बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can tomato pappu be made without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: हागौ. दालखौ 30 मिनिट हुब आरो खुबुम गोनां हाण्डिआव 3½ कप दैजों मोटामुटि 40–45 मिनिट सं, खन खन लोरसोरनानै, बेयो अंखाबै निसिजानो सिम.
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a pot with a lid with 3½ cups water about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: आंनि टोमाटो पप्पुआ मानो जोबोद खाखि?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why is my tomato pappu very sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: खायसे टोमाटो जोबोद खाखि. दालखौ गुबुन मिनिट खायसे गुरै अराव फुदुं आरो समान खालामनो इसे गुर एबा सामुस मोनसे बांसिन निसिनाय दाल दोननानै लोरसोर.
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Boil the dal a few more minutes on low flame and to make it equal stir in a little jaggery or one more spoon of mashed dal.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: టమాటో పప్పు · आन्ध्रनि टोमाटो दालनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: టమాటో పప్పు · Recipe method of Andhra tomato dal | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. आन्ध्रनि टोमाटो दाल: टोमाटो आरो सोमखोर बानलु, जोंनि हालदै आरो सन्नम बानलु गुन्दैजों गुदुर जानो सिम संनाय अरहर दाल, आरो सामब्राम गुफुरनि फोरन. 4 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra's tomato dal: toor dal cooked until soft with tomato and green chilli, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: टोमाटो पप्पु: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · वेल्लुल्ली कारम · लहसुन की सूखी चटनी
seg.9078b361da10.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Karam · lahsun ki sukhi chutney [Hindi]

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम आ आन्ध्रनि जानायनि टेबुलाव थानाय सामब्राम गुफुर-बानलुनि पोडि: गोजा बानलु गुन्दैखौ गोबां सामब्राम गुफुर, सावनाय धनिया आरो जिरा, आरो संख्रिजों सेबनाय. घिजों गुदुं ओंखामनि गिबि मुथायाव गलायनानै, एबा इसे थाउजों इडलि आरो दोसानि सायाव सिखारनानै, बेयो खामानि गोबां सानाव गोख्रों जानाय आरो टिफिन बाकसोनि सारासे थानाय मुवा.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is the garlic-chilli podi that sits on Andhra meal tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, fried coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled with a little oil on top of idli and dosa, it is the quick meal of many everyday days and an always-there item of the tiffin box.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: जोंनि तेजा बानलु गुन्दैआ बेखौ गोहो गोजा आरो जोबोद गुदुं खालामो, गुन्टुरनि न'फोरा मोजां मोननाय बादि. खमाय गुदुंनि थाखाय, खावसे सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय.
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, as Guntur homes like. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: गासैआव गुन्दै खालामनायनि सिगां बिजि आरो सामब्राम गुफुरखौ गुसुनो होनाया लाफाबाय.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: Letting the seeds and garlic cool before grinding is included in the total.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धनिया आरो जिराखौ साव, गुन्दै खालाम, बेनि उनाव तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, संख्रि आरो इसे गुदुं खालामनाय सामब्राम गुफुरजों खरखरा पोडि जानो सिम फिसा फिसा गिदिं. बेखौ गुदुं ओंखाम आरो घि, इडलि एबा दोसाजों जा.
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Fry the coriander and cumin, grind, then pulse little by little with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly heated garlic until a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 सामब्राम गुफुरनि खोंसे ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि ½ कप, बिगुर एखेरनाय; गेजेरनि पातला बिगुरआ थानो हागौ⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, skin peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ कप तेजा बानलु गुन्दै ⟦1⟧जोबोद गुदुं; गुरै खालामनो खामानि बाथ्राफोर नाय⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it mild⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 फिसा गुलि महरनि तेंतेलि (मोजां मोनोब्ला) ⟦1⟧गोरान, बिजि बोखारनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: 1 small marble-sized tamarind (if you like) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: घि एबा थाउ ⟦1⟧मोनफ्रोम जानायनि थाखाय 1 फिसा सामुस⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for each meal⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: सामब्राम गुफुरनि बिगुर एखेर आरो खोंसेफोरखौ मोनसे सिजों आबुं गोरान जानो सिम मोसो; जायखिजाय दैआ पोडि थानाय समखौ खमायो.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic skin and wipe the cloves with a cloth until fully dry; any water reduces how long the podi keeps.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: धनिया आरो जिरानि बिजिखौ मुसुं होनो सिम थाउ गैयै साव; गुसुनो हो. माजारि-गुरै अराव मोनसे फिसा सराय बाहाय; बेयो 1–2 मिनिट लायो, आरो धनियाआ इसेल' खोमसि जानांगौ, बादामि नङा.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Fry the coriander and cumin seeds without oil until they give smell; let cool. Use a small pan on medium-low flame; it takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should become only a little dark, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: सामब्राम गुफुरखौ 1 फिसा सामुस थाउआव 2 मिनिट गुदुं खालाम. अरखौ गुरै दोन आरो लोरसोर; खोंसेफोरा बादामि जायै सेरफोराव इसे गुदुर जानांगौ. गुसुनो हो.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Heat the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil 2 minutes. Keep the flame low and stir; the cloves should become a little soft at the edges without becoming brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: बिजिफोरखौ गुन्दै खालाम, बेनि उनाव बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों फिसा फिसा गिदिं. तेंतेलि बाहायोब्ला बिजिफोरजों लोगोसे दोन, अब्ला बेयो समानै बायगोन.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds, then pulse little by little with the chilli powder and salt. If using tamarind add it together with the seeds, so it breaks evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: सामब्राम गुफुर दोन आरो खरखरा, सेंसेरनाय गुन्दै जानो सिम फिसा फिसा समाव गिदिं. 2–3 मोन गिदिंनायनि उनाव थाद' आरो जारनि सेरफोरखौ गुरनानै ला, मानोना सामब्राम गुफुरआ सेरफोराव गोबाखांयो.
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and pulse in short times until a coarse, damp powder. After 2–3 pulses stop and scrape the sides of the jar, because the garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: अन्थाइनि उरुनआव, गिबियाव बिजिफोरखौ सेब, बेनि उनाव सामब्राम गुफुरखौ संख्रिजों, आरो जोबथायाव बानलु गुन्दैखौ गलाय.
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar, first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and last mix in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: इसे ओंखाम आरो घिजों इसे सोवाद नाय, आरो नांब्ला संख्रि दोन.
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: भापआ ओंखारनो पोडिखौ मोनसे थालियाव 10 मिनिट फारा, बेनि उनाव मोनसे साफ, गोरान जारआव दोन.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi on a plate 10 minutes for the steam to come out, then put it in a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजाआ जोबोद गुदुं; गुरै पोडिनि थाखाय खावसे सन्नम बाहाय, एबा समान सामब्राम गुफुरनि थाखाय बानलु गुन्दैखौ 3 गेदेर सामुस सिम खमाय.
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a mild podi use half Sannam, or for the same garlic reduce the chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: सामब्राम गुफुरखौ मोजांङै गोरान खालाम आरो थाउआव गुदुं खालाम; सेंसेरनाय सामब्राम गुफुरआ पोडिखौ गोख्रोंयै गाज्रि खालामो.
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and heat it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi spoil (gajri) quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: फिसा फिसा गिदिं, मिक्सिखौ गोलाव समाय गिदिंनो नङा: गोलाव समाय गिदिंब्ला सामब्राम गुफुरआ पेस्ट जायो.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse little by little, do not run the mixie a long time: if run a long time the garlic becomes paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: मोनसे कप गुदुं ओंखामआव 1 फिसा सामुस पोडि आरो 1 फिसा सामुस घि गलाय; सोवाद नायनानै समान खालाम.
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: In one cup of hot rice mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee; make equal by tasting.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: दालजों: बांसिन बादाम बादि, इसे गुरै पोडिनि थाखाय बिजिफोरजों 1 गेदेर सामुस बुट दाल आरो 1 गेदेर सामुस उरद दालखौ थाउ गैयै साव.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dal: for a more nut-like, a little milder podi, fry 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal without oil with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: संजायि सामब्राम गुफुर: बांसिन गोख्रों सोवादनि थाखाय सामब्राम गुफुरखौ गुदुं खालामनो नङा, आरो बेखौ सप्ताह मोनसेनि सिङाव जा.
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Uncooked garlic: for a stronger taste do not heat the garlic, and eat it within one week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: माजारि गुदुं: 2 गेदेर सामुस तेजा आरो 2 गेदेर सामुस सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय.
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: use 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: घिजों गुदुं ओंखामनि गिबि मुथायाव गलाय, एबा इसे थाउ एबा घिजों इडलि, दोसा एबा पेसरट्टुनि सायाव सिखार.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkle with a little oil or ghee on top of idli, dosa or pesarattu.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: मोनसे साफ, गोरान, बार हाबनो हायि जारआव न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव मोटामुटि 2 सप्ताह, एबा फ्रिजआव दान मोनसे लाखि. सारासे गोरान सामुस बाहाय.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: In a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or keep in the fridge one month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: धनिया आरो जिरानि बिजिखौ साव, गुन्दै खालाम, बानलु गुन्दै आरो संख्रि दोन, बेनि उनाव बिगुर एखेरनाय सामब्राम गुफुरनि खोंसेफोरखौ खरखरा, सेंसेरनाय गुन्दै जानो सिम फिसा फिसा गिदिं. आन्ध्रनि न'फोरा सरासनस्रायै बेखौ अन्थाइनि उरुनआव सेबो.
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Fry the coriander and cumin seeds, grind, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse the peeled garlic cloves little by little until a coarse, damp powder. Andhra homes usually pound it in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: सामब्राम गुफुरनि पोडिखौ माबोरै खमाय गुदुं खालामनो?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: खावसे तेजानि सोलायाव खावसे सन्नम बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय, एबा गासैयै 3 गेदेर सामुस बानलु गुन्दै बाहाय. गोबां घिजों जानायाबो गुदुंखौ खमायो.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Use half Sannam chilli powder instead of half the Teja, or use 3 tablespoons chilli powder in all. Eating with plenty of ghee also reduces the heat.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How long does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: गोरान, बार हाबनो हायि जारआव न'नि सिङाव गुदुंथिआव मोटामुटि 2 सप्ताह, एबा फ्रिजआव दान मोनसे. सामब्राम गुफुरखौ मोजांङै गोरान खालाम आरो गिबियाव थाउआव गुदुं खालाम अब्ला बेयो गोलाव समाय थागोन.
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar at room temperature, or one month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil, then it will keep a long time.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: बानलु गुन्दैनि सोलायाव आबुं गोरान गोजा बानलु बाहायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can whole dry red chillies be used instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: हागौ. मोटामुटि 20 गोरान गोजा बानलुखौ इसे थाउजों खरखरा जानो सिम साव, गुसुनो हो आरो सामब्राम गुफुर दोननायनि सिगां गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Fry about 20 dry red chillies in a little oil until crisp, let cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.a2202c094baa.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం · वेल्लुल्ली कारमनि संनाय आदब | 1acrefarms
seg.a2202c094baa.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం · Recipe method of Vellulli Karam | 1acrefarms

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. आन्ध्रनि सामब्राम गुफुर-बानलुनि पोडि: सावनाय धनिया आरो जिराखौ सामब्राम गुफुर, संख्रि आरो तेजा बानलु गुन्दैजों सेबनाय. गुदुं ओंखाम आरो घि, एबा इडलि आरो दोसाजों गलाय.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra's garlic-chilli podi: fried coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम: 1acrefarmsनि संनाय आदबनि कार्ड, मुवा आरो आदबजों
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: दाव बेदोरखौ दहि, तेजा बानलु गुन्दै, हालदै गुन्दै आरो संख्रिजों हुर. 30 मिनिट थादनो हो. बाटिखौ खुबुम आरो थादनाय समायाव बेखौ फ्रिजआव लाखि.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Let it rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge during the resting time.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g नानि दुकुरा ⟦1⟧गोसो दानजानाय गोरा ना: रोहु, कातला (बोच्चा), कोरामीनु (सौल ना) एबा सुरमाइ (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧thick-cut firm fish: rohu, katla (boccha), korameenu (saul fish) or surmai (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g तेंतेलि ⟦1⟧नेमु महरनि मोटामुटि गुटि मोननै, 2 कप गुदुं दैआव 15 मिनिट हुबनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups hot water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. सरायआव लोरसोरनो नङा, गुरैयै गुदुं खालाम, गासैबो गेजेर सिम भाप ओंखारनो सिम.
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Do not stir in the pan, heat gently, until steam comes out all the way to the centre.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: गोसो दानजानाय गोरा दैमानि एबा लैथोनि ना: रोहु, कातला (बोच्चा), सौल ना (कोरामीनु) एबा सुरमाइ. गोबां बेगेर गोनां फिसा नाफोरबो जायो, नाथाय गुरैयै बाहायनांगौ.
seg.379b410c6994.back: Thick-cut firm river or sea fish: rohu, katla (boccha), saul fish (korameenu) or surmai. Small fish with many bones also work, but must be used carefully.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 साननि सिङाव जा. पुलुसुखौ मोनसे सरायआव इसे दैजों गुदुं खालाम, गासैबो गेजेर सिम भाप ओंखारनो सिम.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water, until steam comes out all the way to the centre.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g बेगेर गैयि बरमा बेदोरखौ फोथेरनाय मसला आरो ½ कप दैजों प्रेसार कुकारआव 5–6 सिटि जानो सिम, गुदोमनो सिम सं, बेनि उनाव समान आदबै साव.
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless goat meat with ground masala and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker until 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: मोननैबो जायो. बेगेर गैयिआ गोख्रोंयै संजायो आरो बांसिन खरखरा जायो; फिसा बेगेर थानाय दुकुराफोराव बांसिन सोवाद दं नाथाय बेफोरनि रसआव 6–8 मिनिट बांसिन नांगौ.
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crunchier; pieces with a little bone have more flavour but need 6–8 more minutes in their juice.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: लान्स बाक्सो एबा गोजान नङै दाबायनि थाखाय बान्दोब लाब्ला मोटामुटि 4 घन्टानि सिङाव जा. बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो सान मोनसेनि सिङाव जा.
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If packing for a lunch box or a far journey, eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: नेमुनि रसखौ संनाय जायो एबा हालदैआ थाउआव सावखांबाय. हालदैखौ जोबनायाव दोन, बेनि उनाव तोब्लानो अरखौ थाद' आरो 5–10 सेकेन्ड सिम लोरसोर; नेमुनि रसखौ अरनिफ्राय बेखार लानानै ओंखामआव दोन.
seg.bc9078e02646.back: The lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric at the end, then immediately turn off the fire and stir only 5–10 seconds; taking it off the fire, add the lemon juice to the rice.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: बांसिन कप मोनसे दैखौ गाहाय गोरोंथि सरायाव फोनां; पातला सरायाव रागीआ गाहायाव गोरलैयै गोजोम जायो.
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Add [फोनां unclear: or put / pour in?] one extra [बांसिन: or 'more'?] cup of water in a heavy-bottomed [or: thick-bottomed] pan [सराय: or vessel/pot]; in a thin pan the ragi easily sticks [गोजोम unclear: or catches / burns / goes lumpy?] at the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: रागी जावायाव खुसेरनि गुर बाहायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be used in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: हागौ. समान बिबां रुखुनाय खुसेरनि गुर (चेरुकु बेल्लम) ला आरो अरखौ थादनायनि उनाव दोननानै लोरसोर, अब्ला गाइखेरआ बायाखै. बेयो अनसाय फिका रं आरो गुरैयै, कारामेल बादि गोदैथि होयो.
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery and add it after turning off the fire and stir, so the milk does not split. It gives a slightly pale colour and a gentle, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 1 साननि सिङाव जा. सरायआव गासैबो गेजेर सिम भाप ओंखारनो सिमल' गुदुं खालाम; गोलाव समाय गुदुं खालामोब्ला इचा नाफोरा गोरा जायो.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftover, keep it in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until steam comes out all the way to the centre; if heated a long time the prawns become hard.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: खुसेरनि गुरजों सुन्नुंडलु बानायनो हागोन नामा?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can sunnundalu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: हागौ. खुसेरनि गुरखौ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) मिहि रुखु आरो तालनि गुरनि समान बिबां बाहाय. लाडुफोरा अनसाय फिका रं जायो, आरो गोदैथिआ गुरैयै, कारामेल बादि जायो.
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate the sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus become slightly pale in colour, and the sweetness gentle, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: संजायि सामब्राम गुफुर: बांसिन गोख्रों सोवादनि थाखाय सामब्राम गुफुरखौ गुदुं खालामनो नङा; बेखौ फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 3 साननि सिङाव जा.
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw white onion [garlic]: for a stronger taste do not heat the garlic; keep it in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: मोनसे साफ, गोरान, बार हाबनो हायि जारआव फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो 2 सप्ताहनि सिङाव बाहाय. सारासे गोरान सामुस बाहाय.
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: गोरान, बार हाबनो हायि जारआव फ्रिजआव 2 सप्ताह सिम. सामब्राम गुफुरखौ मोजांङै गोरान खालाम आरो गिबियाव थाउआव गुदुं खालाम, आरो सारासे गोरान सामुस बाहाय.
seg.367798df40e3.back: In a dry, airtight jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks. Dry the garlic well and first heat it in oil, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: हागौ. मोटामुटि 20 गोरान गोजा बानलुखौ इसे थाउआव खरखरा जानो सिम साव, गुसुनो हो आरो सामब्राम गुफुर दोननायनि सिगां गुन्दै खालाम.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dry red chillies in a little oil until crisp, let cool and powder them before adding the garlic.

seg.c473a3556357.back: Sweet of Andhra · for 2 people · 10 minutes

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(poha tasty with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलुआ तेलुगु न'फोरनि 10 मिनिटनि मिथाय. बेयो कृष्णाष्टमीयाव कृष्णनो होनाय पोहा, जाय कुचेलनि होनाय मुवाखौ गोसोखांहोयो, आरो बेयो फरायसालिनिफ्राय फैनायनि उनाव गथ'फोरनि थाखाय गोख्रों मिथायबो. पोहाखौ दैजों सुनायसो, दैयाव जेबो संनाय नङा, बेनि उनाव बेखौ गुदुं गुरनि रसआव लोरसोरनाय जायो.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha given to Krishna on Krishnashtami, which reminds of the gift Kuchela gave, and it is also a quick sweet for children after coming from school. The poha is only washed with water, nothing is cooked in water, after that it is mixed into warm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: जोंनि ताटि बेल्लम तालनि गुरआ बेखौ गोहो बादामि गाब आरो गोहो, इसे धुवां बादि गोदैथि होयो. बे संनाय आदबआ 2 मानसिनि थाखाय.
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our thati bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a deep, slightly smoke-like sweetness. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: थियारिआव सुनाय पोहा गुदुर जानो 5 मिनिट लाफाबाय.
seg.25e28614accb.back: In preparation, 5 minutes are needed for the washed poha to become soft.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: मोटा पोहाखौ गुदुर खालाम, नारिकल आरो एलाचीजों गुदुं तालनि गुरनि रसआव लोरसोर, आरो घिजों जोबनो खालाम.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Make the thick poha soft, mix it in warm palm-jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ कप रुखुनाय तालनि गुर ⟦1⟧मोटामुटि 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧from the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ फिसा सामुस एलाची गुन्दै ⟦1⟧एबा 2–3 एलाचीनि सुंनाय बिजि⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.5f1854fd1277.t: 6–8 खाजु, लुबैयोब्ला ⟦1⟧घियाव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम सावनाय⟦/1⟧
seg.5f1854fd1277.back: 6–8 cashews, if you wish ⟦1⟧fried in ghee until gold colour⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: पोहाखौ मोनसे छाकनियाव दोन आरो बिगुरनि फिसा फिसाफोरखौ बासिनानै ला.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the poha in a strainer and pick out the small bits of husk.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: पोहाखौ छाकनियाव लाखिनानै बोहैनो थानाय दैयाव सेकेन्ड खायसे सु, दैखौ गोग्लैनो हो, आरो गुदुर जानो 5 मिनिट लाखि. नेनोब्ला बेयो गुदुर मोननांगौ, नाथाय दै थानाय नङा.
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Keeping the poha in the strainer, wash it under flowing water for a few seconds, let the water drain, and keep it 5 minutes to become soft. When pressed it should feel soft, but there should be no water.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: तालनि गुरखौ मिहिनै रुखु, गोरा गेदेर दानायफोरखौ सिफायनानै.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking the hard big lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: तालनि गुरखौ 2 गेदेर सामुस दैजों गुरै अराव गलाय, बेनि उनाव छाक. सरायखौ साफा खालाम आरो रसखौ फिन बेयाव फोनां.
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low fire, then strain. Clean the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: नों खाजु बाहायोब्ला, बेफोरखौ इसे घियाव सोनानि गाब जानो सिम साव.
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If you use cashews, fry them in a little ghee until gold colour.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: गुदुं रसआव पोहा, नारिकल आरो एलाची दोन आरो गुरै अराव 1–2 मिनिट लासै लासै लोरसोर, मोनफ्रोम पोहा रसजों गाननो सिम. पोहाफोरा बायाखै थाखाय गुरैयै लोरसोर.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Put poha, coconut and cardamom in the warm syrup and mix slowly on low fire for 1–2 minutes, until every poha is coated with syrup. Mix gently so the poha does not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: पोहाफोरा रसजों गाननायजोंनो सरायखौ अरनिफ्राय बेखार ला; गोलाव समाव संब्ला बेफोरा रबर बादि गोरा जायो.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the poha is coated with syrup, take the pan off the fire; if cooked for a long time they become hard like rubber.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: घि आरो खाजुजों जोबनो खालाम. गुदुंयै एबा न'नि सिङाव साधारण गुदुंथिआव जानो हो.
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finish with ghee and cashew. Give to eat warm or at normal room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: मोटा पोहा बाहाय. पातला पोहाआ रसआव जोबोद गुदुर आरो गुन्दै गुन्दै जायो.
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick poha. Thin poha becomes very soft and powdery in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: पोहाखौ बाटि दैयाव गोलाव समाव लाखिनो नाङा; गोख्रोंयै सुनायनो जोबथा, नाथ'बा बेयो गुदुर आरो चिपचिपा जायो.
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: The poha does not need to be kept in a bowl of water for a long time; a quick wash is enough, otherwise it becomes soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: पोहा दोननाय समाव रसखौ गुदुंनो लाखि, बुरबुरि जानो नाङा, अब्ला पोहाफोरा समानै रसजों गानो.
seg.972f174730fe.back: When adding the poha keep the syrup warm, it does not need to bubble, then the poha gets coated evenly with syrup.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: गाइखेरजों: गोबां गुदुर मिथायनि थाखाय जोबनाय पोहायाव 2–3 गेदेर सामुस गुदुं गाइखेर फोनां.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: for a softer sweet, add 2–3 big spoons of warm milk to the finished poha.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: सिबिंजों: नारिकलजों लोगोसे 1 गेदेर सामुस सावनाय सिबिं दोन.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 big spoon of roasted sesame together with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: बेखौ कृष्णाष्टमीयाव नैवेद्यम महरै हो, एबा फरायसालिनिफ्राय फैनायनि उनाव गथ'फोरनि थाखाय गोख्रों मिथाय महरै हो.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Give it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or give it as a quick sweet for children after coming from school.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: बानायनाय सानआवनो जानायआ खोब मोजां. बांसिनखौ खुबुमनानै फ्रिजआव लाखि आरो गाबोन सान जा; पोहाआ थायोब्ला गोरा जायो.
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Eating it on the day it is made is best. Cover the remainder, keep it in the fridge and eat it the next day; when poha sits it becomes hard.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलुनि थाखाय माबादि पोहाआ खोब मोजां?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: What kind of poha is best for bellam atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: मोटा पोहा (अटुकुलु). बेयो गुदुं रसआव बेनि महर लाखियो; पातला पोहाआ जोबोद गुदुर आरो गुन्दै गुन्दै जायो.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick poha (atukulu). It keeps its shape in warm syrup; thin poha becomes very soft and powdery.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलुखौ खुसेरनि गुरजों बानायनो हागोमा?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can bellam atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: हागौ. समान बिबांनि रुखुनाय खुसेरनि गुर (चेरुकु बेल्लम) बाहाय. बेनि गाबआ अनसाय गुरै जायो, केरामेल बादि गोदैथिजों.
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam). Its colour becomes a little light, with a caramel-like sweetness.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: आंनि बेल्लम अटुकुलुआ मानो चिपचिपा जायो?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why does my bellam atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: पोहाखौ दैयाव गोलाव समाव लाखिबाय एबा गोलाव समाव संबाय. बेखौ सेकेन्ड खायसेसिम सु, आरो मोनफ्रोम पोहा रसजों गाननायजोंनो सरायखौ अरनिफ्राय बेखार ला.
